Locations.Title: Perception Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Museum of Freedom, in the top floor room where you find Preston and the Minutemen. Next to a broken terminal (near a desk on the left side).

**Perk:** Your perception has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Melee Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** At the top of [Trinity Tower](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71843), inside the cage where you first meet Rex Goodman and [Strong](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351091).

**Bonus:** Permanently gain +25% critical damage with melee weapons.

Locations.Title: Speech Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Park Street Station (Vault 114)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71924) — Inside the Overseer's office, unlocked by hacking the novice-level terminal or taking the[Overseer Door Password](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443821) from Dino's corpse.  

**Bonus:** All vendors permanently have 100 more caps for bartering.

Locations.Title: Repair Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Corvega Assembly Plant - Climb to the upper-most tower outside. The Bobblehead is located at the end of a metal walkway surrounding a big blue storage tank.

**Bonus:** Fusion cores permanently last 10% longer.

Locations.Title: Lockpicking Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Pickman Gallery - deep in the basement in the room after you rescue Pickman, beside a barrel of fire.

**Bonus:** Lockpicking is permanently easier.

Locations.Title: Energy Weapons Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Fort Hagen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71930), Command Center (Basement Interior) — In the kitchen area, between two refrigerators.

**Prerequisite:** Main quest _Reunions_

**Bonus**: Permanently gain +25% critical damage with energy weapons.

Locations.Title: Explosive Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Saugus Ironworks - Saugus Blast Furnace area. On the 2nd level, directly in front of you as you enter.

**Bonus:** Permanently gain +15% damage with explosives.

Locations.Title: Science Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Malden Middle School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72026)'s Basement (Vault 75) —  In the Lab, in a room overlooking the Combat Course.  You'll need a Lab Access Card, which can be obtained by in the Diner with the Gunner commander.  

**Bonus:** Get one extra guess when hacking terminals.

Locations.Title: Charisma Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Prerequisite:** The asylum is only accessible during side quest _The Secret of Cabot House_

Parsons State Insane Asylum, 2nd floor, Jack Cabot's office. Follow the quest markers.

**Perk:** Your Charisma has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Intelligence Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Boston Public Library, inside the upstairs server room.  After entering the library from the street level, turn left and cross the big room with the turrets.  Open the single door at the end of the room for the server room.

**Perk:** Your Intelligence has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Strength Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Mass Fusion Building](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71831) - On top of a sculpture overlooking the lobby area on the fifth floor. Hop up on the ledge opposite the reception desk to reach it.

**Perk:** Your Strength has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Medicine Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065), Curie's Office — During [Hole in the Wall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350472), you will find Curie. Next to a terminal in Curie's room.

**Bonus:**   Stimpaks permanently heal 10% more damage.

Locations.Title: Sneak Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Dunwich Borers - on a small metal table by a lantern, right next to the metal post and Station 4 Terminal.

**Bonus:** You are permanently 10% harder to detect.

Locations.Title: Barter Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Longneck Lukowski's Cannery - Inside the metal catwalk hut, northwest upper area of the main cannery room.

**Bonus:** Prices are permanently 5% lower.

Locations.Title: Big Guns Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Vault 95 - in the living quarters area, north-most room, on a radio.

**Bonus:** Permanently gain +25% critical damage with heavy weapons.

Locations.Title: Small Guns Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Gunners Plaza - on the broadcast desk in the on-air room, ground floor, west side of the building.  Be prepared for a fight after unlocking the door.

**Bonus:** Gain 25% critical damage when using ballistic weapons.

Locations.Title: Unarmed Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Atom Cats Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71921) — On the hood of the rusty car in the main warehouse.

**Bonus:** Permanently gain 25% critical damage with unarmed attacks.

Locations.Title: Endurance Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Poseidon Energy - on the metal desk with a magazine, near steamer trunk, central metal catwalk.

**Bonus:** Your Endurance has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Luck Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Spectacle Island - in the green boat, inside a locker on the top floor.

**Bonus:** Your Luck has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Agility Bobblehead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Wreck of the FMS Northern Star](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72061) — On the edge of the bow of the ship, wooden platform.

**Bonus:** Your Agility has been permanently increased by 1.

Locations.Title: Sheila's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Forest Grove Marsh](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72006) - on a rooftop near some sleeping bags.

Locations.Title: Boston Shelter - Guard Update
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Boston Mayoral Shelter](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71858), lower level. On a table in the middle of the bedroom.

Locations.Title: Boston Shelter - Mayor's Goodbye
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Boston Mayoral Shelter](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71858), lower level - on top of a toilet in the bathroom unlocked with the [Boston Mayoral Shelter Bathroom Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443330)

Locations.Title: Boston Shelter - Where are You?
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Boston Mayoral Shelter](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71858), lower level - on a stool opposite the [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71473) in a side-room connected to the basketball court.

Locations.Title: Knight Astlin's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [The Lost Patrol](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350565)

[National Guard Officer's Password](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71289), Recruitment Office — On a corpse in the corner of a first floor office.

Locations.Title: Private Murnahan’s Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Fort Strong

Ground Floor- North West side of the building, on a desk.

Locations.Title: Wicked Business
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a cabinet next to the power armor station in the workshop beside the main structure at [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879).

Locations.Title: Jake's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Saugus Ironworks - in the inventory of Jake Finch, found inside the blast furnace area.  Retrieve the tape from his body upon his death, or trade with him for it if he is rescued. 

*Listening to this tape (or speaking to Jake if he survives the encounter) begins the [Out of the Fire](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350754) side quest.*

Locations.Title: Technician’s Personal Log
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [ArcJet Systems](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71887).

Locations.Title: Det. Perry's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the [Utility Tunnel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441189) (which can also be accessed via [Mass Pike Tunnel East](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71956) and [Mass Pike Tunnel West](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71955) - follow the corridor opposite the [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71483), and you'll find it next to a skeleton in the next room over from [Sgt. Reise's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441190)

Reise's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441190)

Locations.Title: The New Squirrel Tape 1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the brick building near the pool in [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860). On top of a table next to a terminal and teddy bear.

Locations.Title: The New Squirrel Tape 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a metal trailer south-west of the pool in [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860), next to a crib.

Locations.Title: The New Squirrel Tape 3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the fridge in a trailer directly east of the pool in [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860).

Locations.Title: Employee 011985TP Personal Log
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Federal Surveillance Center K-21B](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71877), on a desk immediately to your left as you enter.

Locations.Title: School Announcements Oct. 18th
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Suffolk County Charter School. Inside the principal's office, on the desk beside the terminal.

On the lectern in the cafeteria hall.

On a desk in the second floor library, next to the [Unstoppables](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71364) comic.

Locations.Title: Tessa's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Quincy Ruins](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72003) - In the inventory of Baker, a named Gunner enemy found on the roof of the church.

Locations.Title: Property of R. Burton
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Shaw High School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72024) — Inside the library on the northern edge of the upper floor. Once inside, go down the stairs and pick through a novice-difficulty door (or use the [Library Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442712)) to enter a room where the holotape is on a table.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 5
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located on the second floor of the Nahant Sheriff’s Department, on top of a filing cabinet.

Locations.Title: Baker's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the Police Terminal on the ground floor of [Quincy Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71973).

Locations.Title: Dunwich - Hugo's Struggle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Hugo's Hole](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71998) - On a table next to the body of Hugo.

Locations.Title: Cruz's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Gunner's Plaza

Locations.Title: Ryder's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Gunner's Plaza. Found on Ryder's Body (in the basement).

Locations.Title: Wes's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Gunner's Plaza

Locations.Title: Dear Detective 1-4 Holotapes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Fens Street Sewer

Locations.Title: Captain Dunleavy’s Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Sentinel Site](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71864) - in the room where you find Brother Henri. Can only be found after starting [Liberty Reprimed](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350589).

Locations.Title: Sentinel Site Blast Door Override
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Sentinel Site](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71864) - as you enter, go down the stairs to your left and press a button to get inside an office. Jump over the railing and turn around to find the holotape on a desk.

When loaded into terminals next to heavy-looking doors, it can be used to open them.

Locations.Title: Knight-Captain Cade's Report
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Next to Knight-Captain Cade's terminal in the medical area to the west.

Locations.Title: Maxson Was Right
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Next to a desk lamp between two beds on the top level.

Locations.Title: Personal Log - 142
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Next to a desk lamp between two beds on the top level.

Locations.Title: Runaway's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the suitcase next to the skeleton within the [Ranger Cabin](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71874).

Locations.Title: Emma's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Super Duper Mart](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71813) - outside of the supermarket, in the inventory of a corpse in the storage area. To get in from the outside, you'll need to hack an advanced-level terminal.

**Note:** Emma's body will despawn if you explore the area around here and the [Corvega Assembly Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71880) and enough time passes without finding her.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 8
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a cell at the end of the hall in [Police Precinct 8](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71977).

Locations.Title: Marc's Warning
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - on a desk next to the Operations Terminal in a small side-room on the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Marlene's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Top floor, in a room unlocked with the [Wilson Atomatoys HQ Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443621). Read the nearby [Reminder](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443625) to learn the the Development Lab Access Terminal's password, unlock the lab, and you'll find this holotape in the Development Lab Terminal.

Locations.Title: Spotlight Override Program
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** The Shamrock Taphouse. Automatically obtained when you collect [Total Hack #2 - Control Spotlights](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71443)

Load it into a terminal with Spotlight access to unlock new options:
- **Override Detection Parameters** - Spotlight only targets hostiles.
- **Clear Detection Parameters** - Spotlight's targeting disabled.
- **Sabotage** - Spotlight blows up.

Locations.Title: Oslow's Office Recording
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the roof of the [Mass Fusion Building](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71831), in a small office near the elevator.

Locations.Title: Gwinnett Brewery Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Gwinnett Restaurant

Locations.Title: To Claire
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On a bedside dresser in a part of [Andrew Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71926) that's only accessible during [Long Time Coming](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351090).

Locations.Title: We Are Done
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824) - inside an evidence room on the right side of the upper floor. You'll need to get through a door with a novice-difficulty lock to reach it.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 0
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824), on a filing cabinet opposite the holding cells in the basement.

Locations.Title: Operation Winter's End
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Cambridge Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71975) - on the shelves in an evidence room at the south-western edge of the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Scribe Haylen's Personal Log
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside [Cambridge Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71975). After entering through the front door, go to the right and you'll find it on a table after going through a hole in the wall.

After [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546), the holotape will move if you didn't pick it up. After entering through the front door, enter the room on the left and search the office in the corner (the one with a safe) to find it on a shelf.

Locations.Title: Lead Engineer's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059). Soon after entering, you'll fight through a long corridor full of robots. At the end of this corridor is a small diner area, and in the nearby room marked 'Quality Control', the holotape is on a desk opposite the door.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Facility Director's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deeper into the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), you'll find a huge room filled with piles of scrap. At the end, follow the corridors into a Facilities Management area, and keep an eye on the left wall to find this holotape next to the Facilities Management Terminal.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Chief Scientist's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Even deeper into the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), you'll enter the research area. After taking an elevator down, go into the brain extraction room on the right to find it near the Cerebral Reconditioning Terminal.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Jackson's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Found on the corpse of Jackson in the general location where [Ada](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351094) is encountered in the 'Mechanical Menace' quest.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Mechanist's Log
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), on a cabinet next to the bed in the Mechanist's bedroom. You can find it by following the corridor in the room you first encounter her.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Zoe's Diary
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Found on the corpse of Zoe in the general location where [Ada](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351094) is encountered in the 'Mechanical Menace' quest.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Jezebel Interview
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deep inside the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291) - next to a caged eyebot and the Rust Devil Workshop Terminal, in the same room where you fight Ahab and pick up Jezebel.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Bedford Station Recording
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the Stationmaster's Terminal in a small tower at [Bedford Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72002)

Locations.Title: Silver Shroud Script
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside Hubris Comics, on the second floor in the office behind the locked (expert) door. You can use the Hubris Comics Office Key, found in the manager's office, to gain access without needing to pick the lock.

Locations.Title: Sal's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - in the inventory of Sal, found dead on the upper floor of the town hall, behind a desk.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 6
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the upper floor of the [East Boston Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71972), inside a desk opposite the stairs.

Locations.Title: Josh's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Super Duper Mart](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71813) - on Josh's dead body, lying against a steamer trunk in a back room.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the police station directly south of the Malden Center entrance, on the second floor in the room in the southeast corner beside the only working terminal.

Locations.Title: Hammer's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the kitchen counter inside a yellow house beside the water tower.

**Warning:** Hammer is a named Super Mutant with a Rocket Launcher inside the same house.

Locations.Title: Control Subject's Recordings
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Three holotapes inside the unmarked location *Abandoned House.*

**Tape 1:** On the kitchen counter, by the mixing arm.  
**Tape 2:** On the dresser to your right at the top of the stairs.  
**Tape 3:** On top of a *Blast Radius* board game in the attic, behind an advanced locked door, guarded by a *Glowing One*.

Locations.Title: Edwin's Journal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside Edwin's terminal in his house on the southwest side of [Chestnut Hillock Reservoir](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71982)

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 9
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside of the [Coast Guard Pier](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71934), on top of a safe in the corner of the second floor.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Natick Police Department](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71974) - on the ground floor, inside the only intact locker in a room filled with rubble.

Locations.Title: Arlen's Manifesto
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Top floor, on the ground next to a desk that has a green steamer trunk on it.

Locations.Title: Bonnie's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Mass Bay Medical Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71915). From the power armor go one floor up and further east, on a shelf in a small room beside the MRI/CAT scan machine.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 7
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the second floor, on top of a desk in the corner.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Quincy Police Lock Up](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442660) - In a locker opposite the cells.

Locations.Title: Eddie Winter Holotape 1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Given by [Nick Valentine](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351089) at the beginning of his companion quest [Long Time Coming](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351090).

Locations.Title: Sylvia's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a toolbox near the safe with an expert-difficulty lock in a liquor store.

Locations.Title: David's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside Wayne's Terminal in the [Backyard Bunker](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440649), found outside the house where you grabbed [Hammer's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=116914).

Locations.Title: Log - SSG Michael Daly
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a desk beside a [T-45 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71701) and vertibird on the roof of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849).

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the Police Terminal in a trailer directly west of the [Boston Police Rationing Site](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71936)

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [The Lost Patrol](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350565)

In the inventory of Knight Varham, slumped against a desk in the ruined house.

Locations.Title: Scribe Faris' Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Related Quest:** [The Lost Patrol](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350565)

[Revere Satellite Array](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72020) — Inside an elevated shack near the southwest array tower.

Locations.Title: Discarded ArcJet worklog
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: It can be found in the lab control room at [ArcJet Systems](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71887), on a desk next to a terminal and a globe in the middle of the room.

Locations.Title: Pledge Initiation Instructions
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Russell Sutton, found dead near the fusion core in [Malden Drainage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440654).

Locations.Title: Skylanes Flight 1981 Recording
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Added to your inventory when grabbing the Flight Data Recorder in the plane's cockpit.

Locations.Title: Sgt. Reise's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [Utility Tunnel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441189) (which can also be accessed via [Mass Pike Tunnel East](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71956) and [Mass Pike Tunnel West](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71955) - follow the corridor opposite the [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71483), and you'll find it near a skeleton wearing army clothes in the room to the left of the terminal.

Locations.Title: Sully's Journal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the Thicket Excavations Terminal, found in a trailer opposite the stone blocks.

Locations.Title: Combat Sentry Proto MKIV Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found inside a terminal inside the concrete building at the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916). Can be used in your Pip-Boy or on the terminal itself to activate the sentry bot outside.

Once active, it can be sent to temporarily visit [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021), [South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933), [Revere Satellite Array](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72020), or [Fort Hagen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71930), but moves slowly and often stops due to overheating.

Can also be used again to trigger the bot's self-destruct sequence. This yields two [Fusion Cores](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71500).

Locations.Title: Private Hart's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Private Hart, found near the cellar doors outside of the [Museum of Witchcraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71961).

Locations.Title: Sergeant Lee's Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a restroom filled with Deathclaw eggs on the upper floor of the [Museum of Witchcraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71961).

Locations.Title: Gunner Holotape
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of a Gunner found here after listening to the Vault-Tec Distress Signal. After reading its contents, you can interact with the corpse again to find [more coordinates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71868) to investigate.

Added to the game with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Griswold's Poetry Collection
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a terminal in the gun shop on the top floor of [Monsignor Plaza](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72019). You may need to progress through the [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415) quest before it will appear.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: The Black Devil Vol.1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Beneath a spotlighted poster on the northern end of [Wattz Consumer Electronics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71818).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Protectron Override Program
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the issue of [Total Hack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71398) in [Wattz Consumer Electronics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71818).

Load it into your Pip-Boy to unlock new options:
- **Disengage Safety Sensors** - Makes the Protectron hostile to everything in the vicinity.
- **Override Alliance Parameters** - Makes the Protectron friendly to allies, and hostile to enemies.
- **Hijack VIP Escort Protocols** (Protectron charging pod terminals only) - Makes the Protectron a temporary companion, allowing it to fast travel with you.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Automatically obtained when looting the [Total Hack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71444) magazine at [Wildwood Cemetery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71905)

Load it into a terminal with control over a turret to unlock new options:
- **Scramble Targeting Parameters** - Turret will shoot anything that moves
- **Override Targeting Parameters** - Turret will only target hostiles
- **Sabotage Firing Mechanism** - Turret will blow up next time it fires.

In the inventory of [Commander Kaylor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543607), a named Gunner enemy found outside the [Nuka-World Transit Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117903).

*Nuka-World DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Notes from Red Tourette's Sister
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Three notes can be found deep inside the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857), on the main table in front of the sofa in Red Tourette’s room (easiest to find when entering through a hatch in the [Lonely Chapel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71867).)

- Don't Worry, Sis
- To My Big Sister Red
- Red! It's Lily!

Between a log and wooden pallet at the water's edge.

Locations.Title: Signal Checklist
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a table next to the [Spectacle Island Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441332).

Locations.Title: Bottle Message - Predator Becomes Prey
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sticking out of a bottle at the edge of the rocky beach.

Begins a miscellaneous quest that leads to [a treasure](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441391) at the bottom of the sea nearby.

Locations.Title: Bottle Message - Not Going Well
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sticking out of a bottle at the edge of the water, near a red buoy.

Begins a miscellaneous quest that leads to [a treasure](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441395) at the bottom of the sea nearby.

Locations.Title: Office Duties
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On top of a desk on the upper floor of [Hopesmarch Pentecostal Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71868).

Locations.Title: Journal Scrap
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: College Square Station Interior - on the lowest level of the station, in the inventory of a corpse laying in a concrete archway that leads into the train.

Locations.Title: Toll Schedule
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Ricca, a corpse found on the bar's roof.

Locations.Title: Racetrack Advertisement
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In a magazine rack found inside the small building opposite the College Square Station entrance.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Flyer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the countertop of the small building opposite the College Square Station entrance. Taking it begins a miscellaneous quest.

Locations.Title: Marvin's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a countertop beneath the pipe grenade launcher in the gun shop on the top floor of [Monsignor Plaza](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72019). You may need to progress through the [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415) quest before it will appear.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Richard's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Richard, found dead inside the small building.

Locations.Title: The Synthetic Truth
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the countertop of a small building. Eight more copies can be found in boxes inside the building.

Locations.Title: Connie's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Beneath a spotlighted poster on the northern end of [Wattz Consumer Electronics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71818). Must be picked up to progress [Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Richie's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Richie, found dead here during the [Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414) side quest added as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Note: May not spawn if you haven't found [Connie's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442030)

Locations.Title: Cigarette Paper
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In a hole in the wall behind Connie, found dead in an interrogation room at the north-western edge of the [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824) during the [Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414) side quest added as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

**Note:** Will not spawn if you haven't found [Richie's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442032)

Locations.Title: Connie's Confession
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a table next to Connie, found dead in an interrogation room at the north-western edge of the [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824) during the [Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414) side quest added as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

**Note:** Will not spawn if you haven't found [Richie's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442032)

Locations.Title: Hodges' Journal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Hodges, an Enclave commander that attacks after you find the [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441192), read the entries on the terminal behind it, and make either choice regarding the radio.

Added to the game with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Notes on the X-02
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a table next to the [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441192). The room it's in can only be accessed by following the "[Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414)" quest to its very end and interacting with the radio.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Swan's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Next to the pillow inside a small wooden shack next to [Swan's Pond](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=76796).

Locations.Title: Experiment Log Notes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Four notes in the 'Experiment Log J-32' series can be found in and around the wooden shack next to [Swan's Pond](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=76796). They can be found in the following locations:
- On a small wooden crate near a chair (Day 1 and Day 6)
- On a concrete block next to a bench (Day 14)
- On the ground next to a steamer trunk in the corner of the shack (Day 21)

Locations.Title: State House Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Massachusetts State House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71836). Immediately after entering, climb the collapsed floor in a room to your left to go up a level, then enter a room on your left. The note is in the inventory of a scavenger next to the cooking station.

Locations.Title: Racetrack Advertisement
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Water Street Apartments](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442067), in front of the TV on the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Lana's Notes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [New England Technocrat Society](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442260), next to a skeleton in the corridor next to the stage.

Locations.Title: De-Capitalist Helmets
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [New England Technocrat Society](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442260). At the end of the corridor to the right of the stage, input code 4-3-4-6 to enter a room where the note is near some helmets to your left.

Locations.Title: Work Order 09-241
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a cabinet opposite the back door inside [RobCo Sales & Service Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=87934).

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Bakery Tickets x9
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Nine Bakery Ticket notes can be found inside and around the bakery in the [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). There is a tenth ticket with number 65, but it's glitched into the ground and cannot be obtained without cheating.

1. On the bakery's countertop. (82)
2. Beneath the previous ticket. (84)
3. Beneath the previous ticket. (83)
4. On the ground in front of the cash register. (61)
5. On the ground in front of the brown shelves (77)
6. Opposite the bakery's countertop, on a bench. (22)
7. Next to the bakery's front door, behind a pillar holding the sign. (43)
8. Next to the bakery's front door, near an orange and white barricade. (58)
9. Inside a nearby Pulowski Preservation Shelter, in a skeleton's hand. (47)

Locations.Title: Evacuation Plan
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside Bill's Suitcase in the [shack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71877).

Locations.Title: Food for the Grasshopper
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found when picking up the Gilded Grasshopper found on the roof of [Faneuil Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71848).

Locations.Title: Mama Murphy's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On top of a bedside dresser in a room on the ruined building's top floor.

Locations.Title: Jacq's Note

When you reach the chained door, search a nearby office to find the note inside a duffel bag.

Locations.Title: Fishing Tournament Ad
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a desk inside the [monitoring station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442689).

Locations.Title: Legal Notice
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a desk inside the [monitoring station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442689).

Locations.Title: Fear Not
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a coffin found when digging up a grave near a tree at the north-western edge of the [Graveyard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71907). Can only be accessed after reading [Food for the Grasshopper](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442650).

Locations.Title: Cargo Handler's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the ground beside the desk with the Loading Dock Terminal, inside the northern warehouse at [Bedford Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72002).

Locations.Title: Helena's Instructions
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Helena, found slumped against the water tower near [Bedford Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72002).

Locations.Title: Dutchman's Instructions
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of Dutchman, found a few steps away from the small tower's stairs at [Bedford Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72002).

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899) - In a side-room on the upper floor, on top of a desk next to a well-dressed skeleton.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a desk with a novice-difficulty lock in the 'Slocum's Joe Offices' interior of [Slocum's Joe Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72017).

Locations.Title: Sleepwalking Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a chem cooler on the upper floor of a chained-up house. It can only be accessed by swimming in the [Old Gullett Sinkhole](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71980) and exiting through the house.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Flyer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - In the inventory of Luke Silverhand, found sitting near the chained up door inside the church.

Locations.Title: Silverhand's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - In the inventory of Luke Silverhand, found sitting near the chained up door inside the church.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Flyer

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Top floor, on the desk in a room unlocked with the [Wilson Atomatoys HQ Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443621).

Locations.Title: The Mysterious Stranger
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the ground floor underneath a bed in [Valentine's Detective Agency](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71963).

Locations.Title: Earl Sterling Case Notes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Diamond City, [Valentine's Detective Agency](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71963) - On a desk in the corner. Can only be found here after completing [Unlikely Valentine](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354338).

Locations.Title: Marty Bullfinch Case File

Locations.Title: Sleep Walker's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Camp on the Freeway](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443612) - Inside a trailer, on a small table near the door.

Locations.Title: Calvin's Letter

**Required:** Own and install the Graphic T-Shirt Pack creation.

Found inside a suitcase on top of a round table in one of the trailers. It's north of the pool and has a bathtub outside.

[Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - In the inventory of a Forged Keeper enemy. Reading it begins the [Crucible](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441413) quest.

**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation.

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - In the inventory of a Gunner found on the floor next to a radio. Watch out for the tripwire!

**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation.

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - On the upper floor, next to a Novice-difficulty terminal and [Beast Hunter's Log 1](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510378) on a dresser in the corner of a bedroom.

Locations.Title: Flashbang Grenades
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - On top of a small dresser in the same room as the [Beast Hunter's Hideout Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510414).

Unlocks the ability to craft flashbangs at a chemistry workbench.

Locations.Title: Beast Hunter's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - On top of an armor workbench in the same room as the [Beast Hunter's Hideout Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510414)

Locations.Title: Raider Reminder Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation.

[Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753) - In the inventory of a raider near a valve, directly left of the hermetically sealed door.

Locations.Title: Kerry's Note 3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - On a table next to the corpse holding the [Varmint Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510758)

Locations.Title: Survivor's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757), Research Wing - After restoring functionality to the containment pod arm, go back down in the elevator and use the Research Control Terminal to retrieve pod 41 and find the note inside it.

[Destroyed House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=455012), in the corner.

Reading it begins [The Quantum Stag](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=512596) quest.

Locations.Title: Scavenger's Lead

Locations.Title: Extra's Notes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation. 

On the rooftop of [Hubris Comics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71840), on top of a table near a skeleton. You can reach it via ladder on the top floor of the store.

Locations.Title: Jenny's Diary
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation. 

On the rooftop of Hubris Comics, on top of a stack of crates near a skeleton. You can reach it via ladder on the top floor of the store.

Locations.Title: Notes on the Throne Room
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation.

Inside a duffle bag on the rooftop, accessed via [Shenley's Oyster Bar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353775).

Locations.Title: Kerry's Note 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - After raising the water level in the Reactor and Security Wing (by following a red pipe in the area back to the [Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753), and using the terminal you previously used to lower it), swim to the far side of the room to take on the power puzzle. Once it's solved, you can use a terminal upstairs to lift lockdown, unlocking a small area with Kerry's Terminal.

Approach the nearby 'EXIT' door to meet a friendly Deathclaw, then enter the room it was in to find this note on a box.

Locations.Title: Kerry's Note 1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - After raising the water level in the Reactor and Security Wing (by following a red pipe in the area back to the [Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753), and using the terminal you previously used to lower it), swim to the far side of the room to take on the power puzzle. Once it's solved, you can use a terminal upstairs to lift lockdown, unlocking a small area with Kerry's Terminal.

This note is on top of a box near a metal pillar.

Next to a corpse found by tuning in to the SOS radio signal, unlocked at level 15.

_Note: This creation is only available on the PC and Xbox versions of the game._

_Note: This creation is only available on the PC and Xbox versions of the game._

Next to the corpse of Nunez, found on the upper floor of the church.

Locations.Title: Alexandra Trumbull's Note

On the corpse of Captain Mercer, found on a rooftop. He also carries the Minutemen Flag needed to complete [War Paint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=520694).

Locations.Title: Note to Tweez

Locations.Title: Farmer's Note

**Required:** Own and install the Zetan Arsenal creation.

In the inventory of a farmer, found dead on the road. Begins the [Over The Moon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543130) quest.

Locations.Title: Family Matters

**Required:** Own and install the Bunker Home Pack creation.

On a desk by a hole in the upper floor, reached via elevator.

Locations.Title: The Third Law
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Bunker Home Pack creation.

Inside [Wilmingdon Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543137)' basement bunker, on a table in the living room to the north of the courtyard.

**Required:** Own and install the Bunker Home Pack creation.

Inside [Juniper Cove Resort](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543140), on a table to your right as you enter the main area.

Inside a small display case in the [Museum of Witchcraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71961). The note's name will change based on your character's name.

Locations.Title: Announcement Script
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Given to you during the Institute quest [Powering Up](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516507).

Locations.Title: Bathroom Note x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Reeb Marina](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71952) - Both notes are on top of the sink in the bathroom.

Locations.Title: Breakroom Note x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Reeb Marina](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71952) - Both notes are on a countertop in the kitchen area.

Locations.Title: Caravan Details
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Obtained during [Human Error](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516527) when you agree to help track down the caravan.

Locations.Title: From Lucia
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Inside Initiate's Clarke's Footlocker at the bottom of a bed at the edge of the top level near the Outgoing Mail Terminal. Can only be found during [Duty or Dishonor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350575)

Locations.Title: Goodbye Letter
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Warwick Homestead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72057) - In the inventory of Bill Sutton.

Locations.Title: Eleanor's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a table in the trailer where you can usually find [Eleanor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441193).

Locations.Title: Note from Eric
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Second floor of HalluciGen, on a desk beside the accounting terminal.

Locations.Title: HalluciGen Mission Brief
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the Gunner commander in the lab within HalluciGen. Also drops Gunner's Note.

Locations.Title: Lorenzo Cabot's Journal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on the 3rd floor of Cabot House, right next to the Massachusetts Surgical Journal. You'll get access the 3rd floor after completing [Emogene Takes a Lover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516526)

Locations.Title: Find the Silver Shroud
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on Smiling Kate’s body near Bunker Hill during The Silver Shroud side quest if Northy, south of Wattz Consumer Electronics, is killed first.

Can alternatively be found on [Northy’s body](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=558436), south of Wattz Consumer Electronics, if you kill Smiling Kate near Bunker Hill first.

Locations.Title: Find the Silver Shroud
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on Northy’s body south of Wattz Consumer Electronics during The Silver Shroud side quest. It only appears here if you kill Smiling Kate near Bunker Hill first.

Can alternatively be found on [Smiling Kate's body](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=558435), near Bunker Hill, if you kill Northy near Wattz Consumer Electronics first.

Locations.Title: Contract: Shelly Tiller
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on Kendra’s body during The Silver Shroud side quest on the 2nd floor of Water Street Apartments. This starts the optional objective to kill Shelly Tiller at the National Guard Training Yard. Good-natured companions will disapprove, but you’ll receive 500 caps at a dead drop if you kill Shelly.

Locations.Title: Scavenger's List
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a dead scavenger on the 2nd floor of Hubris Comics, inside a hole in the wall to the right at the top of the stairs from the first floor, as you enter the office area.

Locations.Title: Scavenger's Note
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a dead scavenger in the first-floor restroom of Hubris Comics.

Locations.Title: HELP WANTED!
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Both copies of "HELP WANTED!" are on the reception desk in the entrance area of HelliuciGen.

Locations.Title: Ness' Lead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Carried by Ness, a traveling random encounter who will hire you as part of a miscellaneous quest to help secure the [Skylanes Flight 1981](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71962) crash site from raiders. 

After the site is secured with Ness and the Gunner mercenaries she hired, she reveals that she’s really after the contents of a hidden compartment beneath the front section of the plane. If you refuse to leave with only the caps she promised, Ness and the Gunners will turn on you. Once she’s been killed, the note can be looted from her body. 

Alternatively, you can pickpocket it from her as well.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Med-Tek Research](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71911), Sub-Level — On the lowest sub-level, inside a generator.

 Note that the subfloors of the building can only be explored during [Long Road Ahead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350900), after [MacCready](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350823) gives you the password to the locked terminal located on Level 3.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the roof of [Fallon's Department Store](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71819). Enter through a hatch in a back room on the top floor to find it next to you inside a generator.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On [Quincy Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71973)'s upper floor, inside a wooden box on a desk in the corner. You'll need to jump on top of the desk to see and grab it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Gunners Plaza - inside a machine in the very top room.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Malden Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71927) - one is found inside a generator directly to the south when you emerge from the elevator.

The second is on the ground next to the generator.

The third inside a cardboard box on top of the nearby desk.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Easiest to find when entering Concord Civic Access from the [Eastern entrance](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401373). Follow the pipe down into some shallow water, then turn left to find it beneath some hanging plants at the end of the waterway.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a generator on the roof of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850).

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Behind [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) in an area only accessible with Master-level lockpicking or hacking.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found inside the Combat Sentry Prototype MK IV at the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916). 

*The cores can be obtained by activating the prototype from the terminal inside the concrete building, then selecting the self-destruct command once it becomes available.*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916) -  inside a green trunk in front of the inactive sentry bot.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857). Follow the path to the right (while watching out for landmines) until you reach the upper half of a flooded room. Drop down a level, turn to the right, and you'll find it in a generator in the room behind a novice-locked door.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Inside a generator in the basement, near some can chimes.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Three fusion cores are available in the tunnels beneath [The Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72055), only accessible after starting [Old Guns](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350711) (a Minutemen quest.)

The first core is in a generator, with the other two in the inventory of Sarge (a hostile sentry bot found near the exit.)

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Cutler Bend](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71950) - In the cabin of a capsized white boat.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Four Leaf Fishpacking Plant - On the shelf to the right of the Protectron pod.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Four Leaf Fishpacking Plant - In a fusion generator in one of the huts on the roof

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Four Leaf Fishpacking Plant - Inside the ground floor entrance, to the left.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Greenetech Genetics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71822) - after exiting the elevator, hack into a master-difficulty terminal to find two fusion cores in the room it unlocks. 

A third fusion core can be found on the same floor. Before going up the stairs, look left and pick through a door with an advanced-difficulty lock (or hack into an advanced-level terminal) to gain access to a storage room with a fusion core inside.


Note that the building is inaccessible until starting the [Hunter/Hunted](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354344) quest.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found at the bottom of the big chamber in [Kendall Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71914), where the Deathclaw is prowling.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Layton Towers - found on the first floor.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the Mirelurk-infested basement of the [Massachusetts State House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71836). Inside a generator near a terminal that unlocks the way out of the basement.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Medical Center Metro](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71925) - inside a generator in a room accessed by climbing a pile of rubble near a wrecked train.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Railroad HQ Escape Tunnel - Inside a generator in the room behind a locked terminal (Expert) security door.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Revere Beach Station - found inside a book return box in the Revere Arcade. Use 50 tokens to collect it.

Tokens are earned by finding Overdue Books out in the world and putting them in the machine.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside [Malden Drainage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440654), on the upper-right side of the area reached by walking along the pipes at the back.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Institute - found in the Old Robotics area after dropping through a round hatch.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the storage room found behind the screen at [Starlight Drive In](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72032). You'll need to pick through a novice-difficulty lock to reach it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Super Duper Mart](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71813) in the employees area at the eastern edge of the store. Pick through a door with a novice-difficulty lock to reach it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In a generator behind the puzzle-locked door in the [Pumphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442651). Press the buttons near the door so the code '10-4-5-1' is displayed to get inside.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Mass Fusion Building](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71831) - In a secret room far above the glass ceiling. Can only be accessed by using an ID card on the elevator, obtained during the Brotherhood of Steel's [Spoils of War](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350610) quest (or every other faction's Nuclear Option quest.)

Once you're above the glass ceiling, use a jetpack power armor mod to fly incredibly high up - and look out for a hole in the southern wall. This leads to a small room where you'll find the fusion core on a desk to your right.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the lowest level of the [Yangtze](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71970), in the flooded part of the room in the south-eastern corner. You'll find it in a box near a skeleton sticking out of a barrel.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899) — In a display case on your left as you enter the Director's Office. The door has a master-difficulty lock that will be unlocked for you at the [end of the building's quest](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443401), or with the [CPL Director's Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443417).

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a generator that's on a roof opposite the [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824). Climb the scaffolding behind the building to reach it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71732). To access the cage it's in, you'll need to hack a novice-difficulty terminal.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Beacon Hill - found inside a rooftop generator.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Behind an unmarked shed north of [ArcJet Systems](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71887). Watch out for landmines nearby.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [The Switchboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117211) - when you reach the  offices, follow the signs to the exit. Near the elevator, you'll find a security gate with an advanced-difficulty lock; the fusion core can be found behind it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [The Switchboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117211) - after fighting through the sewer and hacking into a novice-difficulty terminal, you'll enter a large room. Search a smaller room to your left to find the fusion core in a generator.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a generator beneath the freeway, right next to the [Freeway Elevator](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443611)

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the Compound

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** When first entering the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), there is a fusion core in a generator to your left next to a corridor filled with laser tripwires, and on a shelf in the security office behind a locked door to the right of the corridor. 

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the lowest level of the [Wreck of the FMS Northern Star](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72061), in a generator.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: This well-hidden fusion core can be found to the northeast of the [Coastal Cottage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72040), in a [Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440536) under the eastern side of the bridge. You'll find the fusion core in front of you as you enter the hideout, but should be prepared for a fight against several ghouls - including a Glowing One.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Encountered during [The Big Dig](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350822), a side quest started in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

- The first Fusion Core can be located when Sonia blasts open the first wall of dirt, on the left side of the following room.
- The second Fusion Core can be found further in, immediately after exiting the red pipe. Turn left, and you’ll see a locked (Expert) door, with a generator behind it holding the core.
- An additional two Fusion Cores can be found in the strongroom, but are **only accessible if you side with Bobbi No-Nose at the end of the quest**. After looting the key from one of the named NPC’s bodies, you can unlock Hancock’s Storeroom and claim the last two Fusion Cores.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The last two Fusion Cores can be found in the strongroom, but are **only accessible if you side with Bobbi No-Nose at the end of the quest Goodneighbor.** After looting the key from one of the named NPC’s bodies, you can unlock Hancock’s Storeroom and claim the last two Fusion Cores.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Aboard the [Yangtze](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71970). Head to the northern end of the submarine until you reach the sleeping area, then hug the western wall to find it in a footlocker on the floor opposite the [Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71683).

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a generator that's at the top of a fire escape near the police department.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [Nuka-World Transit Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117903), near some radioactive barrels at the end of a tunnel behind the train.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of a Sentry Bot that spawns here when you open [The Door](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441401).

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a generator on the ground floor of the [Factory](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442285), near the stairs.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a safe that you can only access after completing the 'Quality Assurance' quest in the QA area of  the [General Atomics Factory](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71901). The steps to complete it are listed below.
- In the first chamber, turn off the radio near the fireplace.
- In the second chamber, hold the 'pick up' button while looking at the large baby bottle, walk it over to the crib, and drop it inside.
- In the third chamber, pick up the:
    - Abraxo cleaner, next to the sofa
    - Wrench, under the stool in front of the TV
    - Machete, inside the fridge

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Deep inside the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After fighting Ahab and picking up Jezebel, you'll find a room with three laser tripwires. Once you're in the room past them, you'll find this fusion core in a generator to your right.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Public Works Maintenance Area](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442635)- Inside a generator in a room you'll reach soon after emerging from the sewers. Only accessible during [The Nuclear Option (Minutemen)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350738)

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Reach the top floor of the deadly [Parking Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442706) to find four fusion cores inside a locked cell. Press the button on the left to open it, but prepare for the other cell's loot (chems and first aid) to be destroyed.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of a Sentry Bot found in the back room of [Hester's Consumer Robotics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71841).

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Once you’ve completed the [Reunions](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354340) story quest, you can head to the Boston Airport and find this Fusion Core on the ground floor, behind an iron fence. Enter through the hole in the wall and it will be on your left -- along with a pack of Feral Ghouls.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2

**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter DLC.

[Nahant Sewers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510397) - Inside a generator in the upper corner of the area where you fight Bessy and the Beast Hunter.

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - On a shelf directly to the left of the Research Wing door.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71699) that's located in train car in a locked cage. To reach it, you'll need to hack an Advanced-difficulty terminal.

Inside the [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442292) that's found in the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291), a location only accessible after making progress in [Headhunting](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442288). Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71703), found inside a container outside the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857). Try to approach stealthily, as a raider may get into the armor if alerted.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Gunners vs Minutemen creation.

On the corpse of a minuteman found in the garage.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located under the control console of the partially flooded red ship near the Yangtze’s telescope.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on the Enclave Hellfire Trooper wearing [Hellfire Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440709) at the [Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=598142) east of  [The Slog](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72041). 

It can only be obtained by pickpocketing the trooper. This will most likely require killing the turret and the two other Enclave soldiers at the encampment first, then leaving the area and waiting 48 hours to reset the trooper’s detection state after being caught for killing nearby allies. Afterward, return to the encampment, sneak up on the Hellfire Trooper, and pickpocket it.

Locations.Title: Fusion Core
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441425) worn by an Enclave soldier at the [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453).

Can only be obtained by pickpocketing the soldier. This will most likely require destroying the turret and killing the two other Enclave soldiers at the encampment first, then leaving the area and waiting 24 hours to reset the trooper’s detection state after being caught for killing nearby allies.

*The [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core

Can only be obtained by pickpocketing the trooper. This will most likely require destroying the turret and killing the two Enclave soldiers at the encampment first, then leaving the area and waiting 24 hours to reset the trooper’s detection state after being caught for killing nearby allies.

*The [Eastern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401454) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core

Inside the [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443590) worn by an Enclave soldier at the [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455). 

It can only be obtained by pickpocketing the soldier. This will most likely require killing the two turrets and the other Enclave soldier at the encampment first, then leaving the area and waiting 48 hours to reset the trooper’s detection state after being caught for killing nearby allies.

*The [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Fusion Core

Locations.Title: Fusion Core x2

Inside the power armor worn by Boomer, the raider boss at [Outpost Zimonja](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72039).

The core can only be obtained by pickpocketing it. Killing Boomer, or anyone wearing power armor, destroys the core and makes it unavailable.

**Location:** Robotics Disposal Ground - found by the east entrance.
Behind a stack of tires on the right when you enter the grounds. 

**Tips:**
- The Mini Nuke is usually stuck and cannot be grabbed *unless* you throw a mine down onto it. This can roll the mini nuke into a position where it can be grabbed.
- A Fat Man (weapon that launches Mini Nukes) can be found amongst the wreckage at the north-west edge of the area.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke

Hug the left wall to enter a ruined room filled with Ghouls, and you'll find it among the rubble of a destroyed wall to the right of the generators.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [The Switchboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117211) - after entering the office area, follow the signs to the R&D room. Here, [Deacon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350803) will hack into a terminal and open a vault where the mini nuke is held.

*Note - the vault can only be opened during the [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802) quest.*

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deep inside [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After dealing with Ivey (the Rust Devil boss with the [Tesla Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71806)), you'll enter a small room with some pipes. At the back of this room, pick through a security gate with an expert-difficulty lock to find the mini nukes next to a fat man on a shelf.


*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), in the room at the end of the hallway near the Mechanist's bedroom.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [University Point: Sedgwick Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442666) - on the top floor, reached by fighting through the mirelurk-infested area behind the barricade. When you reach the chained door, search the nearby office to find it under a desk.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Reach the top floor of the deadly [Parking Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442706) to find a mini nuke alongside four fusion cores inside a locked cell. Press the button on the left to open it, but prepare for the other cell's loot (chems and first aid) to be destroyed.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a countertop in the unmarked [Diner](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443800), found above the junkyard near [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929). Easiest to reach with a jetpack, or by performing some very tricky jumps over the rooftops of nearby buildings.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Arturo Rodriguez](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443631)'s house. If you pickpocket the key from him or pick the advanced lock, it is to the left on a table in the corner.

Locations.Title: Mini Nuke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Behind the counter of Kill Or Be Killed, the shop run be [KL-E-0](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443810) in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063). Must be stolen.

Respawns every few days.

Locations.Title: Jetpack Mod (T-60)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Mod that can be applied to any T-60 power armor without the need for any crafting materials. Reward for completing [A New Dawn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350619).

Locations.Title: X-02 Devil's Inferno
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a safe in the wall behind the [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441192). Read the entries on the terminal behind the armor, and choose to 'short-circuit radio transmission' to unlock the safe.

Added to the game with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Patience Legendary Mod
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - After raising the water level in the Reactor and Security Wing (by following a red pipe in the area back to the [Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753), and using the terminal you previously used to lower it), swim to the far side of the room to take on the power puzzle. Once it's solved, you can use a terminal upstairs to lift lockdown, unlocking a small area with Kerry's Terminal.

Approach the nearby 'EXIT' door to meet a friendly Deathclaw, then enter the room it was in to find this mod for the [Varmint Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510758).

**Effect:** Second shot after a 2 second delay grants +175% damage.

Locations.Title: Puncturing pipe wrench mod
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Mod for the pipe wrench.

**Location:** In the FEV Lab storage room, on a shelf.

**Effect:** Armor piercing. Superior damage +10

Locations.Title: Hooked pipe wrench mod
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Mod for the pipe wrench.

**Location:** In the storage room, on a shelf.

**Effect:** Chance to disarm. +5 Better damage.

Locations.Title: Flame Resistance
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Only works with Raider power armor legs.

[Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - Found during the [Crucible](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441413), and used to retrieve the [Ghoul Slayer's Heavy Incinerator](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508925).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.
