Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Next to a skeleton on the roof of the [Haymarket Mall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71828). Seemingly only accessible if you have a jetpack and start from a high-up point like the [Garden Terrace](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71827).

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Gunners Plaza

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [HalluciGen, Inc.](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71839) — On the first level.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Mahkra Fishpacking](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71884) - in the back of a blue truck on the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Medford Memorial Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71910) - Middle floor, south-west corner; next to a bench near the doorway of a room with two Nuka-Cola machines.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:**[Medical Center Metro](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71925) - inside a baby stroller in the men's bathroom, on the same level as the flooded platform.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:**[Medical Center Metro](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71925) - inside a small blue box next to a Nuka-Cola machine by the flooded platform.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Old Corner Bookstore - found on Level 1.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Peabody House

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Pickman Gallery - found in one of the tunnels.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Pickman Gallery - found in one of the tunnels.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. On the lowest level, opposite the Recreation Terminal.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the storage room found behind the screen at [Starlight Drive In](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72032). You'll need to pick through a novice-difficulty lock to reach it.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside [Super Duper Mart](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71813), in the boxes directly to your right after entering through the store's front door.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the third floor of The Institute's main room, western side. Enter the living quarters on the left to find it on a dresser opposite the bed.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Charlestown Laundry](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440738), on a desk behind the door with a novice-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On a small outpost near [Breakheart Banks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71903).

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On top of an air duct on the top floor of a ruined brick building. Perform some tricky jumps on the half-broken walls to reach it, or just shoot the bottle down.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Hidden under leaves by a dried out river bed north of [Vault 111](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72064). 

*If it's stuck underground, place a mine nearby and use the explosion to knock the bottle loose, as shown in the two screenshots.*

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Next to the driver's seat inside a bus on top of the freeway. Use the [Wrecked Bus](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441509) to the west to reach it.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside a vending machine on the back of a truck.

Unlike most Nuka-Cola machines, the Quantum in this machine is guaranteed to spawn.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Top floor, underneath a red chair in the middle row of the conference room.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Shamrock Taphouse, in a storage room with some radroaches.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Shamrock Taphouse

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Aboard the [Yangtze](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71970). Head to the northern end of the submarine until you reach the sleeping area, then hug the western wall to find it near a skeleton in the corner.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Gwinnett Restaurant

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Charlestown - South Alley and Garage

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Both bottles are in a crate under the stairs on the fourth floor of Ticonderoga, as you descend from the Railroad safehouse.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - Both are near [Takahashi](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443647); one near a cooler on the countertop, and the other on a countertop near an oven.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929) - On the upper floor of the Cooke Residence, entered by picking through an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Kellogg's House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443646) in [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929). Unlock the secret room during [Getting a Clue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354339) and check the shelves to find the two bottles.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Dugout Inn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443637) - on the shelves behind the bar. Taking it is stealing, so don't get caught!

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Quincy Ruins](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72003) - On the lower level of the elevated freeway, accessed by climbing up to the church roof and using the wooden walkways. Once you're on the freeway, look behind the big red truck to find it on a shelf.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Park Street Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71924) - in a pile of debris at the end of one of the train tunnels.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the fridge near [Hammer's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=116914) inside a yellow house beside the water tower.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On a small shelf in the top area of the scavenger's house outside of *Mass Pike Tunnel West.*

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Gibson Point Pier](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71951) - on a shelf to your immediate left as you enter the diner.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929) - Next to Sheng Kowalski's house in the middle of the lake.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the refrigerator in the [Lootable House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441290), southeast of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034).

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** The Dig

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the [Backyard Bunker](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440649), in a crate on top of the table.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Deep inside the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After fighting Ahab and picking up Jezebel, you'll find a room with three laser tripwires. Once you're in the room past them, you'll find the nuka-cola on a desk in the corner near a terminal.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x5
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Five bottles of Nuka-Cola Quantum can be found while exploring the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059).

- In a locker immediately to your left after getting through the extravagant door in the basement of [RobCo Sales & Service Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=87934).
- In a smaller diner area left of the entrance to Quality Control
- Held by a skeleton inside Quality Control, just opposite the entrance
- Inside a box in the Facilities Wing. As you enter, jump on top of the concrete platform next to a ramp leading down to find two bottles in a box behind the pipe.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Public Works Maintenance Area](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442635) - Inside a blue box at the end of a sewer tunnel. Can only be accessed during [The Nuclear Option (Minutemen)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350738).

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the basement of [Milton General Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71909), hidden behind a box on a desk.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Behind a Nuka-Cola machine on the ground floor's north-western stairwell.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum x2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Two bottles of Nuka-Cola Quantum can be found in the rubble near the fridge in this submerged house. Swim near the fridge to knock them loose.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Gwinnett Brewery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71902) - next to the Nuka-Cola Machine, behind a wooden panel leaning against the wall.

Locations.Title: Nuka-Cola Quantum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a fridge, on the first floor of the ruined building, slightly West of the [USS Constitution](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71958)

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** South of Greater Mass Blood Clinic in a large shed with 4 Power Armor Stations.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Military Checkpoint

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Lexington](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72012) - worn by a raider up on the walkways between buildings. Destroy or steal the fusion core to take the frame, or just kill the raider to loot the pieces from their corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located in train car in a locked cage, requires advanced level terminal hacking

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Underwater at the northern end of the pond. Look for a vertibird tail above the water, then swim down to find it on the western side of the submerged aircraft.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found beside a vertibird on the roof of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849). It can be reached either by traversing through the museum during the main story quest [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644), or by jumping onto the vertibird from the roof of the neighboring [Concord Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441298).

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Behind a security door controlled by an Advanced Terminal inside a blue train car.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a container outside the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857). Try to approach stealthily, as a raider may get into the armor if alerted.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Found outside the [Roadside Pines Motel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71816), and usually worn by a Raider. Destroy or steal the fusion core to take the frame, or kill the raider wearing it to take the pieces.

Infamously buggy, and may be stuck in a wall.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [National Guard Training Yard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71931), Outside — On the western outskirts of the yard, inside a large shipping container, behind a locked (Expert) door.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [National Guard Training Yard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71931), Armory — Inside terminal-locked room. Can be opened by hacking or using [National Guard Officer's Password](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71289).

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a cage on the western edge of the [South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933). Hack an Expert-level terminal to gain access.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Worn by Cutty, a raider inside [Poseidon Energy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71893). Destroy or steal their fusion core to take the frame, or just kill Cutty to take the armor pieces from their corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Revere Satellite Array](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72020). A power armor frame can be found inside the north-eastern satellite dish.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860) - inside a locked trailer north-east of the pool. Can be opened with the [Fiddler's Green Trailer Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441217)

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Federal Surveillance Center K-21B](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71877). In the corner of the lowest floor, in a workstation.

Locations.Title: Power Armor x4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Three suits of power armor can be found in and around the [Atom Cats Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71921).

- An empty frame can be found in the corner next to two power armor stations in the garage. Purchase a note from [Rowdy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442663) to own it.
- A helmetless suit with Atom Cats T-60 pieces is a short distance northeast of the garage. 
- One is worn by Duke and cannot be claimed without stealing / destroying his fusion core (or killing him, and taking the pieces)
- One is worn by Johnny D and cannot be claimed without stealing / destroying his fusion core (or killing him, and taking the pieces)

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Worn by Tessa, a named Gunner enemy found in the [Quincy Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71973). Steal or destroy her fusion core to take the frame, or just kill her to take the pieces.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Worn by a Raider patrolling the [Wreck of the USS Riptide](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72062). Destroy or pickpocket their fusion core to take the frame, or just kill the raider to take the pieces.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** In the centre of the [Cave](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71862), next to a radio and corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside the [Massachusetts State House ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71836), worn by a raider near the makeshift elevator on the third floor. Kill them to take the parts, or shoot / steal the fusion core to take the frame as well.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Several suits of power armor can be found aboard [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), with the highest concentration being on the Main Deck.

A full set of T-60 power armor is also given as a reward at the end of [Blind Betrayal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350597).

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** On the elevated freeway above the [Mass Pike Interchange](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71967).

Can be worn by an enemy in the area if you don't kill them quickly.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In front of the [Crashed Vertibird](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440515).

**Does not contain a Fusion Core.**

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the military barge. To access the cage it's in, you'll need to hack a novice-difficulty terminal.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: May only appear after the destruction of [The Institute](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350820)

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Before crossing the bridge to Fort Strong and dealing with the Super Mutants camped out there, you can even the odds with a Power Armor frame by checking the guardpost on the left.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Worn by a Raider patrolling the outside of [Dunwich Borers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71987). Destroy or steal their fusion core to take the full set, or just kill the raider to take the armor pieces from their corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Worn by Boomer, a Raider wielding a Fat Man. Destroy or steal the fusion core before killing Boomer to take the frame, or just kill Boomer and take the armor pieces from his corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Crashed Vertibird Site. May be guarded by hostile robots.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the second level of the bridge, next to the crashed Vertibird. Use the [Freeway Elevator](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441988) to the east to reach the highway, then turn left to find it.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a cage in the abandoned military checkpoint. You'll need to hack into an Advanced-level terminal to access it.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Near the wrecked plane and military vehicles.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a truck near the military vehicles.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Financial District - on Court 35's rooftop. Protected by robots.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Goodneighbour - In a tunnel under Bobbi's house. Found during [The Big Dig](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350822) side quest after using Sonia to blast through some dirt.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Near a half-submerged military vehicle north-west of [Neponset Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71985).

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - worn by Slog, a Raider boss in the blast furnace area. Destroy or steal the fusion core to take the frame, or kill Slog and take the pieces from his corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Quincy Ruins](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72003) - Usually worn by Clint, a Gunner miniboss on the upper level of the elevated freeway. To reach him, climb up to the church roof and use the wooden walkways. Once you're on the freeway, look behind the big red truck to find a sloping ramp up to the upper level.

If you're stealthy, you can get into the armor before Clint does - or will need to pickpocket / destroy his fusion core to claim the armor frame. Naturally, killing him and taking the pieces is also an option.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Inside a blue container with an advanced lock found on the dock.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the road south of the [South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933).

Guarded by a Mr. Gutsy

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the *Mass Bay Medical Center* up an elevator, in the Radiology area.

**Note:** The power armor is not being worn when you first enter the area, but a Gunner Commander is right beside it and will get in it as soon as they spot you or take damage so you have to kill them quick if you want the frame!

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found near a derelict military checkpoint at the end of the road just south of [Natick Banks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72007)

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An Enclave Hellfire Trooper wearing Hellfire Mk. VI power armor can be found here. Destroy or pickpocket their fusion core to steal the armor, or just kill them to take the individual pieces.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A full suit of X-02 Power Armor can be found in the [Utility Tunnel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441189), in the same room where you find [Sgt. Reise's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441190). It can only be accessed by following the "[Speak of the Devil](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441414)" quest, added in the 2024 Next Gen content update, to its very end and interacting with the radio.

Locations.Title: Power Armor x9
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on six Enclave Soldiers wearing the X-02 power armor at the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850), during the 2024 New-Gen Update creation club quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).

After the lockdown is lifted, a Vertibird appears with another soldier wearing X-02 power armor, and two Enclave Hellfire troopers appear outside the offices wearing Hellfire power armor. 

Pickpocketing the fusion cores from any of these power armors allows the player to steal the frames, but this is extremely difficult under the circumstances. It is more practical to simply loot the armor pieces from them after they are killed.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on an Enclave Soldier at the [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453).

*The [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside [New England Technocrat Society](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442260). At the end of the corridor to the right of the stage, input code 4-3-4-6 to enter a room where the power armor can be found to your right.

It's an empty frame save for the De-Capitalist Helmet, which boasts 180 damage resistance, 120 energy resistance, and 150 radiation resistance.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Worn by a Gunner Commander found on top of the freeway near [Hub City Auto Wreckers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71922), but only after killing Captain Bridget and waiting a few days for the area to repopulate. Destroy or steal the fusion core to take the frame, or just kill the gunner and take the armor pieces from their corpse.

*To get on top of the freeway, look for the Hub City Terminal inside a metal trailer - it will give you the option to lower a crane that leads up to the freeway.*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on a Enclave Hellfire Trooper at the [Eastern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401454).

*The [Eastern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401454) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291), a location only accessible after making progress in [Headhunting](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442288). When you reach a room filled with tanks, hug the left wall and hack through a door with an expert-difficulty lock to find it in front of a power armor station.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Worn by Ivey, a Rust Devil boss found deep within the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). Can only be accessed after making progress in the [Headhunting](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442288) quest.

The set she wears includes a Tesla T-60 Torso, Left Arm, and Right Arm, each of which have a unique effect that increases your Energy damage by 5%.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On an Enclave Soldier at the [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455).

*The [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455) appears after picking up a miscellaneous quest from the Enclave CO’s Terminal on the lowest basement level of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) during the 2024 Next-Gen Update quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).*

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Mass Fusion Building](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71831) - worn by a Gunner Commander, found in an office on the fifth floor (the highest floor that's still intact beneath the glass ceiling.)

Destroy / steal the fusion core to take the full suit, or just kill the Gunner to take the armor pieces from their corpse.

Locations.Title: Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A named Raider, 'Pyro', can be found wearing a full suit of Hellfire Power Armor in the camp here. Destroy or steal his fusion core to take the frame, or just kill Pyro to take the pieces.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Gunner T-51 Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Gunners vs Minutemen creation.

Standing in the power armor station inside the garage. Must be repainted with one of the creation's Minutemen paint schemes to progress [War Paint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=520694).

Locations.Title: Raider Power Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - Bottom floor, in the northeast corner in a power armor workstation. 

Part of the [Crucible](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441413) quest, added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Gwinnett Brew Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Beantown Brewery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71895) — In the Foreman's Office, on the corner of the desk.

Note: The crafting recipe is encrypted and can only be used by the [Drinkin' Buddy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401421) bot.

Locations.Title: Gwinnett Lager Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** The Shamrock Taphouse

Note: The crafting recipe is encrypted and can only be used by the [Drinkin' Buddy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401421) bot.

Locations.Title: Gwinnett Stout Recipe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the terminal found in a barred room on the roof of [Gwinnett Brewery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71902). You can open the door by shooting the bar through the window.

Locations.Title: Piezonucleic Power Armor Chest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899). When entering the first lab, C2, [a quest](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443401) to complete the research project will begin. When completed, a unique piece of power armor will be created - the Piezonucleic Power Armor Chest.

To complete the research project you'll need to find samples **611** and **3111** in the lab, use the Isotope Containment Terminal to unlock a room where **U-238** waits on a shelf, then mix them all together using the polymer coating applicator terminal in lab C2.

**Effect:** Radiation exposure increases Action Point refresh speed.

- In the second cryopod room (not where your spouse is held), on a table.

- Reduces damage from humans by 15%. (Chest Piece)
- Increases wearer's movement speed by 10%. (Left Leg)

Locations.Title: Destroyer's Right Leg (Combat Armor)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sold by [Alexis Combes](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443825) in [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065).

**Effect:** Increases wearer's movement speed by 10%.

Locations.Title: Overseer's Left Armguard & Right Armguard (Combat Armor)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Both are sold by [Alexis Combes](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443825) in [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065).

**Effects:**
- 10% reduction in Action Point costs in VATS. (Left Armguard)
- Reduces damage while standing and not moving by 15%. (Right Armguard)

Locations.Title: Doom Marine Armor + Helmet
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Doom Classic Marine Armor creation.

[Dunwich Borers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71987) - In the inventory of Slayer, a unique corpse found directly left of the Station 1 Terminal.

Locations.Title: Morgan's Space Suit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Morgan's Space Suit creation.

[ArcJet Systems](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71887) - Underneath the stairs at the back (eastern) edge of the lobby.

Locations.Title: Ranger Beast Hunter Helmet & Outfit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter DLC.

[Nahant Sewers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510397) - In the inventory of the Beast Hunter.

Locations.Title: Chinese Stealth Suit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Chinese Stealth Armor creation.

[South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933)

**Effect:** Makes the user invisible when crouching

Locations.Title: Commando Chest Piece & Helmet (Combat Armor)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sold by [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) aboard the [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965).

**Effect:**
- Increases Action Point refresh speed. (Chest Piece)
- 10% reduction in Action Point costs in VATS. (Helmet)

Locations.Title: Felt Hat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Worn by Ms. Pennyworth, a Ghoul appears in the ambush when you enter the [New England Technocrat Society](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442260).

**Effect:** Charisma +1

Added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update

Locations.Title: Honor (T-60 Left Leg)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sold by [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) aboard the [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965) after completing [Blind Betrayal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350597).

**Effect:** Bonus to Action Point refresh speed

Locations.Title: Exemplar's T-60c (T-60 Power Armor Chest)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Reward from for completing [Duty or Dishonor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350575) by persuading Clarke to turn himself in.

**Effect:** 10% reduction in Action Point costs in V.A.T.S.

Locations.Title: Tesla Left Arm + Tesla Right Arm + Tesla Torso
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291) - Part of the [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442296) worn by Ivey.

**Effect:** 5% bonus to energy weapon damage

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Vengeance (T-60 Right Leg)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Purchased from [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) aboard [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965) after completing [A New Dawn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350619).

**Effect:** Reflects 10% of melee damage back on attacker.

Locations.Title: Visionary's T-60c Helmet
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Reward for completing [A Loose End](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350579)

**Effect:** Increases Action Point refresh speed.

Locations.Title: Protector's Left Armguard & Right Armguard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Sold by [Arturo Rodriguez](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443631).

**Effects:** Reduces damage from super mutants by 15%

Locations.Title: Father's Lab Coat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Worn by Father, found in The Institute. Can also be found in the Director's room after completing [Nuclear Family](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516510).

**Effect:** Intelligence +2

Locations.Title: Lieutenant's Hat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Reward for completing [Last Voyage of the U.S.S Constitution](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516529) by siding with Ironsides.

**Effect:** Charisma +1

Locations.Title: Legend of Vault 88
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Reward for completing [Lady Luck](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516711)

**Effect:** Reduces damage from Ghouls by15%

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required._

Locations.Title: Lorenzo's Suit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Looted from Lorenzo Cabot if he's killed, during [The Secret of Cabot House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516647) or afterwards.

**Effect:** Charisma +2

Locations.Title: Teagan's Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Pickpocketed from Proctor Teagan in the Prydwen Main Deck armory.

**Effect:** None

Locations.Title: Quinlan's Armor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Pickpocketed from Proctor Quinlan on the Prydwen Main Deck.

**Effect:** None

Locations.Title: Cryolator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Master Locksmith (Level 18, PER 4)

[Vault 111](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72064) — In the armory cage next to the Overseer's desk.

Locations.Title: Justice [Shotgun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Covenant - Sold by [Penny Fitzgerald](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442071).

**Effect:** Chance to stagger on hit.

Locations.Title: Junk Jet
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[ArcJet Systems](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71887), Engine Core — Found in the utility room in the lower level of the ArcJet Engine Core. Available during or after completion of the [Call to Arms](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350479) quest.

**Effect:** Use scrap as projectiles.

Locations.Title: HalluciGen Gas Grenade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[HalluciGen, Inc.](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71839) — Can be built with materials found in the basement laboratory.

**Effect:** Chance to Frenzy targets for 60 seconds.

Locations.Title: Good Intentions [Laser Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Quincy Ruins](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72003) - Equipped by Clint, a Gunner miniboss on the upper level of the elevated freeway. To reach him, climb up to the church roof and use the wooden walkways. Once you're on the freeway, look behind the big red truck to find a sloping ramp up to the upper level.

**Effect:** Critical hits cause target to frenzy.

Locations.Title: Big Boy [Fat Man]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - sold by [Arturo Rodriguez](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443631)

**Effect:** Shoots an additional projectile.

Locations.Title: Old Faithful [Laser Pistol]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - sold by [Arturo Rodriguez](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443631)

**Effect:** Double damage if target is at full health.

Locations.Title: Sentinel's Plasmacaster [Plasma Gun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Sold by [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) after reaching the rank of Sentinel in [A New Dawn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350619).

**Effect:** Double damage if target is at full health.

Locations.Title: Wastelander's Friend
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Bunker Hill - Sold by Deb.

**Effect:** +50% limb damage.

Locations.Title: Le Fusil Terribles [Shotgun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside the Captain's cabin on the upper floor on the tall floating mass  in Libertalia

**Effect:** +25% damage plus limb damage.

Locations.Title: Prototype UP77 "Limitless Potential" [Laser Gun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [University Credit Union](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442665) - enter through the building's side door and hack a novice-difficulty terminal in the basement to gain access to a vault. Here, you'll need to unlock a safe with a master-difficulty lock* to find a button that, when pressed, reveals a secret room with the gun inside.

**Effect:** Infinite clip size.

* Master-level lockpicking is not required. There's an unmarked quest in *Sedgwick Hall* that involves reading a professor's terminal, then checking a student's birthday in the student records mainframe - this gives you the safe's combination.

Locations.Title: Tinker Tom Special [Hunting Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Railroad HQ (Old North Chuch) - Sold by [Tinker Tom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442720).

**Effect:** If not in combat, VATS accuracy is increased at the cost of more AP.

Locations.Title: Reba II [Hunting Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Rook Family House - Kill 3 Mirelurks and then talk to Barney on top of the house. Complete the quest he gives you and you'll receive the Reba 2 as a reward.

**Effect:** +50% damage against Mirelurks and Bugs.

Locations.Title: Alien Blaster
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In a [cave](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441526), to the north of the unmarked UFO crash site that appears east of [Oberland Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72051) after reaching level 20.

Follow a trail of burning trees to find the [downed flying saucer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443418).  Once there, follow the blood splatters north down the hill and into the cave where you'll need to kill the alien for its blaster.

Locations.Title: Virgil's Rifle [Institute Laser Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Rocky Cave - Kill Virgil to get the rifle. Alternatively, steal it.

**Effect:** +50% damage against Super Mutants.

Locations.Title: Vertibird Signal Grenades
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965) - reward for completing the [Show No Mercy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350553) quest, where they will also begin to appear in [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674)'s stock.

Locations.Title: Survivor's Special [Laser Gun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Recon Bunker Theta](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71855), which can only be accessed during [The Lost Patrol](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350565). 

Can be obtained in the following ways:
- Killing Paladin Brandis, and taking it from his corpse
- Pickpocketing it from Brandis with the perk at a high enough level
- Convincing Brandis to re-join the Brotherhood, then meeting him on [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965)

**Effect:** Increased damage at low HP.

Locations.Title: Short Syringer Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Vault 81 - received upon completion of [Hole in the Wall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350472)

Locations.Title: Railway Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Old North Church - received for completing the [Underground Undercover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350810) quest.

Locations.Title: Lorenzo's Artifact [Gamma Gun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Parsons State Insane Asylum

**Prerequisite:** Kill Lorenzo during the side quest "*The Secret of Cabot House*."

**Effect:** Push targets away with telekinesis.

Locations.Title: Kellogg's Pistol
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Loot from Kellogg during [Reunions](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354340).

**Effect:** Critical Hits refill your Action Points.

Locations.Title: Final Judgement [Laser Gatling Gun]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Carried by Elder Maxson, usually found aboard [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965). He cannot be pickpocketed, so it must be taken from his corpse during the Railroad's [Precipice of War](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350811) mission or Minutemen's "Airship Down" mission.

**Effect:** +25% rate of fire & +15% reload speed.

Locations.Title: Experiment 18-A [Plasma Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Sold by the [Synth Requisition Officer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442606) in [The Institute](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442607).

**Effect:** +25% faster fire rate, +15% faster reload.

Locations.Title: Eddie's Peace [.44]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the inventory of Eddie Winter, confronted in [Andrew Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71926) during [Long Time Coming](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351090).

**Effect:** 50% more limb damage.

Locations.Title: Deliverer [10mm]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Old North Church - received for completing the [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802) quest.

**Effect:** Improved VATS hit chance, 25% less Action Point cost

Locations.Title: Death from Above [Missile Launcher]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Sold by Proctor Teagan once you reach the rank of Paladin at the end of [Blind Betrayal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350597).

**Effect:** +75% movement speed while aiming.

Locations.Title: Broadsider
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** USS Constitution - received for completing the side quest "*Last Voyage of the U.S.S. Constitution*."

Locations.Title: Automatic Laser Musket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** The Castle - received from Sturges for completing the Minutemen quest "*The Nuclear Option*."

**Effect:** Automatic fire.

Locations.Title: Artillery Smoke Grenades
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside an ammo box in [The Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72055)'s armory, only accessible after starting [Old Guns](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350711) (a Minutemen quest.) Respawns regularly.

Locations.Title: The Gainer [.44 Pistol]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Behind the puzzle-locked door in the [Pumphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442651). Press the buttons near the door so the code '10-4-5-1' is displayed to get inside.

**Effect:** Set targets on fire for 15 Damage Points.

Locations.Title: Zeta Gun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Parsons State Insane Asylum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71912) - reward for releasing Lorenzo during "*The Secret of Cabot House*" side quest, and taking it from Jack Cabot's corpse. Can also be found in [Cabot House.](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443805)

**Effect:** Area-of-Effect stun on hit

Locations.Title: Overseer's Guardian [Combat Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Sold by [Alexis Combes](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443825) in [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065).

**Effect:** Shoots an additional projectile.

Locations.Title: Tesla Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the inventory of Ivey, a power-armor wearing Rust Devil boss found deep within the [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). Can only be accessed after making progress in the [Headhunting](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442288) quest.

**Effect:** Fires an electrical discharge that arcs between targets.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Salvaged Assaultron Head
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deep inside [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After dealing with Ivey (the Rust Devil boss with the [Tesla Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71806)), you'll enter a small room with three large pipes. At the back of this room, search a steamer trunk to find the weapon inside.

**Effect:** Charged by reloading repeatedly. The more charges, the higher the damage. (Irradiates user.)

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Protectron's Gaze
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** In the inventory of The Mechanist, found at the end of [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059). Can be taken from her corpse, or pickpocketed with the highest level of the perk.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Spray n' Pray
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Purchased from [Cricket](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=400596).  She is a wandering merchant - check for her at or close to the following locations; 
- [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968)  
- [Warwick Homestead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72057)  
- [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065)
- [Bunker Hill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72049)

**Effect:** Bullets explode on impact doing 15 points area effect damage

Locations.Title: Ashmaker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Rewarded or looted from Fahrenheit upon completion of the prerequisite.

**Prerequisite:** Side quest [The Big Dig](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350822).  Speak with Bobbi No-Nose in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063) to begin quest.

**Effect:** Sets target on fire for 15 points of damage

Locations.Title: Righteous Authority [Laser Rifle]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Reward from Paladin Danse after completing [Call to Arms](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350479) (Brotherhood of Steel Quest).

**Effect:** Critical shots do double damage and the critical meter fills 15% faster

Locations.Title: Partystarter
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Available for purchase from [KL-E-0](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443810) in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063)

**Effect:** Does 50% more damage against humans

Locations.Title: The Last Minute
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Purchased from [Ronnie Shaw](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350714) in [The Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72055)  

**Effect:** 50% more limb damage.

Locations.Title: Deliverer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [The Switchboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117211) - given to you by [Deacon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350803) upon completion of the [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802) quest given by the Railroad.

**Effect:** Improved VATS hit chance, 25% less Action Point cost

Locations.Title: Tesla Cannon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Dropped by Caroni, a named Gunner enemy who only appears here after following every step of the 'Best of Three' quest that was added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update. 

The trail starts with the [Gunner Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441405), and will see you visit the [Hopesmarch Pentecostal Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71868) and [Relay Tower 0DB-521](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71997) before finally discovering the [Gunner Signal Remnant Source](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441409) - at which point Caroni will ambush you with the tesla cannon.

*Note: Enclave soldiers at the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850) may also wield tesla cannons.*

Locations.Title: Rapid Pipe Grenade Launcher Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a countertop in the gun shop on the top floor of [Monsignor Plaza](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72019). You may need to progress through the [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415) quest before it will appear.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

**Effect:** 25% faster fire rate, 15% faster reload.

Locations.Title: Piggy Bank Fat Man
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Marvin, found on the rooftop here after finding [Marvin's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442001) during [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Penetrating Chinese Grenade Launcher Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Given by [Suggs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440647) if you fight off the enemies that attack him at the end of [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

**Effect:** Ignores 30% of the target's damage and energy resistance

Locations.Title: Flakker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of [Suggs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440647) if he's killed at the end of [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415). The weapon will **not** be in his inventory if he's killed at any other point.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

**Effect:** 20% chance to cripple the target's leg.

Locations.Title: Baseball Launcher
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of a Marvin's Store Security goon , found attacking [Suggs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440647) in the street after killing Marvin near the end of [When Pigs Fly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441415).

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Zeta Gun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Cabot House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71825) - found on the desk in the lab on the second floor. Can also be taken from Jack Cabot's corpse.

Taking it is considered stealing until starting 'The Secret of Cabot House' side quest.

Locations.Title: Homing Beacon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Not a gun, but a unique weapon that allows you to call in tactical missile. Obtained from Zao after completing Here There Be Monsters.

Locations.Title: Institute Beacon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Not a gun, but a unique weapon used only during the Airship Down mission. Use it to summon synths. the prototype weapon will be removed from inventory after the quest concludes.

Locations.Title: BFG 9000
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Doom BFG creation.

Used by Mercy, a unique Raider found outside the [Cave (Red Rocket Filling Station)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71863).

Locations.Title: Ghoul Slayer's Heavy Incinerator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - Dangling above a vat of lava that you'll need flame-resistant power armor legs to access. Looted as part of [Crucible](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441413).

**Effect:** 50% more damage against Ghouls.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Thunderbolt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Quake Thunderbolt creation.

Held by one of the Raiders that spawns in the crater at the start of [Deathmatch](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510062).

Locations.Title: Judge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter DLC.

[Nahant Sewers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510397) - In the inventory of the Beast Hunter.

Locations.Title: Varmint Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757) - As you enter, use the [Labs Card Level 1](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510756) to unlock a corridor and go down some stairs. Drop through a hole, then look for a black and white umbrella to find it in the arms of a corpse sitting beneath it.

Locations.Title: Lucky Manwell Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:**  Own and install the Manwell Rifle Set creation.

Next to a corpse by the pond, found during [The Quantum Stag](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=512596)

**Effect:** Critical shots do double damage and the critical meter fills 15% faster.

Locations.Title: Hunter's Manwell Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Manwell Rifle Set creation.

In the inventory of a corpse slumped over a desk at the [Junkpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508635).

**Effect:** Does 50% more damage against animals.

Locations.Title: Plasma Offender [Plasma Pistol]
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Revenge of the Van Graffs creation

Inside a safe in [Matt's Workshop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516497). 

**Effect:** Does double damage if the target is at full health.

_Note: This creation is only available on the PC and Xbox versions of the game._

Locations.Title: T60 Pistol
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Brotherhood of Steel T60 Pistol creation.

[Cambridge Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71975) - Behind the reception area opposite the entrance.

Can also be purchased from [Proctor Teagan](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442674) and found near Elder Maxson aboard the Prydwen.

Locations.Title: Bloodied CR-74L
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the CR-74L Combat Rifle creation.

Next to the body of Mary Jane, leaning against a brick wall.

**Effect:** Does more damage the lower your health is. 75% faster movement while aiming.

Locations.Title: Alien Atomizer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Zetan Arsenal creation.

Dropped by an alien fought here during [Over The Moon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543130).

Locations.Title: Alien Disintegrator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Zetan Arsenal creation.

Dropped by an alien fought here during [Over The Moon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543130).

Locations.Title: Silver Submachine Gun Prop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located on the top floor of Hubris Comics, behind the film set. If the prop is given to Kent Connolly in Goodneighbor’s Memory Den, you will receive the unique (but fairly unremarkable) Silver Submachine Gun.

Locations.Title: Reba
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can be pickpocketed from Barney Rook. After completing his miscellaneous quest, he will eventually despawn, so you may wish to steal the gun before that happens.

Locations.Title: Tesla Cannon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on an Enclave Soldier in X-02 power armor on the roof of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850). 

*The Tesla Cannon can also be found on the Gunner boss Caroni at the crash site of [Skylanes Flight 1665](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71949) during the 2024 New-Gen Update Creation Club quest [Best of Three](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441411).*

Locations.Title: Railway Rifle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Next to a sleeping bag and cooler inside the blue train car still attached to a locomotive at [Bedford Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72002).

Appears only at level 20.

*Can occasionally be purchased from [Tinker Tom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442720) at [Railroad HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71969), or looted from Railroad members. The only other fixed location where the rifle can be found is inside the hidden shelter at [Big John's Salvage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71920).*

Locations.Title: Big Jim [Pipe Wrench]

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Inside a coffin found when digging up a grave near a tree at the north-western edge of the [Graveyard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71907). Can only be accessed after reading [Food for the Grasshopper](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442650).

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Dunwich Borers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71987) - underwater at the very bottom of the mine.

Locations.Title: Assaultron Blade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deep inside [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After dealing with Ivey (the Rust Devil boss with the [Tesla Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71806)), you'll enter a small room with some pipes. At the back of this room, search a steamer trunk to find the weapon inside.

It's not a *unique* weapon, but spawn rates are quite low, and it's guaranteed to spawn here.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Mr. Handy's Buzz Blade
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Deep inside [Fort Hagen Hangar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442291). After dealing with Ivey (the Rust Devil boss with the [Tesla Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71806)), you'll enter a small room with some pipes. It's not a *unique* weapon, but spawn rates are quite low, and it's guaranteed to spawn here.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation.

Sword from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.

Part of the [Method to the Madness](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=513712) quest that starts in [Hubris Comics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71840) before taking you into [Shenley's Oyster Bar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353775), where the sword can be found in the diner's restroom after looting the key from the roof.

**Effect:** Damage increased by 15% after each consecutive hit on the same target.

Locations.Title: Zao's Sword
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Can only be obtained from Captain Zao at the end of [Here There Be Monsters](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355599) if you passed three speech checks when talking to him for the first time. After he mentions Saugus Ironworks, choose these options:
- Ask For Money
- More Money
- Even More Money

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** Received for siding with the Deathclaw and returning its egg to a nest found here in [The Devil's Due](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441313).

It's not a *unique* weapon, but spawn rates are quite low, and it's guaranteed here.

Sticking out of a dead Brahmin found here during [Over The Moon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543130).
