- The Minutemen: [Inside Job](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350735)

Locations.Title: When Freedom Calls
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**START OF MINUTEMEN QUESTLINE**

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_A man is protecting a group of people inside the Museum of Freedom in Concord. He pleaded for me to help him fend off their attackers._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 100 Caps
- 50 x Fusion Cells

**Next Quest:** [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647)

Locations.Title: The First Step
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_Preston Garvey has asked me to travel to a nearby settlement that's requested help from the Minutemen. I should go there as soon as possible and see what I can do to help them._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps
- Minutemen Rank: General

**Next Quest:** [Taking Independence](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350699)

Locations.Title: Taking Independence
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647)

Requires at least four settlements be recruited to the Minutemen cause via the radiant quests [Taking Point](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350689) or the recruitment side quests [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647), [Out of the Fire](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350754), [Returning the Favor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350759), and [Troubled Waters](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350767).

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_Preston Garvey thinks it's time for the Minutemen to retake "The Castle", an old fort that used to be their main base of operations._

**Rewards:**
- 350 XP
- Settlement: [The Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72055)

**Next Quest:** [Old Guns](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350711)

Locations.Title: Old Guns
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Taking Independence](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350699) + Wait 3 Days

**Quest Giver:** Ronnie Shaw

_Someone named Ronnie Shaw has arrived at the Castle looking for me. I should find out what she wants._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Artillery Schematic (Settlement Crafting)
- Artillery Smoke Grenade
- Trader: [Ronnie Shaw](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350714)
- [Minutemen General's Uniform](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350717) (Unique Apparel)

**Next Quest:** [Inside Job](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350735)

Locations.Title: With Our Powers Combined
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**WARNING: Completing this quest is a point of no return for faction allegiances!**

**Previous Quest:** [The Nuclear Option (Minutemen)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350738)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_It's time for the Minutemen to remove the Brotherhood of Steel as a threat to the Commonwealth._

Note: If you'd like the Minutemen to be the **last faction standing**, start this quest **after** siding with the Brotherhood of Steel to neutralize the Railroad and Institute. Complete [The Nuclear Option (Brotherhood of Steel)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350618), then return to Preston Garvey to begin this quest.

**Reward:** 350 XP

Locations.Title: Inside Job
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:**
- [The Molecular Level](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354345) (Main Quest)
- [Old Guns](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350711) (Minutemen)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey or Sturges

_Sturges gave me a holotape that will scan the Institute's computer network for useful data. All I need to do is run it on any Institute terminal, and then return it to Sturges for analysis._

**Reward:** 300 XP

**Next Quest:** [Defend the Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350737)

Locations.Title: Form Ranks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Inside Job](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350735)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_The Minutemen are not strong enough yet to take on the Institute. I should work on building up support across the Commonwealth._

**Reward:** 350 XP

**Next Quest:** [Defend the Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350737)

Locations.Title: Defend the Castle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Inside Job](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350735)

Requires at least eight settlements be recruited to the Minutemen cause via the radiant quests [Taking Point](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350689) or the recruitment side quests [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647), [Out of the Fire](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350754), [Returning the Favor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350759), and [Troubled Waters](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350767).

If you do not have enough settlements, then [Form Ranks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350736) will start instead.

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_The Institute is preparing to attack the Castle to try to crush the Minutemen before we can build up enough strength to strike them. I need to help defend the Castle before it's too late._

**Reward:** 300 XP

**Next Quest:** [The Nuclear Option (Minutemen)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350738)

Locations.Title: The Nuclear Option (Minutemen)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**WARNING: Completing this quest is a point of no return for faction allegiances!**

**Previous Quest:** [Defend the Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350737)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey

_Sturges analyzed the data from the Institute network and found a way in: an old tunnel providing cooling water to their reactor. He gave me a holotape that will reprogram the Institute Relay to bring in the Minutemen._

**Rewards:**
- 1500 XP
- Automatic Laser Musket

**Next Quest:** [With Our Powers Combined](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350731)

Locations.Title: All Aboard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**START OF NUKA-WORLD (DLC) QUESTLINE**

**Quest Giver:** Listen to Nuka-World Family Radio (appears after Level 30), or discover [Nuka-World Transit Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117903)

_I tuned into an old Nuka-Cola family radio station on my Pip-Boy. It was looping a jingle and advertisement for a place called Nuka-World. The broadcast mentioned a Nuka-World Transit Center with transportation to take me there. I should find it and see if I can still reach the amusement park._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- Access to [Nuka-World](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world)

Locations.Title: Signed Baseball Card
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the cooler in the same hut as the *Unstoppables* comic.

**Related Quest:** [Out in Left Field](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516642)

Locations.Title: Signed Baseball
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the novice locked safe on the second floor of the flooded house.

**Related Quest:** [Out in Left Field](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516642)

Locations.Title: Signed Catcher's Mitt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the toolbox in the garage beside the house.

**Related Quest:** [Out in Left Field](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516642)

Locations.Title: Experimental Serum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On a countertop in the lab. Required as part of _Virgil's Cure._

Locations.Title: Knight Rylan's Holotag
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on the body of Knight Rylan in the Boston Airport Ruins. The holotag can be shown to Initiate Clarke as proof that the feral ghouls are dangerous.

**Related Quest:** [Duty or Dishonor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350575)

Locations.Title: Pristine Deathclaw Egg
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found beside the body of Sergeant Lee on the main floor of the Museum of Witchcraft. 

**Related Quest:** [The Devil's Due](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441313)

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Control Board
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Carried by Security Chief Andersen, who has turned into a feral ghoul in [Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=79965). You can find him in the control room, to your left if you are facing the main [Vault Tech (Workbench)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=461447). 

**Related Quest:** [Better Living Underground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516705)

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Control Board: North Sector
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unlocks workshop access in the North Sector of [Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=79965). It can be found by entering the North Sector and making your way to the ruined subway area. There you will find it against the wall of the platform with the manhole exit for Vault 88 by [Milton General Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71909).

**Related Quest:** [Explore Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516707)

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Control Board: North-East Sector
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Used to unlock workshop access in the North-East Sector of [Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=79965). It can be found by entering the North-East Sector and making your way to what are the sub-levels of the [University Point Pharmacy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=156182). There you will find it on a shelf in the lowest part of the Pharmacy's sublevels before you enter the cavernous area of North-East Sector.

**Related Quest:** [Explore Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516707)

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Vault-Tec Control Board: East Sector
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Used to unlock workshop access in the North Sector of Vault 88. It can be found by entering the East Sector and heading straight to the end of the tunnel; to your right there is a path to into a cavern, beside it is shelving with the control board.

**Related Quest:** [Explore Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516707)

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Locket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The locket belonged to Mary Abernathy, who was killed in a raider attack. Her father, Blake Abernathy at [Abernathy Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72033), asks you to retrieve it during the side quest [Returning the Favor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350759), which unlocks the farm as a settlement. 

The locket is found deep inside [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021), in a toolbox beside a novice-locked double door with a screwdriver jammed into the keyhole.

Locations.Title: Cleansing the Commonwealth
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Brotherhood of Steel

**Available After:** [Semper Invincta](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350509)

**Quest Giver:** Knight Rhys

_Knight Rhys has given me an assignment to clear a location of what he calls "abominations." I need to find the location and eliminate any synths, Ferals, Super Mutants, and Atom worshipping cultists that I can find._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps

Locations.Title: Quartermastery
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Brotherhood of Steel

**Available After:** [Semper Invincta](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350509)

**Quest Giver:** Scribe Hayden

_Scribe Haylen has given me a mission to recover a piece of technology for her at a given location. I need to go there, find the artifact, and bring it back to her in one piece._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps

Locations.Title: Taking Point
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Minutemen

**Available After:** [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey or Settler

This is a catch-all map marker for all radiant quests related to the Minutemen recruiting new settlements or aiding existing settlers. All of these quests will have formulaic titles. For example, "(Resource) for (Location)" could appear as "Power for Ten Pines" in-game.
- (Resource) for (Location)
- Clearing the Way for (Location)
- Defend (Location)
- Suspected Synth at (Location)
- Taking Point: (Location)
- etc. etc.

**Tip:** There is a no-mod method to stopping these quests. Complete a radiant quests up to the final step "Talk to Preston Garvey". Then, as you're talking to Preston, walk away mid-dialogue before he mentions another settlement needs help. The timing can be tricky, but it works. 

**Rewards:**
- Approx. 50-200 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps

Locations.Title: Feeding the Troops
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Brotherhood of Steel

**Available After:** [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546)

**Quest Giver:** Proctor Teagan

_Proctor Teagan has asked me to pay a visit to a Commonwealth farm and secure their crops for the Brotherhood. I've been told to "persuade" them by any means necessary._

**Reward:** 100 XP

Locations.Title: Leading by Example
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Brotherhood of Steel

**Available After:** [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546)

**Quest Giver:** Lancer Captain Kells

_I spoke to Lancer Captain Kells and agreed to train one of the Brotherhood Squires by allowing him to accompany me on a mission. I was told to meet the Squire in the airport where he'll give me further details on the mission location._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps

Locations.Title: Learning Curve
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Brotherhood of Steel

**Available After:** [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546)

**Quest Giver:** Proctor Quinlan

_I spoke to Proctor Quinlan and agreed to escort a Brotherhood Scribe on a research patrol. I was told to meet the Scribe at the airport where he'll give me further details on the mission location._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Approx. 100 Caps

Locations.Title: A Clean Equation
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** The Railroad

**Available After:** [The Nuclear Option (Railroad)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350817)

**Quest Giver:** P.A.M.

_Even with the Prydwen destroyed, Brotherhood stragglers are a threat to the Railroad. PAM has spotted a surviving patrol. It's my job to deal with them._

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP
- 130 Caps

Locations.Title: Randolph Safehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Railroad

**Available After:** May only begin if you have no other Railroad quests active

**Quest Giver:** Drummer Boy

_Randolph Safehouse has been dark since Switchboard fell. Drummer Boy says the safehouse has left a message at a dead drop. I've been tapped to intercept it._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- Institute Killer Weave armor mod (after completing the quest 6 times)

Locations.Title: To the Mattressess
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Railroad

**Available After:** Complete [The Nuclear Option (Railroad)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350817)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_The Synth-hating L&L Gang is the greatest single threat remaining to the Railroad with the Institute out of the picture. Desdemona has a lead on them. And my job is dealing with it._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Jackpot
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** Railroad

**Available After:** [Mercer Safehouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350817)

**Quest Giver:** P.A.M

A set of three Railroad radiant quests where P.A.M. sends you to open hidden DIA caches using an RFID device; the locations are the [Ruined Skyscraper](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442236),  [Medford Memorial Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71910), and [Hub 360](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442235), though the order is random. After completing the first quest you should talk to Tinker Tom before leaving Railroad HQ to unlock Ballistic Weave (which can otherwise be missed) and gain access to Deliverer mods, with additional rewards granted after finishing the third quest.

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- New Items for sale from Tinker Tom

Locations.Title: Appropriation
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Faction:** The Institute

**Available After:** [Synth Retention](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516502)

**Quest Giver:** Evan Watson

_In an effort to learn more about their technology, Dr.Watson has askeed me to obtain blueprints from the Brotherhood of Steel._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Fusion Cells

Locations.Title: Road to Freedom
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**START OF RAILROAD QUESTLINE**

**Quest Giver:**
- Listen to "Join the Railroad" Holotape
- Follow the Freedom Trail (Miscellaneous Objective)

_If I want to fight the Institute, I've been told I should find the Railroad. The only clue I have is: "Follow the Freedom Trail." The tourist trail starts at Boston Common._

**Reward:** 300 XP

**Next Quest:** [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802)

Locations.Title: Tradecraft
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Road to Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350798)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_Deacon wants to help me join the Railroad. In order to join, I have to help him on a mission. He said he'd meet me by the old freeway outside Lexington._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [Deliverer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71793) (Unique Gun)
- Railroad Rank: Member
- Companion: [Deacon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350803)

**Next Quest:** [Underground Undercover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350810)

Locations.Title: Underground Undercover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:**
- [Institutionalized](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354346) (Main Quest)
- [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802) (Railroad)

Warning: The Railroad finale is a back-to-back sequence of quests, starting with this one and leading up to [The Nuclear Option (Railroad)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350817). If you continue with this quest, make sure you're properly armed and decided to side with the Railroad.

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_Desdemona gave me an encoded holotape that I can use at any Institute terminal to make contact with the Railroad's guardian angel, Patriot. Perhaps with him (or her) we can devise a way to rescue many synths._

**Rewards:**
- 600 XP
- 500 Caps
- Railway Rifle
- Railway Spikes

**Next Quest:** [Precipice of War](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350811)

Locations.Title: Precipice of War
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Underground Undercover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350810)

**Quest Giver:** Z1-14

_There's only one way out of the HQ—straight through the catacombs and everything the Brotherhood brought to wipe us out. I'm the Railroad's only hope._

**Reward:** 500 XP

**Next Quest:** [Rockets' Red Glare](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350815)

Locations.Title: Rockets' Red Glare
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Precipice of War](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350811)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_We actually made it aboard the Prydwen. Now it's my job to place explosive charges on the Prydwen's gas bags. After that, I need to get back to our stolen vertibird and fly to a safe distance so we can remotely detonate it._

**Reward:** 500 XP

**Next Quest:** [The Nuclear Option (Railroad)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350817)

Locations.Title: The Nuclear Option (Railroad)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous Quest:** [Rockets' Red Glare](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350815)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_It's time to finally put the Railroad's plan into action. I need to find Z1-14 in the Institute and let him know we're ready._

**Reward:** 1500 XP

Locations.Title: Kid in a Fridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Billy, after you shoot the fridge door

_I found a ghoul child locked in an abandoned refrigerator on the side of the road._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: The Combat Zone
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Automatically starts after entering [Combat Zone](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72015)

_Eliminate the Raiders at the Combat Zone, then talk to Tommy about Cait's contract._

**Rewards:**
- 100 Caps
- Companion Unlocked: Cait

Locations.Title: Hole in the Wall
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** After completing [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350473), either leave the Vault for 24 hours or complete [Here Kitty, Kitty](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355593)

**Quest Giver:** Dr. Priscilla Penske (located in Clinic)

_Austin was bitten by a diseased mole rat. I'm going to the newly discovered secret part of the vault to look for a cure._

**Rewards:**
- 250 XP
- [Short Syringer Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71784)
- [Curie (Companion)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350475)
- Vault 81 Room

Locations.Title: Vault 81
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Overseer McNamara after attempting to get inside [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065)

_I discovered a potentially functional Vault called Vault 81. Their Overseer offered a tradeoff: I can enter the Vault if I bring them Fusion Cores._

**Note:** You can skip the fusion core trade by pointing out that you're a fellow vault dweller and  passing a speech check.

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP
- Vault 81 Access

Locations.Title: Dependency
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [Hole in the Wall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350472)

**Quest Giver:** Tina De Luca

_Tina asked me to try to get Bobby off the Jet. After what happened with Austin, he needs to quit before someone else gets hurt. She said Rachel has treatment drugs that can help him._

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP

Locations.Title: The Lost Patrol
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Started automatically when entering this area, but can also be started by following the Distress Signal beaming from [Relay Tower OMC-810](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71992), or speaking to Paladin Danse / Lance Captain Wells after [Call to Arms](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350479)

_In a ruin near Malden, I found the remains of a group of soldiers that were ambushed and nearly wiped out. If I follow their trail, I may be able to learn what happened to them._

Find all Recon Team's Holotapes:
- [Knight Varham's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=400593)
- [Knight Astlin's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71288)
- [Scribe Faris' Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=400594)

**Rewards:**
- 350 XP
- Steadfast BOS Combat Armor Chest Piece (Unique Armor)
- [Survivor's Special [Laser Gun]](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71783)

Locations.Title: Duty or Dishonor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [Show No Mercy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350553) (Brotherhood of Steel)

**Quest Giver:** Lancer Captain Kells

_Captain Kells ordered me to investigate some missing supplies at the airport. I should report to Knight Sergeant Gavil for more information._

**Rewards:** Depends on quest outcome. If you convince the traitor to turn themselves in, you'll receive Exemplar's T-60C (Unique Power Armor).

Locations.Title: A Loose End
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:**
- Virgil is still alive
- Complete [Liberty Reprimed](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350589) (Brotherhood of Steel)

**Quest Giver:** Lancer Captain Kells

_Captain Kells ordered me to kill Virgil, but Virgil says he poses no threat to the Brotherhood. Should I complete my original mission or protect Virgil and lie to Captain Kells?_

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Visionary's T-60C Helmet (Power Armor Part)

Locations.Title: Order Up
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** [Wolfgang](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350625) or [Trudy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350624); Walk near diner

_Wolfgang over at the Drumlin Diner says Trudy owes him money she won't pay. He's offering me a reward if I resolve their disagreement._

Whoever remains at the end of the quest becomes a trader at Drumlin Diner. Wolfgang sells chems; Trudy is a general store.

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Sanctuary
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644)

**Quest Giver:** Sturges 

_I've agreed to help the people in Sanctuary establish a permanent settlement._

**Reward:** 150 XP

Locations.Title: The Sight
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:**  Complete [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644)

**Quest Giver:** Mama Murphy

_Mama Murphy claims to have the Sight—visions of future. All she needs are chems. (And a comfortable chair.)_

**Reward:** 
- Mama Murphy's visions of the future

Locations.Title: Out of the Fire
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647) (Minutemen)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey, Abraham Finch, Jake Finch, or [Jake's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71292)

_Abraham Finch has asked me to retrieve his grandad's sword from The Forged who have taken over Saugus Ironworks. I should also keep an eye out for Jake Finch, to see if I can bring him back to the farm._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 250 Caps (350 Caps if Jake is saved)
- [Shishkebab](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71767) (Unique Melee)
- Settlement: [Finch Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72042)

Locations.Title: Returning the Favor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Blake Abernathy

_Blake Abernathy asked me to retrieve his late daughter's locket from the Raiders that murdered her. He believes I'll find them at USAF Satellite Station Olivia._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 100 Caps
- Settlement: [Abernathy Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440501)

Locations.Title: Troubled Waters
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [The First Step](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350647) (Minutemen)

**Quest Giver:** Preston Garvey or Supervisor White

_Weston Water Treatment Plant has been flooded. If I want to restore the water supply to Graygarden, I'll have to get it up and running again._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- 100 Caps
- Settlement: [Graygarden](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72050)
- Trader Discount: Supervisor Greene

Locations.Title: The Big Dig
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Bobbi No-Nose

_I met Bobbi No-Nose in an alley in Goodneighbor and agreed to work for her. She asked me to work on digging a tunnel in her basement._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [Ashmaker](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=76797) (Unique Gun)
- Side with Bobbi — 300 Caps
- Side with Hancock — Companion: [John Hancock](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350821)

Locations.Title: Recruiting Hancock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Only available if you sided with Bobbi No-Nose at the end of [The Big Dig](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350822), but still want to recruit [John Hancock](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350821) as a companion

**Quest Giver:** John Hancock

_Hancock confronts the Sole Survivor about the death of Fahrenheit, his friend and bodyguard. Someone needs to pay—literally._

**Rewards:**
- Up to 450 Caps
- Companion: [John Hancock](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350821)

Locations.Title: Story of the Century
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Piper Wright, inside Publick Occurrences

_Piper, a reporter in Diamond City, wants to interview me for her newspaper._

**Rewards:**
- 150 XP
- Companion: [Piper Wright](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351087)

Locations.Title: Curtain Call
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Trinity Tower Radio

_I heard a radio broadcast by a man named Rex. He was begging to be rescued from super mutants who have taken him captive in Trinity Tower._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- Companion: [Strong](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351091)
- [Reginald's Suit / Agatha's Dress](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353764)

Locations.Title: Boston After Dark
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Tradecraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350802) and join the Railroad

**Quest Giver:** Stanley Carrington

_My first official assignment in the Railroad is to deliver Doctor Carrington the prototype we recovered from Switchboard. And then see if he needs any help._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- Approx. 180 Caps

Locations.Title: Mercer Safehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Boston After Dark](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354348)

**Quest Giver:** Predictive Analytic Machine (Railroad HQ)

_PAM's found a suitable location for a new safehouse. She wants me to secure the site and fortify it._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 200 Caps

Locations.Title: Burning Cover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Only available if you failed during [Underground Undercover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350810) and became an enemy of the Institute

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_My cover with The Institute has been blown. I need to report back to Desdemona and see how we can proceed._

**Reward:** 75 XP

Locations.Title: Butcher's Bill
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Boston After Dark](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354348)

**Quest Giver:** Doctor Carrington

_Since the fall of Switchboard, the Railroad's been picking up the pieces. Carrington is sending me to check the status of Augusta Safehouse. The details will be at another dead drop._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 150 Caps

Locations.Title: Butcher's Bill 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Butcher's Bill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354351)

**Quest Giver:** Doctor Carrington

_Potentially a survivor made it out of the Augusta Safehouse disaster. His name is Blackbird and he was spotted recently. I've been asked to gather more details at a dead drop and rescue him._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 175 Caps

Locations.Title: Memory Interrupted
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Boston After Dark](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354348)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_There's a Synth stranded at the Memory Den. His escape route out of there has been compromised. I need to go to Doctor Amari and tell her I've been sent to clear a path._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 200 Caps
- 2 x Railroad Stealth Boy

Locations.Title: Operation Ticonderoga
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Boston After Dark](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354348)

**Quest Giver:** Desdemona

_Coursers have been spotted in the field, which means trouble. Desdemona has asked me to check on Ticonderoga Safehouse, which has gone dark. Hopefully the Institute hasn't found them._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- 500 Caps

Locations.Title: Short Stories
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350473)

**Quest Giver:** Katy Pinn (Vault 81 Classroom, Teacher)

_The teacher at Vault 81, Miss Katy Pinn, has asked me to speak to her class about my adventures in the Commonwealth. I should let her know when I'm ready once her class is in session._

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP
- [Grognak the Barbarian](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71355)

Locations.Title: Here Kitty, Kitty
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350473)

**Quest Giver:** Erin Combes, or ask Horatio about Vault 81 rumors

_Erin Combes' cat, Ashes, has escaped Vault 81 and is now loose in the Commonwealth. She's asked me to find him and bring him home safely before something happens to him._

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP
- Player Choice: fusion core, kickball, silver locket, or teddy bear

Locations.Title: Pull the Plug
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Sully Mathis

_Sully asked me to help repair the leaky pipes so he can get the pump running again._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- 50 - 125 caps

Locations.Title: Here There Be Monsters
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Donny Kowalski

_I met a boy named Donny on the docks. He claims he saw a sea monster in the bay._

**Rewards:**
- 200+ XP
- Three homing beacons
- 4 Pre-War Money if you negotiate through a speech check when meeting Zao for the first time
- 200 Caps if you negotiate through two speech checks when meeting Zao for the first time
- [Zao's Sword](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442250) if you negotiate through three speech checks when meeting Zao for the first time

Locations.Title: Vault 81 Tour
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350473)

**Quest Giver:** Austin

_For five bottle caps, Austin will give the Sole Survivor a tour of Vault 81._

**Rewards:**
- 75 XP

Locations.Title: Galleria
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Greeter Robot

_The General Atomics Galleria is a one-stop shopping destination to showcase the technological developments of General Atomics. This Galleria location is under strict Mr. Gutsy control until it receives orders to reopen._

Note: You will need the [General Atomics ID Card](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401375) from General Atomics Factory to successfully impersonate the General Atomics Director. When the park reopens, items can be taken without stealing and robot personalities are reset.

**Rewards:**
- Gold Watch
- 15 x Pre-War Money
- General Atomics Galleria Reopens

Locations.Title: Trouble Brewin'
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** [Rufus Rubins](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443812) in the Hotel Rexford, or Drinkin' Buddy in [The Shamrock Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71834).

_Rufus Rubins wants to replace the usual barman's swill with something better. Fortunately, Shamrock Taphouse is home to a microbrewing protectron called Drinkin' Buddy. Bring the machine to Rufus to install a new barkeeper at Hotel Rexford._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- 200-400 Caps

Locations.Title: The Devil's Due
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Started when you pick up [Private Hart's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441312) outside the [Museum of Witchcraft](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71961)

_I found a holotape on a mutilated body. Wonder what it says..._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- 200 / 300 / 400 / 500 caps + Wellingham's Recipe (if you sell the egg to Wellingham)
- [Deathclaw Gauntlet](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71794) (if you return the egg to the Deathclaw)

Locations.Title: Best of Three
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Begins when you listen to the Vault-Tec Distress Signal.

_I've received a Vault-Tec Distress Signal on my Pip-Boy. Listening to it will reveal more._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [Tesla Cannon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441410)

Locations.Title: All Hallows' Eve
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Begins when you tune in to the Mysterious Signal that can be picked up around this area.

_I've picked up an interesting signal on the Pip-Boy. I should listen to it and see what it is._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442267) with De-Capitalist Helmet
- Random legendary weapon from [Mr. Wendt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442262)

Locations.Title: Crucible
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N/A - Starts inside [Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) after you kill a Forged Keeper enemy.

_While investigating the Saugus Ironworks I encountered a gang of raiders called the Forged. Apparently they've set up a trial to find someone worthy of a powerful weapon. I found a note on one of the Forged that may offer a clue on how to retrieve it._

**Rewards:**
- [Ghoul Slayer's Heavy Incinerator](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508925)

Locations.Title: Speak of the Devil
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Starts when you read [Connie's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442030).

_I've found a note that implies a pair of settlers are trying to use patriotic music to lure a hero out of hiding. I should head over to the [0MC-810 Relay Tower](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71992) and investigate._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [X-02 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441192)

Locations.Title: When Pigs Fly
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when approaching [Suggs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440647).

_In the run-up to the war, the militaries for both the United States and the Chinese developed several powerful infantry weapons, including grenade launchers. It's possible some of those weapons survived today. I should visit a local supplier and see what I can find._

**Rewards:**
- 200 XP
- [Piggy Bank Fat Man](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442015)
- [Flakker](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442021) (if Suggs is killed)
- [Penetrating Chinese Grenade Launcher Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442019) (if Suggs is saved)
- [Piggy Bank Mines](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606632) Crafting Recipe
- [Piggy Bank Launcher Bombs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606633) Crafting Recipe

Locations.Title: Pyromaniac
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you enter the area.

_A murderous member of The Forged has been terrorizing the Commonwealth in a suit of Enclave Hellfire Power Armor. I need to find them and take them down._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=461452)

Locations.Title: Echoes of the Past
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when entering the area for the first time.

_I've heard that a Brahmin Caravan has gone missing close to [Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885). I should try and find out what happened to it._

**Rewards:**
- 300 XP
- [Colonel Uniform](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441423)
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441422)
- [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453), [Eastern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401454), and [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455) added to the map

Locations.Title: Special Delivery
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Given by Edward Deegan who can appear at [Bunker Hill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72049), [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929)'s Dugout Inn, or [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063)'s Third Rail. May also be started by visiting [Cabot House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71825) and succeeding a skill check.

_I was offered a job from a ghoul named Edward Deegan. If I'm interested, I need to travel to [Cabot House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71825) in downtown Boston and talk to someone named Jack Cabot._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: The Gilded Grasshopper
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Started when picking up the Gilded Grasshopper found on top of [Faneuil Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71848), or when picking up Marty Bullfinch's holotape in [Valentine's Detective Agency](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71963).

_I recovered an old note from inside the Gilded Grasshopper - "Food for the Grasshopper." I wonder what it says..._

**Rewards:**
- 400 XP
- [Shem Drowne's Sword](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71802)

Locations.Title: Cambridge Polymer Labs
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Started when you enter the clean room in [Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899).

**Rewards:**
- [Piezonucleic Power Armor Chest](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71721)

Locations.Title: Painting the Town
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Abbot, found painting the wall at the northern edge of [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929)

_Abbot in Diamond City wants me to find paint for the city's Wall. There's a place call [Hardware Town](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72016) where I can start looking._

**Rewards:**
- 150 XP
- 100 caps (if you paint the wall blue or yellow)
- 200 caps (if you paint the wall green)

*And if you succeed a few speech checks at the start of the quest...*
- 125 caps (ask for money & paint the wall blue or yellow)
- 150 caps (ask for more money & paint the wall blue or yellow)
- 200 caps (ask for even more money & paint the wall blue or yellow)
- 225 caps (ask for money & paint the wall green)
- 250 caps (ask for more money & paint the wall green)
- 300 caps (ask for even more money & paint the wall green)

Locations.Title: The Memory Den
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Can only be started **before** rescuing Nick Valentine from [Park Street Station (Vault 114)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71924).

**Quest Giver:** Irma, found inside The Memory Den building in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063). Pay her 100 caps or pass a speech check.

_Irma at the Memory Den says I can relive my past if I sit down in one of the den's Memory Loungers._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Begins [Jewel of the Commonwealth](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354337) if the quest has not been started already

Locations.Title: Mechanical Menace
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Mechanical Menace is the first mission in the Fallout 4 Automatron DLC. It pits the player against a cadre of robots attacking a caravan. To initiate this mission, tune your radio to the Caravan Distress Frequency on your Pip Boy.

Locations.Title: The Disappearing Act
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Unlikely Valentine](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354338)

**Quest Giver:** Ellie, after picking up the [Earl Sterling Case File](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=445480) in [Valentine's Detective Agency](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71963)

_I've offered to help Nick and Ellie find out what happened to Earl Sterling, a bartender at The Dugout Inn. I need to find a way into Earl's home, see if I can turn up any clues to his whereabouts..._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Way Back Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the CR-74L Combat Rifle creation.

**Quest Giver:** [Commonwealth Travel Guide](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543115) in Mary Jane's inventory

_The area near Sanctuary is known to be a hunting ground for feral dogs. I should check the surrounding woods and make sure it's safe._

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: Deathmatch
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Quake Thunderbolt creation.

**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you loot a trunk in the middle of the [Cambridge Crater](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72011)

_Three figures have relayed into the center of the crater, and have begun fighting each other and me._

**Rewards:**
- [Thunderbolt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510063)

Locations.Title: Dog Rescue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install any of the dog breed creations.

**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you approach any of the dogs.

_I've found the location of a stray dog. I should see if I can find it and give it a new home._

**Dogs:**
- [Golden Retriever](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510196#L)
- [Shiba Inu](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510236#L)
- [Border Collie](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510596#L)
- [Boxer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515853#L)
- [Great Dane](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515334#L)
- [Dalmatian](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515856#L)
- [Black Labrador](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515859#L)
- [Chocolate Labrador](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515860#L)
- [Husky](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515857#L)
- [Pitbull](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515855#L)
- [Rottweiler](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515854#L)
- [Yellow Labrador](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=515858#L)

**Rewards:**
- Dog is sent to guard a settlement of your choice

Locations.Title: Home Away from Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation.

**Quest Giver:** N/A - Automatically begins when approaching the [Nahant Sheriff's Department](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71971)

_I picked up a distress signal in Morse code, I'd better go see what it is._

**Rewards:**
- [Beast Hunter's Hideout Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510414)

Locations.Title: Legendary Hunt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation

**Quest Giver:** Begins when you pick up the [Beast Hunter's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510418)

_I've found a map marking a location of interest. I wonder if there's anything worth finding there, as it seemed to interest the Beast Hunter._

**Rewards:**
- Random legendary loot from the [Legendary Mythical Deathclaw](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510420)
- Bandolier mod for the Ranger Beast Hunter outfit

Locations.Title: Captain Cosmos
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Captain Cosmos creation

**Quest Giver:** [Hubris Delivery Points](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510899)

_??_

**Rewards:**
- ??

Locations.Title: Malevolent Malfunction
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Sentinel Control System Companion creation.

**Quest Giver:** Begins when picking up the [Sentinel System Log](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=511195)

_I've discovered a system log on one of the Sentinel Power Armors. It seems like a Brotherhood soldier named Dawson reprogrammed the Sentinels to attack his unit. According to the log, he fled to a nearby propane station. I should check it out._

**Rewards:**
- Sentinel Control System Companion

Locations.Title: The Quantum Stag
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Manwell Rifle Set creation.

**Quest Giver:** Note inside the [Destroyed House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=455012)

_West of Outpost Zimonja I found a note left by a hunter. Evidently he and his son were hunting a Quantum Radstag at a nearby pond._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Random Legendary Loot (if the Quantum Stag is killed)
- Quantum Stag as a settler (if it's spared)

Locations.Title: Method to the Madness
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation.

**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you pick up the [Director's Notes](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=513711) holotape.

_In Pre-War times, I recall hearing a news story about an actor who nearly killed someone on the set of Hubris Comics. Perhaps he left something behind that may be of some use._

**Rewards:**
- [Steel Sword](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353778)
- [Iron Helmet](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353776)

Locations.Title: Run To The Hills
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Revenge of the Van Graffs creation

**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you reach Level 15.

_The sender of the signal is already dead. He has a note beside his hand. I should take a look._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Plasma Offender [Plasma Pistol]](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516499)

_Note: This creation is only available on the PC and Xbox versions of the game._

Locations.Title: A House Divided
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Nuclear Family](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516510)

**Quest Giver:** Newton Oberly

_Something is going on in BioScience, and Dr. Oberly needs to speak to me about it right away._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Chems

Locations.Title: Building a Better Crop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Institutionalized](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354346)

**Quest Giver:** Isaac Karlin

_I've been asked to deliver genetically-modified seeds to the Roger Warwick synth at Warwick Homestead. I've been given a code phrase to identify myself as an agent of the Institute._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- Stimpaks
- [Warwick Homestead Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441392)

Locations.Title: Plugging a Leak
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Mankind - Redefined](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516504)

**Quest Giver:** Justin Ayo

_Dr. Ayo of the SRB suspects that Dr. Binet is helping synths escape the Institute. I should investigate the terminals in Robotics for clues._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- 1000 Caps (if you take Justin's side)
- Liam's Glasses (if you take Liam's side)

Locations.Title: Confidence Man
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to Travis at Diamond City Radio

**Quest Giver:** Vadim Bobrov

_The owner of the Dugout Inn has asked me to help him improve the confidence of Diamond City Radio's DJ, Travis Miles._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- Travis acts more confident in his broadcasts

Locations.Title: Diamond City Blues
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Witness a fight at the [Colonial Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443643)

**Quest Giver:** Paul Pembroke

_Paul Pembroke has asked me to help get Henry Cooke to stop seeing his wife Darcy._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Chems
- Caps

Locations.Title: Emogene Takes a Lover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Special Delivery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442643)

**Quest Giver:** Edward Deegan

_I should talk to Edward Deegan about my next mission._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Human Error
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Honest Dan

_Honest Dan's been hired to find Stockton's missing caravan. He wants me to investigate Covenant looking for clues. He knows the little settlement's involved._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Covenant Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442069)

Locations.Title: In Sheep's Clothing
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Be banished from the Institute

**Quest Giver:** Danny Sullivan

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: Last Voyage of the U.S.S Constitution
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Lookout

_The captain of the USS Constitution, Ironsides, has ordered me to assist in repairing his vessel. I'm to report to Mr. Navigator and Bosun for details._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Broadsider](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71796) + [Lieutenant's Hat](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516530) (if you help Ironsides)

Locations.Title: Mystery Meat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Listen to the argument between Theodore Collins and Trader Rylee

**Quest Giver:** Theodore Collins

_After hearing that people have been getting sick eating cans of food from Longneck Lukowski's, I've decided to have a look around to see if I can find the problem._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Out in Left Field
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Moe Cronin

_Moe Cronin in Diamond City wants me to find three baseball relics said to have been left behind in the old Westing Estate._

**Quest Items:**
- [Signed Baseball Card](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117898#L)
- [Signed Baseball](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117899#L)
- [Signed Catcher's Mitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117900#L)

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Pickman's Gift
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** N/A - Begins when you enter [Pickman Gallery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71826) and take the [Message to Jack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516644)

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Pickman's Blade](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71771)

Locations.Title: Public Knowledge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Daisy

_Daisy in Goodneighbor has asked me to clear out the Super Mutants that are threatening the old Boston Public Library. She also wants me to return her overdue book._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: The Marowski Heist
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Paul Pembroke must die during [Diamond City Blues](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516525). Then, speak to Darcy Pembroke and offer to help with her investigation.

**Quest Giver:** Darcy Pembroke

_Darcy Pembroke gave me an old photograph of Paul Pembroke, Henry Cooke, and Malcolm Latimer. This might be worth something to the right person._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: The Secret of Cabot House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Emogene Takes a Lover](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516526)

**Quest Giver:** Jack Abot

_There's been some kind of attack on Jack's facility at the Parsons State Insane Asylum. Jack and I are going to deal with it._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Lorenzo's Artifact [Gamma Gun]](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71787) + 500 Caps (If you take Jack's side)
- Mysterious Serum (if you take Lorenzo's side)

Locations.Title: The Silver Shroud
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Listen to Silver Shroud Radio in Goodneighbor

**Quest Giver:** Kent Connolly

_Someone named Kent Connolly is calling all Silver Shroud fans for an "urgent mission." If I want to check it out he's at the Memory Den._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Vault 75
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:

Locations.Title: Skylanes Flight 1981
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Sometimes occupied by a Random Encounter.**

Visited in a miscellaneous quest given by Ness, a traveling random encounter found in the Commonwealth. She will ask for your help securing the site from raiders and will meet you there with Gunner mercenaries she hired for backup. 

Once the raiders are defeated, Ness will lead you to a Master-locked hidden compartment beneath the front section of the plane. At that point, she reveals that she’s after whatever is inside. You can accept her caps and leave as agreed, or refuse, causing Ness and the Gunners to turn hostile as you fight for the compartment’s contents.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Astoundingly Awesome Tales](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71450)**
- **[Skylanes Flight 1981 Recording](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440657)**
- **[Skylanes Smuggling Manifest](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440658)**
- **[Ness' Lead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606685)**
- **[Skylanes Cargo Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606689)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440656)**
- **Combat Rifle**: In the front section’s lower level. 
- **Combat Shotgun**: In the left wing, beside a duffle bag. 
- **Short Pipe Rifle**: Inside the mid-section. 
- **RadAway**: Inside a bathroom in the front section. 
- **Pipe Pistol x2**: One in the right wing; one in a front-section bathroom.
- **Pork n’ Beans**: Inside the mid-section. 
- **Cram**: One in the front section and two in the mid-section. 
- **Dandy Boy Apples**: Inside the front section. 
- **Gum Drops**: Inside the front section and mid-section. 
- **Jangles the Moon Monkey**: In the right wing. 
- **Luxobrew Coffee Pot**: Inside the front section. 
- **Brain Fungus**: Growing above a toilet in the front section. 
- **Glowing Fungus x5**: Growing around the crash site.

If the you are a member of the Brotherhood of Steel and can convince him to rejoin, Brandis can later be found aboard [the Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965). The cellar's loot includes toolboxes, ammo boxes, a refrigerator, a desk, and several shelves stocked with items. There is also a weapons workbench, and several pieces of a mini nuke.

Locations.Title: Atlantic Offices
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by the Enclave.**

Located north of the [Crater of Atom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72001), the offices are visited as part of the creation club quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417), which was added with the Next-Gen Update. 

Using the Enclave CO's Terminal on basement level B3, select “Encampment Distribution,” then choose each of the three listed Enclave encampments in the Commonwealth to start three miscellaneous quests to visit them.

The Enclave Communications Tower on the roof can be interacted with to deactivate it, preventing the Enclave from respawning at the offices.

Locations.Title: Robotics Disposal Ground
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Sentry Bot and Mole Rats.**

Despite its name, the derelict disposal yard is more of an auto wrecking yard than a robotics facility. Aside from one inactive Sentry Bot, there are no robots here, but the area still contains a toolbox, first aid kit, and trunk to loot, along with a weapons workbench.

The lone robot is the Combat Sentry Prototype Mk IV, which can be activated from the terminal inside the concrete building using the holotape already loaded into it. It can be sent to temporarily visit [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021), [South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933), [Revere Satellite Array](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72020), or [Fort Hagen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71930), but moves slowly and often stops due to overheating. Many players instead trigger its self-destruct sequence to loot two fusion cores from its remains.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Hot Rodder](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71344)**
- **[Combat Sentry Proto MKIV Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441305)**

The follow-up quest, [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644), has the player clear the inside of the museum, then fight the raiders outside again along with a Deathclaw. Afterward, the player returns to [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035) to finish the quest.

Locations.Title: General Atomics Galleria
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by friendly Mister Handy and Mister Gutsy robots.** 

Before the War, it was built to show off what a town’s commercial district might look like if it were run entirely by robots. The grand opening never happened, though, after the supervisor disappeared under suspicious circumstances. In the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376), you can step into the role of grand reopening supervisor and finally open the place for business. [Back Alley Bowling](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442693) can be found inside the Galleria, though it isn’t marked on the map.

Be careful when interacting with the Galleria’s six traders before completing the grand opening: Bean, Danny, Crisp, Waitron, Sprocket, and Reg. Certain choices can cause them to turn hostile, which will permanently cost you access to them as traders.

Locations.Title: Lexington Parking Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location. The area connected to the open world has some ammunition and miscellaneous loot containers, with the door to an enclosed interior found near a ramp up onto the roof.

Inside, you'll find several ghouls and a friendly Protectron that can be activated after hacking a novice-level terminal. Loot includes a few first aid kits, glowing fungus growths, corpses, and an ammo box.

Locations.Title: Laundromat

Locations.Title: Lexington Pharmacy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a white door beneath a 'drugs' sign. Inside, you'll find a first aid kit, [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441505), junk, jet, and Rad-X.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Greenbriar Radio Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A distress signal originating from an underground bunker. You'll find the hatch here, hidden beneath some bushes near a barrel and crate at the edge of a clearing with a cooking station. Once inside the bunker, interact with the ham radio to turn off the distress signal.

Extend the satellites at [Radio Tower 3SM-U81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71990) to pick up the signal.

**Warning:** High-Level Mirelurk Queen will spawn in the river.

Locations.Title: University Point Pharmacy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Becomes available as an entry and exit point while clearing and opening up [Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=79965) during the Vault-Tec Workshop DLC questline. 

The area within the vault where this exit is located serves as a possible spawn point for attackers during settlement attacks, so it is recommended to place turrets and other defenses there.

Locations.Title: Default Radio Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A radio signal originating from the basement of a ruined house. Extend the satellites at [Relay Tower OMC-810](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71992) to pick up the signal.

To enter the basement, use the cellar door on the side of the house. Interact with the basement ham radio to turn off the radio signal.

Locations.Title: Nautical Radio Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A mayday signal originating from the Western Bell vessel. Enter the fishing boat cabin and interact with the ham radio to turn off the mayday signal.

Extend the satellites at [Radio Tower 3SM-U81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71990) to pick up the signal.

Locations.Title: Trader's Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a [Trader](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508633)**

Home to a [Trader](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508633) and their cat, the shack contains owned items throughout, including a toolbox, duffle bag, and wooden crate that can be stolen from.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Overdue Book**: On a table with a candle. 
- **Canned Dog Food**: On a small shelf.
- **Tato Flower x4**: Harvestable from the [Trader's](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508633) field.
- **Wild Corn x4**: Harvestable from the [Trader's](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508633) field.
- **Blood Leaf x3**: Harvestable from the nearby pond.

Locations.Title: Raider Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied a lone Raider and Attack Dog.**

Located across the lake north of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the shack contains a chem box, ammo box, and cooler to loot. However, the mattress inside cannot be used for sleeping.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Psycho**: On top of the mattress. 
- **Mole Rat Meat**: On the barbecue.

Locations.Title: Shenley's Oyster Bar
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location, west of [Hubris Comics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71840). Neon sign outside. Steamer Trunk located on the roof.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
- Day Tripper x2
- Short Syringer Rifle
- Vegetables
- Nuka-Cola

Locations.Title: Mole Rat Den
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mole Rats.**

Located just south of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034), the den contains a cooler, duffle bag, cabinet, toolbox, and novice-locked safe to loot. 

Be wary, as there are several ways to trigger a runaway series of explosions. The most notable is a derelict power generator beside a refrigerator in a rubbish pile, which, if hit by gunfire, can set off a nuclear explosion similar to a car explosion. Additionally, there are two red containers that can explode, one of which is surrounded by natural gas and needs only a spark to ignite.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Trashbusters Award](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440506)**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71466)**
- **Pipe Pistol**: On a crate beside a large radioactive power generator.
- **Black-Rim Glasses**: Beside a skeleton.
- **Nuka Cola**: In a rubbish pile.
- **Used Oil Can x2**: Beside a cart at the entrance and beside a toolbox.
- **Gas Canister**: Beside a cart by the den's entrance.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: In a crate by the den's entrance.
- **Coolant**: Beside a refrigerator. 
- **Glowing Fungus x12**: Harvestable inside the den and near its entrance.
- **Brain Fungus x20**: Harvestable inside the den and near its entrance.

Locations.Title: 35 Court
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location with a Sentry Bot, an Assaultron,and Power Armor.

Locations.Title: Commonwealth Bank
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location found south of [Faneuil Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71848). Inside you'll find a safe with a novice-difficulty lock, a police protectron that can be activated with a novice-level terminal, miscellaneous loot containers, and a few glowing fungus growths.

The vault (accessed via an expert-level terminal) has two more safes of expert and advanced level difficulty, a duffle bag, and some more junk.

Locations.Title: Concord Civic Access (East)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A cellar door found behind the bus stop leads to an underground sewage maintenance path that runs under Concord. Connects to [Concord Civic Access (Central)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401374) and [Concord Civic Access (West)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441297).

Locations.Title: Concord Civic Access (Central)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Underground sewage maintenance path that runs under Concord. Connects to [Concord Civic Access (East)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401373). 

Access is revealed after the Deathclaw pops out of the ground during [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644).

Locations.Title: Drug Den
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unmarked location filled with raiders. Accessed through a red door across the street from a "BBQ BUFFET" sign.

Expect to find a bed, plenty of chems, and a steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Mean Pastries
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location, entered through a green door beneath a 'Joe's Spuckies' sign. Inside you'll find junk, food, and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Observation Post
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small observation post, marked with one of the railroad's 'ally' murals, is on a hill overlooking [Vault 111](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72064). You can find a few cartons of water here.

Locations.Title: Tiny Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Close to the edge of the map, this shed can be difficult to spot when approaching west from [Vault 111](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72064), as it is partially hidden beside a large rockface. Its door is secured with a novice-level lock. Inside are a tool case, a cabinet, and a few other items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Used Oil Can**: On top of the cabinet.
- **Bloodleaf**: Harvestable beside a tire near the shed.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Tent
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Made from a blue tarp, this small makeshift shelter contains a mattress to sleep on and a first aid kit to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Silt Bean x5**: Harvestable around the tent.

Locations.Title: Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Wild Mongrels.**

Uncomfortably close to the nearly by [Raider Campsite](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440364), the campsite has been overrun by a pack of wild mongrels, with a dead raider, suitcase, and cooler to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Leather Chest Piece**: On top of the suitcase.
- **Dirty Water**: Beside the suitcase.
- **Silt Bean x4**: Harvestable just south of the campsite.

Locations.Title: Military Transport
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Bloodbug Hatchlings.**

The transport sits on a small island at the outlet of the lake that surrounds [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035). A cluster of radioactive barrels are stacked beside it, but those willing to brave a few rads can loot an ammo box near the barrels and a first aid kit inside the transport.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Army Helmet**: Beside the transport's rear hatch.
- **Glowing Fungus x2**: Harvestable beside the barrels.

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Just north of a collapsed house, the campsite has a cooler, duffle bag, and two bottles of alcohol to loot. 

**Notable Loot:**
- **Dirty Water**: Beside the picnic table. May vary based on your level.
- **Nuka Cola**: May spawn instead of the Dirty Water.
- **Nuka Cola Quantum**: May spawn instead of the Dirty Water.
- **Bourbon**: On top of the picnic table.
- **Whiskey**: On top of the picnic table.
- **Wild Corn x4**: Harvestable from the field south of the campsite.

Locations.Title: Wrecked House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Up the hillside from the lake, the remains of this house are occupied only by two mannequins, with an Advanced-locked safe to loot behind it.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Nuka-Cola**: Beside a lit lantern on a table.
- **Gum Drops**: Beside a lit lantern on a table.
- **Danny Boy Apples**: On top of a mattress.
- **Lantern**: On top of a mattress.
- **Hubflower**: Harvestable beside the fence.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radstags.**

Sitting beneath the transmission lines, the trailer contains a first aid kit, cooler, toolbox, and ammo box to loot, along with a mattress to sleep on. 

There are also two tires inside, which can be easily carried to the nearby [Abernathy Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72033) and scrapped for eight rubber once the farm becomes a settlement. 

**Notable Loot:**
- **Bobby Pin Box**: Inside the trailer.

Locations.Title: Concord Water Tower
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034), the tower has a first aid kit at its base. There is also a steamer trunk in a shallow hole just south of the tower, beside a dead tree shaped like a Y.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Purified Water x4**: At the base of the water tower.
- **Wild Tato Blossom x7**: Harvestable beside the steamer trunk.
- **Wild Mutfruit x3**: Harvestable beside the steamer trunk.
- **Hubflower**: Harvestable beside the steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Shooting Range
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Scavenger.**

Located across the lake northeast of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the shooting range is being used by a scavenger who will attack if approached. A toolbox, dresser, and several other items can be found here to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Nuka-Cherry](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=348651)**
- **Gwinnett Stout**: Inside the metal bucket on top of the dresser.
- **Fancy Lads Snack Cakes**: On top of the dresser.

Locations.Title: Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Raiders.**

Located east across the lake from [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the camp contains a dead brahmin, a cooler, and three sleeping bags. Nearby, beside the brick pillar of a ruined building, there is an open safe with a cap stash inside.

**Notable Loot:**
- **10MM Pistol**: Beside the safe.
- **Mole Rat Chunks**: Beside the fire and cooler.
- **Silt Bean x3**: Harvestable near the the safe.

Locations.Title: Water Filtration Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Mole Rat.**

Located at the top of a hill overlooking the lake, east of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035). There is a suitcase to loot, along with three cap stashes hidden inside the yellow equipment. To access them, follow the pipe down to the water's edge and flip the switch. This opens the machine's lid, allowing you to collect the caps.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Snubnosed .44 Pistol**: Beside the skeleton, plus some .44 ammo.
- **Radaway x2**: In a crate atop the large pipe beside the skeleton.
- **Rad-X**: In a crate atop the large pipe beside the skeleton.
- **Pork N' Beans**: Beside the suitcase.
- **Bobby Pin Box**: Near the skeleton.
- **Aluminum Can**: Beside a skeleton.
- **Bloodleaf x2**: Harvestable near the lakeside switch.

Locations.Title: Raider Den
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Raider and attack dog.**

Located south of the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916), the makeshift den contains a cooler and an ammo box to loot, along with a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Jet**: On top of a small table.

Locations.Title: Scavenger Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Scavenger.**

Located north of [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021), the shack is home to a scavenger who will turn hostile if approached. Everything inside, including the sleeping bag, is considered owned, so companions who dislike stealing will react negatively if you loot anything. There are several bottles of alcohol and a wooden crate to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Whiskey x2:** One on a crate, and another beside a lantern.
- **Gwinnett Stout:** On top of a crate.
- **Wine:** On the ground beside a crate.
- **Hubflower:** Harvestable beside the shack.

Locations.Title: Crashed Vertibird
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radstags.**

Located southeast of the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916), the crash site has little to loot, though a wooden crate can be found among the debris.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[T-45 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71731)**
- **Brown Flight Helmet**: On the copilot's seat of the vertibird.
- **Carrot Flower x2**: Harvestable near the vertibird.

Locations.Title: Dismembered Traders
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916), the campsite contains a cooler, a novice-locked crate, and the bodies of the unfortunate traders to loot.

*Nudging the body in the barrel can cause physics glitches, making it spin wildly.*

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Shack Beneath the Flyover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Head under the highway northwest of Outpost Zimonja and the shack is hard to miss. Inside, there’s an ammo box to loot and a bed you can use.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Combat Knife**: Beside the sink.
- **Cram**: On small side table beside a chair.
- **Tato x4:** In the sink.

Locations.Title: Sunken Containers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

At the bottom of [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978), you’ll find a steamer trunk with a nearby explosives box. Both are surrounded by radioactive barrels - power armor is recommended.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Railroad Cache
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a truck's storage trailer found at the edge of the lake. Expect to find an explosives box and bottlecap mine, even if you've had no prior involvement with the Railroad.

Locations.Title: Truck and Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A wrecked truck can be found at the edge of the map. Expect to find a steamer trunk in its trailer, and not much else.

Locations.Title: Hideout
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location found underneath the bridge. You can find a few sleeping bags and several hostile ghouls inside.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=356187)

Locations.Title: Sunken Container
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A steamer trunk can be found at the bottom of the sea, beneath a stone arch.

Finding it will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - Difficult to Kill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440538)

*Note - the nearby bathtub has a few references to Die Hard - namely some duct tape, a lighter, and a teddy bear!*

Locations.Title: Crashed Plane
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A plane has crashed into the rocks on a small island here. You can find a red flight helmet under the wing and a metal box (alongside some harvestable plants) under the cockpit.

Locations.Title: Sunken Containers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A steamer trunk can be found at the bottom of the sea, in an upside-down boat. You can also find a first aid kit next to the doorway.

Looting the trunk will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - Trapped for Days](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440545)

Locations.Title: Floating Platform
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A wooden platform is floating on the surface between two rocks here. Loot includes a wooden box, bobby pins, and some junk.

Locations.Title: Floating Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A floating structure can be found near the rocks here. Loot includes duffel bags and junk, with a metal box on top of the half-submerged boat nearby.

Locations.Title: Floating Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A large wooden platform is floating freely in the sea here. Expect to find a few mattresses, junk items, a crate, and a Mutfruit plant.

Locations.Title: Sunken Cargo Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An enormous cargo ship can be found at the bottom of the sea here. No loot to speak of.

Locations.Title: Sunken Containers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A rowboat can be found at the bottom of the sea, with a steamer trunk and a tool case on it.

Looting the trunk will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - X Marks the Spot](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440616)

You're all but guaranteed to start drowning on the way down to it or back up, so bring plenty of Stimpaks, a suit of Power Armor, or the Aqua Boy / Aqua Girl perk to boost your air supply.

Locations.Title: Backyard Bunker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unmarked location. Entered through cellar doors in the shed next to a yellow house where you find [Hammer's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=116914).

**Notable loot:**
- [David's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=119694)
- [Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440650)
- Hazmat Suit
- Safe with an expert-difficulty lock

Locations.Title: Malden Drainage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location north of [Taffington Boathouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72043), entered by venturing into the dark drainpipe.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Pledge Initiation Instructions](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440655)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71523)

Locations.Title: Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A raider has set up an unusually-decorated camp around the truck here. Watch out for turrets near the front, and a pair of attack dogs.

Expect to find a sleeping bag, ammo box, explosives box with a novice-difficulty lock, and cooking station.

Locations.Title: Hilltop Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A shack can be found on top of the hill here. Expect to find a bed, cooler, some junk, a weapons workbench and a terminal with an expert-difficulty lock. Hacking into it will let you unleash a Police protectron found underneath the shack.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A yellow bus can be found by the side of the road here, surrounded by Stingwings. Expect to find two suitcases and a lunch pail near the driver's seat.

Locations.Title: The Behemoth's Favourite Monkey
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Jangles the Moon Monkey can be found in a small red car here. Picking it up spawns a Super Mutant Behemoth.

Search the surrounding area to find a the corpses of a raider, settler, and glowing one alongside a chem box and caps stash.

Locations.Title: Charlestown Laundry
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a white door near a red truck.

**Notable Loot:**
- [La Coiffe](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71464)
- [Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71674) on a desk behind the door with a novice-difficulty lock.
- Safe with an Expert-difficulty lock (in the same room as the Nuka-Cola Quantum)

Locations.Title: Construction Site Warehouse
