Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a door near a Super Mutant barricade and hanging meat bag.

Locations.Title: Cambridge Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked and unremarkable location near the flyover. Infested by feral ghouls, and visited during [Boston After Dark](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354348).

Locations.Title: Mass Chemical
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location. Inside, you'll find a chemistry station, weapons workbench, and novice-difficulty terminal that can activate a construction protectron.

Locations.Title: Cambridge Construction Site
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location. Filled with super mutants.

Locations.Title: Science Center Gift Shop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a blue door near the bridge. Inside, you'll find a chemistry station, several junk items, a safe with a novice-difficulty lock, and a [Mr. Handy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441176) that acts as a trader.

Locations.Title: Lonely Ghoul
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small raft in the middle of the river is home to a Glowing One that's all but defenceless. On the underside of the raft, you'll find that it was being kept afloat by a few radioactive barrels - which explains a lot!

Locations.Title: Wrecked Apartment
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Climb a pile of rubble to find some junk and a safe with a master-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Apartments
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a blue door beneath the cigarette advertisement. 

Inside, you'll find raiders and junk items on your way up the stairs, with the best loot (food, chems, an overdue book and a bottlecap mine) on the top floor. You can also sleep here thanks to a bed and sleeping bag on the top floor.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Swim up to this wooden boat to find an unlocked safe.

Locations.Title: Marlborough House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a white door behind some sandbags. Inside, you'll find a [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441184), the [Esplanade Mission Brief](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441183) note, several sleeping bags, junk items, and varied loot containers.

Locations.Title: Bridgeway Trust
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through the white double doors beneath a large 'BANK' sign. Inside, you'll mostly find junk items (plus a pair of 10mm pistols from would-be bank robbers), with the real good stuff found when you hack into a master-difficulty terminal and unlock the vault door.

The vault is home to four gold bars and sixteen safes, fifteen of which are locked with difficulties ranging from Novice to Master.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Swim up to this wooden boat to find an unlocked safe inside.

Locations.Title: Utility Tunnel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a door at the bottom of some stairs inside the [Boston Police Rationing Site](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71936).

Connects to a large network of tunnels that can be accessed through [Mass Pike Tunnel West](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71955) and [Mass Pike Tunnel East](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71956).

Locations.Title: Caged Dog
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A dog named Teddy is trapped in a cage here. Pick through the door's advanced-level lock to return him to his owner, [Eleanor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441193).

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A boat can be found in the river here, with parts of it sticking out of the water. Swim inside to find a footlocker with a USCG Lockup Password inside.

Locations.Title: Sunken Container
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An industrial trunk can be found at the bottom of [Lake Cochituate](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71984) here, near a log and some radioactive barrels.

Locations.Title: Lakeside Shacks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A reasonably sized settler camp has been invaded by mirelurks here. Expect to find a cooking station, some junk, a bed, plenty of corpses, and robot model kit parts in a secondary shack out the back.

One of three places where robot model kit parts can be found. The other two are found at the [Poseidon Reservoir](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71888) and [Mahkra Fishpacking](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71884).

Locations.Title: Substation
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the edge of the map, you can find a Super Mutant Behemoth fighting a Deathclaw or two among the power infrastructure. Loot is sparse, but you can find some glowing fungus growths and a safe inside the warehouse nearby.

Locations.Title: Civil Alert System Broadcast Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A hatch at the base of the west satellite dish leads to the Military Bunker, an unmarked location. Once inside, you can interact with the ham radio to turn off the broadcast started when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0BB-915](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71993)

Locations.Title: Distress Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A hatch can be at the base of two trees outside the large orange-and-white trailer northwest of the pool in [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860). Once inside, you can interact with a ham radio to turn off the distress signal started when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0BB-915](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71993).

The bunker is also home to a bed, several food items, and a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Raider Radio Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A hatch outside the lone raider's shack leads down to an unmarked bunker. Once inside, you can interact with the ham radio to turn off the signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0BB-915](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71993).

The bunker is also home to a baseball bat, jet, psychotats, a chem cooler with a novice-difficulty lock, and a single 10mm round.

Locations.Title: Military Vehicle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A military vehicle can be found here, totally surrounded by land mines. Expect to find a duffle bag, some food, a silver locket, a dirty army helmet, and a rifle.

Locations.Title: Canister Launching Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A shack overlooking the area has some explosive canisters you can attack to launch them into the air. Hold down the 'pick up' button to move other canisters into position and continue the fun.

You can also find a bed and cooking stove here.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A mattress, cooking station, suitcase and caps stash can be found at the edge of the water here. Don't get too comfortable - the area is home to several mirelurks.

Locations.Title: Gunner Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Here, you'll find an elevator guarded by a Gunner and a turret. Press the button, and you'll be taken up to a flyover where a few more Gunners can be found alongside a cooking station, weapons workbench, a couple of beds, and some loot containers.

The view's pretty good up there, too!

Locations.Title: Safe on the Flyover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the end of a flyover (accessed by using an elevator beneath the [Gunner Camp](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441249)). You'll find some pre-war money, a snubnosed .44 pistol, a duffle bag, and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Bethany's Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A shack owned by [Bethany](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441255). Expect to find a weapons workbench, cooking station, overdue book, mattress, and plenty of rads - it's built on top of a toxic pond!

Locations.Title: Carhenge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Several cars have been stuck together in strange shapes somewhat resembling Stonehenge here. A Super Mutant Behemoth can be found in the area after reaching level 12.

Locations.Title: Raider Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Two raiders live in a shack by the roadside. Inside, you'll find a bed, chemistry workstation, and wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Concrete Building
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small concrete building can be found here. Inside, you'll need to hack into a novice-difficulty terminal to access the main attractions- a bed, explosives box, and destroyed Mr. Gutsy.

Locations.Title: Billboard Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Accessed by climbing a fallen tree lodged behind the billboard, the campsite contains a first aid kit, an ammo box, and a cooler to loot, along with a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Concord Speakeasy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located north of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the speakeasy contains a news stand, cigarette machine, tool case, toolbox, two suitcases, an ammo box, a steamer trunk, and an advanced-locked safe to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Vault-Tec Lunchbox**: In a second-floor bedroom with an exterior door.
- **10mm Pistol**: In the second-floor room with the steam trunk.
- **Machete x2**: Both are in the second-floor bathroom.
- **X-Cell x2**: Both are beside a second-floor bed.
- **Day Tripper x2**: Both are in the second-floor bathroom.

Locations.Title: Workhouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Entered through a white door near a lantern. Behind the workshop is a Nuka-Cola machine and trash can, while inside there is a cooler, duffle bag, three desks, and an advanced-locked safe on the fourth floor to loot. 

The duffle bag and cooler found on the third floor can be reached by dropping down through a hole on the fourth floor.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Lootable House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034), the house contains a toolbox, first aid kit, cabinet, suitcase, two dressers, and a novice-locked floor safe under the bed frame that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
-  **Cram**: On the kitchen counter beside the oven.
- **Instamash**: Inside the refridgerator.
- **Sugar Bombs**: On top of the refridgerator.

Locations.Title: Seat with a View
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

On a hillside east of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034), the site has a toolbox and ammo box to loot, and acts as the perfect place to admire your Red Rocket settlement.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Gourd Blossom x4**: Harvestable just east of the chair.
- **Wild Mutfruit x3**: Harvestable just east of the chair.
- **Hubflower**: Harvestable just east of the chair.

Locations.Title: Lootable House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located just south of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034), the house contains a mailbox, dresser, chem box, and an advanced-locked wall safe on the second floor that can be looted, plus a mattress that can be slept on.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=123325)**
- **Red Bandana**: On top of the second-floor dresser.
- **Welding Goggles**: On top of the second-floor dresser.
- **Pork N' Beans**: On top of the refrigerator.
- **Sugar Bombs x2**: Both are in the kitchen.
- **Gourd x5**: Harvestable behind the house.

Locations.Title: Concord Civic Access (West)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Cellar door found between two buildings, leading to an underground sewage maintenance path that runs under Concord. Connects to [Concord Civic Access (Central)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401374) and [Concord Civic Access (East)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401373).

Locations.Title: Concord Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located beside the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the church has a desk and an expert-locked safe on the second floor to loot. 

**Notable Loot:**
- **Short Pipe Pistol**: On a crate on the second floor.
- **Fragmentation Grenade**: On a crate on the second floor.
- **Desk Fan**: On a desk on the second floor.

Locations.Title: Lootable House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Northeast of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the house contains a caps stash, chem box, a dresser, and a novice-locked wall safe on the second floor to loot, along with a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Pipe Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle**: Beside the sleeping bag.
- **Sugar Bombs**: On top of the refrigerator.
- **Pork N' Beans**: Inside the refrigerator.

Locations.Title: Gunner Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Here, you'll find an elevator that can take you up to the top of the flyover. On it, you'll find a small Gunner camp that's home to an Assaultron and some loot containers.

Locations.Title: Tiny Diner
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked building with a great view of the water. Loot includes a cola machine that can contain Nuka-Cherry or Quantum depending on your level, beer, and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock behind the counter.

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Home to a few junk items and a power armor station. Climb a nearby truck to get onto the roof, where you'll find an armor workbench, weapons workbench, and sniper rifle.

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the end of a pier, you can swim down to find a sunken boat. Check the inside to find a stimpak and wooden crate with an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A reasonably sized building marked with one of the railroad's 'cache' murals. Walk up a tree leaning against the back wall to find a caps stash and supply box, then drop through a hole in the ceiling to find a power armor station, first aid kit, and explosives box with a novice-difficulty lock.

You can also find a protectron model kit next to the power armor station.

Locations.Title: Ice Cream Shop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can be entered through the waterfront or street. Inside, you'll find some junk items, a chem box, and a safe with a master-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A boat can be found underneath the flyover here. You'll find a toolbox inside, and be ambushed by a Mirelurk Hunter when you leave.

Locations.Title: Sunken Plane
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A large plane can be found at the bottom of the sea here. Swim into the cockpit to find a first aid kit and steamer trunk.

Looting the trunk will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - Need a Hand](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441320)

Locations.Title: Underwater Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A shack can be found on top of a metal platform at the bottom of the ocean here. No loot in the area.

Locations.Title: Underwater Pier
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Just outside the playable area, two piers can be found at the bottom of the sea. No loot in the area.

Locations.Title: Illuminated Pipes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unlike other pipes on the seafloor, this one has glowing lights on its side. No loot in the area, but may be a remnant of 'Vault 120', an underwater vault (and extended reference to Bioshock) that was cut from the game.

What little information we do have suggests it would have been visited in a quest titled '20 Leagues Under the Sea', and ended in a fight against a giant squid - the vault's overseer.

Locations.Title: Cat Lover's Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the bottom of the sea, you can find an upside-down ship above a ravine. Swim inside the boat to find some cat paintings and 'MEOW!' scrawled into the ceiling.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Boats
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Two police boats seemingly apprehended a larger boat here. In the larger boat, you can find a wooden crate, some junk, and a bloodleaf to harvest.

Locations.Title: Sunken Plane & Recovery Effort
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A large plane can be found on the seafloor here, and directly above it is a boat and platform that was seemingly trying to salvage the pieces. Inside the boat, you'll find a wooden crate and handful of junk items.

Locations.Title: Floating Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A few boats have been stuck together and turned into an ill-fated outpost here. Search the area for junk items, plants to harvest, a wooden crate, a few mattresses, a suitcase, and a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A boat carrying several cars has sunk to the bottom of the sea here. No loot in the area.

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A boat carrying several containers can be found on the sea floor here. Swim inside to find a lunch pail and some empty milk bottles.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Boats
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A half-submerged boat can be found on the surface here, with some smaller wooden boats nearby. One of the wooden boats has an unlocked safe on it.

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A white boat can be found at the bottom of the sea here, with a steamer trunk and medkit inside.

Looting the trunk will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - Predator Becomes Prey](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441390).

Locations.Title: Underwater Pipe Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A pipe can be found at the bottom of the sea. Open the orange hatch on its side to find a first aid kit and steamer trunk inside.

Looting the trunk will complete the miscellaneous quest started when finding the [Bottle Message - Not Going Well](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441394)

Locations.Title: Lighthouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A leaning lighthouse can be found here. Inside, you can find mirelurk eggs, ammo, junk, an explosives box, a mattress, a 10mm pistol and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Three mattresses and a duffel bag can be found around a campfire here.

Locations.Title: Tunnel Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A camp is built into a tunnel here. It's filled with feral ghouls, settler corpses, beds, food items, and junk. You can also find a cooking station, caps stash, and safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Benjamin Franklin Statue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An old statue, presumably of Benjamin Franklin, can be found in a sorry state here. You can find a weapon and some junk nearby.

Locations.Title: The Door
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A door in the middle of the area has a message for you. Opening it spawns a Sentry Bot that respawns every few days.

Locations.Title: Crashed Vertibird
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A wrecked vertibird can be found in the swamp here. A brown flight helmet can be found in the flooded area behind the pilot's seat, and a set of [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71737) stands nearby.

Locations.Title: Swamp Treehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks, with Feral Ghouls nearby.**

Located east of [Somerville Place](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72053), the treehouse contains two dressers to loot, a cooking station, and a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Focused Laser Musket**: On a table on the roof.
- **Pipe Pistol**: On a pegboard above a dresser.
- **Militia Hat**: On a chair on the roof.
- **Bobrov's Best Moonshine x2**: On a dresser and on a table on the roof.
- **Buffout x3**: On back of the van beside the treehouse.
- **Rad-X**:  On back of the van beside the treehouse.
- **Microscope**: On back of the van beside the treehouse.

Locations.Title: Skylanes 1665 Mayday Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the Storage Compartment, an unmarked location within [Skylanes Flight 1665](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71949), found by using a trapdoor between two rows of seats and a cart near a pile of rubble.

Open the hatch next to the ladder to disable the Skylanes 1665 Mayday Signal that's started when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0DB-521](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71997).

The area is also home to a few junk items, glowing fungus, two suitcases (one of which has a novice-difficulty lock), and a wooden crate with a lock of the same level.

Locations.Title: Gunner Signal Remnant Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A corpse between the seats in a loose chunk of airplane is responsible for the Gunner Signal Remnant. Visited as part of the Best of Three side quest added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update, after finding the [Gunner Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441405). Interact with the gunner corpse here to be ambushed by Caroni who is wielding the [Tesla Cannon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441410).

Locations.Title: Parking Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location that's free of radiation. One half, entered through the blue door, is full of ghouls - you can find food items, suitcases, sleeping bags, a cooking station, and a security gate with a master-difficulty lock hiding a steamer trunk and first aid kit.

The other half, entered through an elevator on the roof, houses a deathclaw alongside a first aid kit and steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Plane
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A plane can be found here, with a few military grade circuit boards (and radscorpions) around it.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A bus can be found here, surrounded by a Glowing One and several ghouls. Loot in and around the bus includes a few suitcases, a duffle bag, and a steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Cabin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked cabin and public restroom can be found here. Stingwings can be found guarding the trunk and miscellaneous junk.

Locations.Title: Wicked Shipping Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The door at the back of a truck trailer has a master-difficulty lock here. It can also be unlocked with a key found at the [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879).

Inside, you'll find a steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Pondside Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

At the edge of a pond next to [Drumlin Diner](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71814), look for a stack of two mattresses beside several barrels and a small wooden crate containing three lootable items.

**Notable Loot:**
- **RadAway**: In a wooden crate.
- **Aluminum Can x2**: In a wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Cabin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A cabin can be found in the wilderness here. Inside, you'll find enemies, mattresses, a first aid kit, and some other miscellaneous loot containers.

Random encounters can also occur here.

Locations.Title: Slocum Joe's Basement
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the basement of Slocum Joe's, the diner on the street corner. Loot includes junk and miscellaneous containers, but the main attraction is an elevator hidden behind the bookshelf (though it only works after restoring power to [The Switchboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117211), and functions as a quick and easy way to return to that area.)

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the middle of Lexington. Search the area in and around it to find an armor workbench, power armor station, weapons workbench, and junk items.

Locations.Title: Poolside Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A pool frequented by raiders can be found near the [Lexington Apartments](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71823). Around it, you'll find two sleepings bags and a cooking station, with wild tarberries growing in the water.

Locations.Title: Walkway Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the [raider-occupied](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71698) walkway between buildings you can find two sleeping bags, a chem box, a duffel bag, and a cooler.

Locations.Title: Bus Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked bus station can be found by the road here. Loot includes a couple of suitcases and not much else.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Here, you can find a bus that's gotten stuck at a very convenient angle. By walking up the back of the bus, you can reach the freeway.

Locations.Title: Camp on the Freeway
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: After getting up onto the elevated freeway via the [Wrecked Bus](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441509), you can follow a series of Railroad murals to find a truck at the eastern edge. Outside, you'll find a cooking station and cooler, while the inside of the trailer has a mattress, first aid kit, tool case, and suitcase.

Locations.Title: Camp on the Freeway
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small camp can be found on top of the elevated freeway here, accessed by walking up the collapsed section a short distance to the west. You'll find a cooking station, bed, some junk items, and a toolbox.

Locations.Title: Graygarden Homestead
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked interior found directly west of [Graygarden](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72050). Inside you'll find several junk and food items, and if you pick through an expert-difficulty lock to access the basement, you'll find a first aid kit, chemistry station, and safe with an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Truck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A truck and trailer can be found by the side of the road here. Pick through the advanced-difficulty lock on the trailer door to find an ammo box, mattress, gwinnett brew, and some junk.

Locations.Title: Trader's Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A [Trader](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441514) can be found living in a metal tube beneath the broken freeway here. Their camp consists of a cooking station, sleeping bag, overdue book, a chem box, and some junk items.

There's also a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock between support beams beneath the shack.

Locations.Title: Operations
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a blue door on the concrete bridge. Inside you'll find several junk items, a wooden crate with a novice-difficulty lock, and a hatch behind a blue barrel in the corner that takes you down to [Reactor Level.](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441517)

Locations.Title: Boston City Works Beacon Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside [Operations](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441516), accessed by using a hatch behind a blue barrel in the corner. Once inside, turn to the left and use the ham radio to turn off the signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 1DL-109](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71994).

The area is also home to junk and food items.

Locations.Title: Distress Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A hatch in the side of an overturned blue train car leads to a small room. Once inside, you can interact with the ham radio to turn off the signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 1DL-109](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71994).

The train car is also home to junk items, a suitcase, and a wooden crate with a novice-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Waystation
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked interior entered through a trapdoor in the tower near the train tracks. Inside, you'll find a metal box, machete, chem box, junk, blood pack, and a corpse.

Locations.Title: Garbled Radio Beacon Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A cave can be entered here. Before reaching level 20, it's nothing special - home to a few mole rats and brain fungus / glowing fungus growths. 

After hitting level 20 and witnessing a UFO crash, however, the cave contains a wounded alien. You can interact with a ham radio at the back to turn off the signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 1DL-109](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71994#L).

Locations.Title: Flooded Boathouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The boathouse by the river here has certainly seen drier days. The boat outside is home a mirelurk nest, ammo box, and a sea captain's hat, while the building (only accessible through doors with advanced-difficulty locks) has a corpse, shock baton, and industrial trunk inside.

Locations.Title: Freeway Elevator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the wilderness beneath the elevated freeway you can find an elevator that will take you up to the top  where [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71738) can be found.

Locations.Title: Flooded Basement
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the bottom of a pile of rubble, you'll find a hole in the side of a building. Poke your head inside to find a mirelurk, several eggs, and a Nuka-Cola machine.

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked Red Rocket station. Search the area in and around it to find a power armor station, safe with a novice-difficulty lock, weapons workbench, armor workbench, and plenty of junk items.

Locations.Title: Plumber's Secret
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through the warehouse's blue doors. Inside you'll find bottlecap mines, junk, a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock, and other miscellaneous loot containers. Look up to the ceiling to find a trail of plungers leading to some wooden boards you can shoot to find a caps stash and syringer rifle.

Locations.Title: Evans Way Cul-de-Sac
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A ruined building is home to several raiders here. You'll need to pick through one of three three expert-difficulty locks / gates to reach it, and can find a steamer trunk upstairs.

Locations.Title: Copley Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location accessed through station entrance on the northern side of the [Boston Public Library](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71844) building, or through the eastern side of the library's interior.

Occupied by Super Mutants.

Locations.Title: Prost Bar
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a blue door at the bottom of some stairs in the street near [Boston Common](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71960)'s north-western edge. Inside you'll find junk, baseball grenades, and a steamer trunk with a master-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Water Street Apartments
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a white door beneath a large 'apartments' sign. Loot includes food, junk, miscellaneous containers, and mattresses. The upper floor is inaccessible until 'The Silver Shroud' side quest is progressed to a point where you're directed to come here.

Locations.Title: Boxing Gym
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location entered through a green door on a corner building near [Old North Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71870). Loot includes seven instances of Buffout scattered around the gym.

Locations.Title: Office Building
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Raiders.**

Unmarked location with an interior.

Locations.Title: Super Mutant Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An elevator on top of the building can take you up to the [Fallen Skybridge](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=118765), where super mutants have taken over a gunner camp. Loot mostly consists of junk and corpses.

Locations.Title: Hub 360
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location, entered through a door near the rooftop pool or from ground level.

Occupied by super mutants.

Locations.Title: Ruined Skyscraper
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered by clambering up a fallen corridor on the [Fallen Skybridge](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=118765). Can also be accessed at ground level.

Occupied by Gunners and Super Mutants.

Locations.Title: Ticker Tape Lounge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a door on a lower (but still elevated) part of the [Fallen Skybridge](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=118765), or via the rooftop you end up on when using the elevator on top of [Mass Bay Medical Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71915). Occupied by Gunners.

Inside you'll find junk, miscellaneous containers, a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock, food, a chemistry station, an overdue book, and a mattress.

Locations.Title: Pier Building
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked building found at the end of the pier near [Donny Kowalski](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355599). Inside you'll find junk, food, mattresses, and an overdue book.

Locations.Title: New England Technocrat Society
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An additional interior found by going through double doors on the ground floor of the [Harbormaster Hotel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71833).

Added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update, and visited during the [All Hallows' Eve](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441412) side quest.

Locations.Title: Warehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location on the pier, entered through a white door facing the green boat. Occupied by Super Mutants.

Expect to find junk and miscellaneous loot containers.

Locations.Title: Freeway Elevator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An alternative way up to the elevated freeway and [Mass Pike Interchange](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71967) can be found at the base of a concrete pillar here.

Locations.Title: Arcjet Rocket Engine
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An attached terminal can be used to activate the rocket. Try not to stand too close afterwards.

Locations.Title: Factory
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through the double doors near some radioactive barrels. Inside you'll find junk, miscellaneous containers, a few hostile insects and a fusion core. 

On the upper floor, picking through a door with a novice-difficulty lock will reveal a safe with a master-difficulty lock and a terminal that can unlock a security door near the entrance. Behind it, you'll find two first aid kits.

Locations.Title: Fort Hagen Hangar
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A hatch at the base of the northern satellite dish can be found behind a security door. A terminal on the walkway directly above it can be used to open the door, though it only appears during the [Headhunting](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442288) quest.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Public Works Maintenance Area
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through an underwater pipe. Inside, you'll find an advanced-difficulty terminal with a steamer trunk behind it.

If you side with the Minutemen, you'll come here during [The Nuclear Option](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350738) and have access to its more expansive sections. A more detailed map of the area can be found [here](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442634#L).

Locations.Title: CIT Rotunda
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location that can be entered from multiple angles. Inside you'll find junk, miscellaneous containers, a mattress, food, an industrial trunk, a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock, and a mini nuke.

Occupied by Synths and Super Mutants.

Locations.Title: Pumphouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location with a separate interior map accessible from the concrete building near the river. Loot includes a [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71529), steamer trunk, and [The Gainer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71799).

Locations.Title: Quincy Police Lock Up
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a door in the corner of [Quincy Police Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71973)'s ground floor. Inside you'll find junk, some bottles of whiskey, [Eddie Winter Holotape 3](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=118780), a first aid kit with a novice-difficulty lock, and a police protectron that can be activated with a terminal.

Locations.Title: Clothing Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location. Inside you'll find a cooking stove, armor workbench, a bed, junk, miscellaneous containers, and several pieces of apparel and armor on the shelves.

Locations.Title: University Credit Union
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location at the edge of [University Point](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71847). Entering from the front will give you access to a suitcase, 10mm pistol, stimpak, and some junk.

Entering from the side (done by hacking a novice-level terminal in the neighbouring building) grants access to the novice-difficulty vault control terminal. Once inside, hack a safe with a master-difficulty lock to find a button - this opens a secret room where you'll find [Prototype UP77 "Limitless Potential" [Laser gun]](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71763), a chemistry station, and a weapons workbench.

Locations.Title: University Point: Sedgwick Hall
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location directly west of the main [University Point](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71847) marker.

Locations.Title: Lake Quannapowitt Monitoring Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

This unmarked monitoring station ties into the larger story of [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978), where waste dumping connected to the [Mass Fusion Containment Shed](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71882) helped contaminate the lake before the war. Inside, the records point to an attempted cover up after the disastrous July 4th bass fishing tournament, which left multiple people sick, sank a boat, and forced the lake’s closure. 

You can spot the station easily by the water tower beside it. There’s also a large toolbox, cabinet, desk, and tool case that you can loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Fishing Tournament Ad](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442690)**
- **[Legal Notice](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442691)**

Locations.Title: Back Alley Bowling
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Friendly Mister Handy Robots.** 

Part of [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817), Back Alley Bowling is one of the rare places in Fallout 4 where Pre-War money can actually be used as currency. If you pay Tenpin 5,000 Pre-War money to “play” a game of bowling, he lets use one of the lanes, only to explain that they aren’t working and that you’ll have to wait for a service technician who will never arrive.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Galleria DMS Override Password](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442694)**

Locations.Title: Wicked Shipping Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A large truck can be found here. In the trailer you'll find a steamer trunk, four RadAways, and an Explosives Box - just be ready for plenty of Rads, as there's a few radioactive barrels in the back too.

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked camp has been set up next to a truck in the wilderness. You'll find a duffel bag, ammo box, and some mattresses.

Locations.Title: Reactor Level
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a hatch opposite the [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71479) generator in the [Mass Fusion Containment Shed](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71882). Hidden behind some radioactive barrels.

Once inside, you can interact with the circuit breaker to turn off the Automated Radio Alarm signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Radio Tower 3SM-U81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71990).

Locations.Title: Kendall Parking
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location accessed by using a white door beneath a large 'P' sign near the entrance to [Greenetech Genetics](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71822). Inside you'll find mole rats with land mines strapped to their backs, junk, a chem cooler, food, and a sleeping bag - all owned by a Drifter who's friends with the 'ratties'.

Locations.Title: Distress Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A secret room in [Fallon's Department Store](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71819) can be found while exploring the jewellery shop in the basement. Press the button beneath the desk to move aside a bookshelf in the south-west corner.

Inside you'll find six safes; two with Master-difficulty locks, and four with Advanced-difficulty locks, all of which can be unlocked with [Fallon's Storage Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442705) in a nearby toolbox. There's also a ham radio that you can interact with to disable the Distress Signal found when extending the satellites at [Relay Tower 0SC-527](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71991)

Locations.Title: Parking Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location a short walk north-east of [Fallon's Department Store](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71819). Inside you'll find a deadly maze filled with traps, puzzles, corpses, ghouls, and miscellaneous loot.

Reach the top floor to find a [Hot Rodder](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71463) magazine in a small shack, and two cells full of rewards (a Mini Nuke and four Fusion Cores, or chems and first aid). Press the button next to the cell you want to open, but prepare for the other cell's loot to be destroyed.

Locations.Title: Miller Family Radio Signal Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the Shelter found in an overturned blue train carriage at [Big John's Salvage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71920). Initially sealed shut - follow the electrical wires to a circuit breaker behind a nearby building, and pull the switch to gain access.

Once inside, you can interact with a ham radio to turn off the Miller Family Radio Signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0SC-527](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71991).

Other findings include a Railway Rifle, mattress, [Big John's Safe Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442711), and some junk.

Locations.Title: Supermutant Radio Broadcast Source
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Shaw High School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72024) — A hatch labelled 'storage' can be found in the basement, entered through a door in the corner of the cafeteria on the ground floor. Once inside, you can interact with the ham radio to turn off the signal activated when you extend the satellites at [Relay Tower 0SC-527](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71991).

The area is also home to junk items, corpses, and a combat knife.

Locations.Title: Propane Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked building near the road. A cooking station can be found outside, while the inside is home to a Nuka-Cola machine, sleeping bag, food, junk, and safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Apartment
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location entered through a white door on the rooftop. To reach it, use the stairs outside a building to the west, and walk along the roofs and walkways connecting them.

Inside you'll find junk, food, a toolbox with a novice-difficulty lock, and a [holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442719).

Locations.Title: Subway Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through a street-level subway entrance. Inside you'll find a caps stash, junk and two instances of Day Tripper.

Locations.Title: Joe's Spuckies
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location north-east of [Postal Square](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72014), entered through a door at the end of a curved wall. Occupied by Gunners.

Inside you'll find sleeping bags, a trunk, chems, a caps stash, several glowing fungus growths, a weapons workbench, and an armor workbench.

Locations.Title: Slim's Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location inhabited by [Slim](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442726), a chem dealer. Search the area to find a sleeping bag, chemistry station, power armor station, weapons workbench, cooking station, and miscellaneous junk / food.

Locations.Title: Joe's Spuckies Sandwich Shop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A hatch behind the counter, held shut with a master-difficulty lock, leads down to the [Southie Speakeasy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442733). It can be unlocked with [Joe's Spuckies Basement Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442732) found by exploring to the end of [Andrew Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71926).

Locations.Title: Pearwood Residences
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location

Locations.Title: Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location entered through cellar doors in the church's graveyard. Inside you'll find ghouls, cats, junk, a cooler, and an ammo box.

Locations.Title: Train Carriage Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Here, you'll find an unmarked camp where a settler has set up camp inside a shipping container on the back of a train carriage. Search the area to find food, junk, a mattress, and a safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Raider Graveyard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A tiny unmarked graveyard can be found here, with a raider kneeling over their fallen comrade.

Locations.Title: Random Encounter Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Sometimes occupied by a Random Encounter.**

You'll always find a cooking station and some mattresses here.

**Notable Loot:**
- Random

Locations.Title: Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radroaches and a Bloatfly.**

The shack is crawling with insects, but a little pest control is worth the trouble. Inside, you’ll find a toolbox, locker, tool case, and ammo box to loot, plus a chair where you can sit back and admire your handiwork as a certified bug-squisher.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Brain Fungus**: On a inside wall.
- **Glowing Fungus x2**: Beside the front stairs and inside.

Locations.Title: Train Carriage Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A derailed blue train carriage has a novice-difficulty lock on the door. Pick it open to find a mattress, cooler, and wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Pulowski Preservation Shelter Cluster
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Five Pulowski Preservation Shelters can be found around a port-a-diner in this unmarked area. Search the area to find a suitcase and cooler.

Locations.Title: Crashed UFO
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Appears here after level 20. Its little green pilot can be found in a cave to the north [here](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441526#L).

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Often occupied by random events.**

An unmarked camp in the parking lot with three mattresses, a toolbox, and a cooking station. In the back of a nearby truck there is a cooler, first aid kit and wooden crate.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Town Hall Basement
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked interior found in the basement of the town hall west of [Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054).

Pick through the advanced-difficulty lock or use the [Jamaica Plain Town Hall Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443597) to get inside.

Locations.Title: Wicked Shipping Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The door at the back of a truck trailer has a master-difficulty lock here. It can also be unlocked with a key found at the [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879).

Inside you'll find a steamer trunk, stealth boy, bottlecap mine, and gas mask with goggles.

Locations.Title: Freeway Elevator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A yellow platform in a fenced-off area can take you up to the freeway here.

Locations.Title: Camp on the Freeway
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked camp accessed via the [Freeway Elevator](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443611). Search it to find a safe with a master-difficulty lock, chemistry station, mattress, caps stash, cooking station, and plenty of junk.

Locations.Title: Hawthorne Estate
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location, entered through a red building's white door.

Locations.Title: Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked raider camp can be found here.

Locations.Title: Warren Theater
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unmarked location entered through a red door near the 'Foodstuffs' sign. Inside you'll find junk, food, a first aid box, Day Tripper, and a safe with an advanced-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Elevator
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A yellow platform next to the building can take you up to the rooftop.

Locations.Title: Dugout Inn
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - behind the All Faiths Chapel.

Locations.Title: Colonial Taphouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked bar found on the upper level of [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929).

Locations.Title: Kellogg's House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the outskirts of [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929). Can be entered by picking through the master-difficulty lock on the door, or having it unlocked for you during [Getting a Clue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354339).

Locations.Title: Diner
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location above the junkyard near [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929). Easiest to reach with a jetpack, or by performing some very tricky jumps over the rooftops of nearby buildings.

Inside you'll find a power armor station, bed, junk, and [Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443801).

Locations.Title: Anna's Cafe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked diner can be found next to the road here. Inside you'll find food, junk, a first aid box, a sleeping bag, and a 10mm pistol.

Locations.Title: Car Tree
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radscorpions.**

There is a small campsite beneath the tree, with a cooking station, two sleeping bags, and a duffle bag to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Cram x2**: Beside the cooking station.

Locations.Title: Super Mutant Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked building has been taken over by Super Mutants. Search it to find raider corpses, junk, meat bags, a first aid kit, and bed. On the top floor, you can find a steamer trunk.

Locations.Title: Garage Playground
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location where you can find a playground (occasionally inhabited by raiders). Search the area to find sleeping bags inside the UFO, and a garage with a power armor station, weapons workbench, junk, and miscellaneous containers inside.

Locations.Title: Floating Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A small outpost can be found floating here. Search it to find miscellaneous containers, junk, plants, food, and two sleeping bags.

Locations.Title: Joe’s Spuckies Coffee Shop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked diner filled with junk, food, and a cooler.

Locations.Title: Painted Statue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A raider can be found painting a statue here. Search the area to find a cooking station, sleeping bag, day tripper, alcohol, and suitcase. 

You can also find a chem cooler in the statue's hand.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Rowboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located along the lakeside northeast of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the rowboat contains a cooler and a few items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Combat Knife**: Inside the rowboat.
- **Fishing Rod**: Inside the rowboat.

Locations.Title: Mole Rat Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mole Rats.**

Located east of the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916), the colony has a pile of branches with dead bodies and a duffle bag to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Random Encounter House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Sometimes occupied by a Random Encounter.**

You'll always find a cooler and some junk here.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Brain Fungus**: Growing on a wall inside the house.

Locations.Title: Raider-Occupied Buildings
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
East of the [Super Duper Mart](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71813), raiders have taken over three buildings and built walkways between them.

Search the buildings to find an ammo box, jet, chem box, cooking station, and safe with an expert-difficulty lock.

Locations.Title: Cottage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An unmarked location by the waterfront.

Search it to find a baseball bat, junk, combat rifle, and a single raider.

Locations.Title: Forged Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked camp in the woods, inhabited by a small group of Forge enemies. Visited during [Pyromaniac](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441416), a quest added in the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked camp, featuring a small overhang attached to some trees. Search the area to find a duffle bag and flip lighter, with a settler sometimes in the area too.

Locations.Title: Military Vehicles
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: An unmarked location where some military vehicles lay by the roadside, protected by robots. Search the vehicle on the truck bed to find an ammo box and wooden crate inside.

Locations.Title: Gunner Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Gunners.**

The outpost is built into a broken-off section of the elevated highway. You can enter from the north side, where the collapsed highway forms a ramp up to the outpost. On the lower level, the western elevator leads up to the upper level, while the eastern elevator goes down to the ground. 

A sentry bot patrols the southern half of the mid-level. The outpost also contains a cabinet, first aid kit, ammo box, lunch pail, large toolbox, novice-locked wooden crate to loot, plus  a weapons workbench, power station, and two beds. 

**Notable Loot:** 
- **[Fusion Core x2](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606684)** 
- **Charging Laser Sniper Rifle**: On the upper level, beside a bed. 
- **Blood Pack x3**: All on a shelf on the lower level. 
- **Nuka-Cola**: On a cabinet below the outpost and inside a fridge up top.
- **TV Dinner Tray**: On a crate on the upper level. 
- **Aluminum Can**: On a crate on the upper level.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located south of [Thicket Excavations](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71986), the bus has a first aid kit beside the driver’s seat to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Hilltop Ammo Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radstags.**

At the top of the hill, two ammo boxes can be found near a bathtub, inside a safe with its door removed. No other loot is present.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Concord Pharmacy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northwest of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the pharmacy contains a first aid kit, tool case, ammo box, and an expert-locked wall safe on the second floor to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Irradiated Thistle Field
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

A cluster of hard-to-find Irradiated Thistle, with a basket of assorted items in the middle. 

*Be careful while harvesting, as the plants can spew radiation if you stand too close.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **RadAway**: In the wooden basket.
- **Instamash**:  In the wooden basket.
- **Pork N' Beans**: In the wooden basket.
- **Potato Crisps**: In the wooden basket.
- **Toy Car**: In the wooden basket.
- **Hubflower x2**: Growing beside the field.
- **Irradiated Thistle x8**: Growing throughout the field.

Locations.Title: Destroyed House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Bloodbug Hatchling.**

Little remains of the house beyond two crumbling walls, with a dead radstag, first aid kit, and toolbox to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Buffout**: Beside the toolbox.
- **Mentats**: Underneath the mannequin in the bathtub. 
- **Glowing Fungus**: Harvestable within the ruined house.

Locations.Title: Deathclaw Nest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A deathclaw has built a nest beneath the rocky overhang here.

Search the area to find some corpses, and loot the nest itself to find a Deathclaw Egg.

Locations.Title: Submerged House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A wrecked house and its long-dead inhabitant can be found just off the south-western shore of [Spectacle Island](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72056) here.

Loot mainly consists of junk and a bottle of vodka, but two bottles of Nuka-Cola Quantum can be found in the rubble near the fridge. Swim near it to knock them loose.

Locations.Title: Raider Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A short walk south-west of [Sunshine Tidings Co-op](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72029).  Note that you may be ambushed by two raiders when approaching.

Locations.Title: Boobytrapped Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A safe with a master-difficulty lock can be found in front of Lexington Apartments, surrounded by wrecked cars and protected by two land mines.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Train
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Multiple carriages have split apart here. Search them to find ammo boxes, a wooden crate, and some [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71699).

Locations.Title: Shack Beneath the Flyover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Home of a Radscorpion.

Search it to find a bed, gum drops, junk, welding goggles, and tool case. Outside, there's a cage with an expert-difficulty lock holding four Radaway and a caps stash.

Locations.Title: Cabins
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Search them to find a steamer trunk, cooler, mattress, miscellaneous containers, and food.

Outside, you'll find a cooking station and _creative_ outhouse.

Locations.Title: Lakeside Cabin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Search it to find a toolbox, chem box, a suitcase with a novice-difficulty lock, and some junk. A cooler can be found at the end of the nearby pier.

Locations.Title: Gunner Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A small number of Gunners have taken up a defensive position on the road here, complete with a turret. Search the area to find ammo, a wooden crate, and a locker.

Follow the road, and you'll reach a [Wrecked Bus](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543128#L) with two beds and footlockers.

Locations.Title: Junkpile
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Across a dirt road from the adjacent [Scrapyard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=563523), the small junkpile contains a few scattered items to scavenge, including a cooler and desk.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Nuka-Cola x2**: On the desk and atop the overturned wastebasket.
- **Sugar Bomb**: On the desk.

Locations.Title: Shack Beneath the Flyover
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Bloatflies**

Has a suitcase, wooden crate, and toolbox to loot, along with a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=604047)**
- **Gwinnett Brew**: Inside an enamel bucket beside the toolbox.
- **Beer**: Inside an enamel bucket beside the toolbox.
- **Baked Bloatfly**: On a BBQ.
- **Cram**: Beside ham radio and sleeping bag.

Locations.Title: Billboard Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

The camp is directly under the billboard and includes a cooking station, a sleeping bag, and a metal box to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Aluminum Can x2**: Both beside the sleeping bag.

Locations.Title: Locked Diner
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Get through an Advanced-difficulty lock to find a first aid kit, cooking stove, cash register, sweet roll, refrigerator, and junk.

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
By the roadside. Inside you'll find a power armor station, armor workbench, weapons workbench, caps stash, 10mm pistol, miscellaneous containers, and junk.

Stairs behind the building lead to the rooftop that's home to a mattress, radaway, stimpak, wooden crate, ammo box, and sniper rifle.

Locations.Title: Deathclaw Nest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In a small cave beside the water.

Locations.Title: Mirelurk Mausoleum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A lonely mausoleum.

Search it to find a Longshoreman outfit outside and conspicuously-placed Mirelurk egg inside. If you take the latter, a Mirelurk King will spawn.

Locations.Title: Hilltop Bunker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
At the top of a hill you'll find a concrete building with an Advanced-difficulty door. A Sentry Bot will become active as you approach.

Inside you'll find a Trunk and Wooden Crate.

Locations.Title: Cabin and Treehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On the island. You'll need to scale a fallen tree to get inside the treehouse, where the reward is varied junk, a baseball bat, and a Vault-Tec Lunchbox.

In the cabin you'll find an expert-difficulty safe, novice-difficulty suitcase, lunch pail, and junk.

Locations.Title: Ruined Power Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Home of a Deathclaw.

Locations.Title: Nahant Sewers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation.

Visited during [Home Away from Home](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510366) after looting the [Nahant Sewer Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510392) from the [Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369)

Locations.Title: Underground Sewer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Required:** Own and install The Varmint Rifle creation.

Locations.Title: Underground Facility
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation.

[Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753) - At the back of the area you'll access after blowing through a wall via explosives. Immediately after entering, you'll need [Labs Card Level 1](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510756) to get through some doors.

Locations.Title: Wright’s Inn
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, but Raiders are nearby.**

Located northwest of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the inn has a trash can, mailbox, and Nuka-Cola machine outside, as well as a cooler inside on the first floor, to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Desk Fan**: On the front counter on the first floor.

Locations.Title: Well-Guarded Caravan
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On this hilltop, you'll find a caravan protected by a machine gun turret and sentry bot.

Search the inside to find two caps stashes, a sequin dress, deathclaw steak, wine, junk, fashionable glasses, and a bed.

Locations.Title: Bathtub Barbecue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

A bathtub has been turned into a makeshift barbecue, where it looks like a campfire inside a bathtub was being used to heat up a stop sign to cook the meat on top of it. There is a toolbox and cooler to loot nearby, but no sign of the intrepid chef.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mirelurk Meat**: On top of the stop sign.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Occupied by wild mongrels and a corpse on a mattress.

Locations.Title: Makeshift Outhouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Radroach. I hope he wiped.**

The crudely built outhouse has a first aid kit to loot, in case you need to treat any splinters from using the toilet.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Dirty Water**: Beside the toilet.

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occasionally occupied by Raiders.**

Across the road from the [billboard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441263), there is a toolbox to loot, along with a crate containing a few items.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Stimpak](https://i.ibb.co/ynbQ2GkS/Stimpak-Campsite.jpg)**
- **Buffout**: In a small wooden crate.
- **Addictol**: In a small wooden crate.
- **Bourbon**: In a small wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Cosy Corner
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Tucked up against a building, beneath some fire escapes. Search it for a bed, junk, cooking stove, food, and purified water.

Random encounters can be triggered nearby, but the corner itself is always empty.

Locations.Title: Crashed Cargo Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Search a blue container on the lowest tier to find a First Aid Kit, then climb to the top and navigate the mazelike containers - one holds a wooden crate, one holds a locked (Novice) toolbox, and one holds two locked safes; one Expert, one Advanced. Right outside of that same container is a locked (Novice) safe.

Locations.Title: Floating Platform
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Search it to find junk, a lunch pail, wooden crate, locker, and bed.

A lone skeleton and dog house implies this platform was once home to a man and his dog.

Locations.Title: Observation Hut
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Bloatflies.**

Beside the road overlooking the [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879). You’ll find a mattress, a cooler, and plenty of empty and full bottles scattered around. 

Next to the hut is a culvert with radioactive barrels and a skeleton, where you can also find a novice-locked toolbox.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Whiskey**: On a small shelf beside the airplane seat.
- **Nuka Cola**: Inside the fridge beside the hut.
- **Gwinnett Stout**: Inside the fridge beside the hut.
- **Cram**: Inside the fridge beside the hut.

Locations.Title: Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Beside the road beneath the railway bridge. Search it to find a suitcase, wooden crate, and junk.

Locations.Title: Deathclaw Nest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
You’ll find a Fat Man and ammo box here.

Watch out for a Deathclaw that'll drop from the ceiling.

Locations.Title: Ammo Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Radstags.**

At the bottom of this transmission tower, two ammo boxes sit beside a dead raider and a pool of blood.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Hubflower**: Beside a leg of the tower.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On top of the freeway, reached via [Gunner Camp](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508634#L) and some bridges over the gaps in the road, you'll reach a wrecked bus. A turret sits on top, and inside you'll find two beds and two footlockers.

Locations.Title: Gangster's Paradise
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unmarked gun shop in the north-western end of Forest Marsh.  The bottom floor has a duffel bag beside two gangster cutouts, and multiple ammo types in a display case. You'll also find a submachine gun and locked (average) safe nearby.

Head upstairs for an ammo box, weapons workbench, junk, and more miscellaneous containers.

Finally, make your way to the rooftop for [Sheila's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71284) alongside two sleeping bags, a caps stash, steamer trunk, ammo box, and cooler.

Locations.Title: Scavengers Hideout
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Just down the street from the USS Constitution, this spot is the hideout of the Scavengers, who are in conflict with the ship’s robotic crew during [Last Voyage of the U.S.S Constitution](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516529). Inside you will find a weapons bench, and you should watch out for mines placed around the back door.

Locations.Title: Cambridge Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located north of Kendall Hospital, the camp is set up in the ruins of several homes with a bonfire in the center. There’s a cooking station by the bonfire and a steamer trunk on the second floor of one of the houses with a shredded cloth hanging from it.

Locations.Title: Natick Banks Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Houses a Power Armor Station and a regular Armor Station.

Locations.Title: Lake Cochituate Homes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Ruined homes along Lake Cochituate occupied by raiders. A chem box with a novice lock is on the second floor of the house with a boat crashed into it.

Locations.Title: Cutler Bend Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the eastern shore of the shipwreck is a trailer with an advanced lock. Inside are a stimpack, radaway, a duffle bag, and a first aid kit. Mirelurks and their eggs are in the area.

Locations.Title: Marowski's Chem Lab
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Accessed from the roof of the [Four Leaf Fishpacking Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71900), this location is Marowski’s hidden chem lab, visited as part of [Diamond City Blues](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516525#L).

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located north of Wilson Atomatoys Factory, this unmarked Red Rocket features an armor workbench, weapons workbench, and a power armor station.

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located north of NH&M Freight Depot, this unmarked Red Rocket features an armor workbench, weapons workbench, and a power armor station.

Locations.Title: Elevator to Raider Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located east of Postal Square, an elevator takes you up to a small raider camp on the rooftop of the building above. From there, you can traverse across the rooftops.

Locations.Title: Bar & Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located southeast of Nahant Chapel by the unmarked wharf, this two-story structure can be looted and contains a Steamer Trunk on the second floor. It is occupied by random hostiles.

Locations.Title: Seaside Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located along the coastline east of the Museum of Witchcraft. Inside is an assortment of junk and a safe with an expert lock.

Locations.Title: Half-Sunken Tugboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The half-sunken tugboat sits just off the dock north of the Rook Family House. A stimpak can be found on the section of the boat that remains above water. A first aid container is located underwater on the ship’s mid-deck.

Locations.Title: Salem Wharf
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located southeast of the Rook Family House in Salem. The structures along Salem’s wharf contain little to loot, aside from a toolbox in one of the buildings.

Locations.Title: Drumlin Diner (Salem)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located east of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home. Inside is an assortment of food and kitchen junk that can be looted.

Locations.Title: Military Surplus (Salem)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located southwest of the Rook Family House. A master-locked safe is on the first floor, while the second floor contains a Fat Man, a cooler container, and a terminal for one of the town’s turrets.

Locations.Title: Restaurant & Office (Salem)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located southeast of the Rook Family House in Salem. The restaurant contains assorted restaurant junk. The office building has desks and drawers to loot, with mirelurk eggs and a turret control terminal on the top floor. The roof of the adjacent building can be reached through the office building, where another turret control terminal is located.

Locations.Title: Radioactive Raft
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the water north of [Mahkra Fishpacking Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71884) and south of the coastline leading to the [Nakano Residence](https://fallout4map.com/?locationIds=72719). 

There is a Glowing One hanging out on the raft, which is radioactive thanks to the barrels keeping it afloat being radioactive themselves. There is no notable loot on the raft itself, but a nearby sunken tugboat does have a wooden crate inside.

Locations.Title: Ruined Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the northeast corner of [Hyde Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72009), found by the home's toilet is a Day Tripper along with other drugs.

Locations.Title: Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the southwest corner of [Hyde Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72009), with a random group of hostiles inside. On the second floor, you’ll find an ammo box, a cooler, and a wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Vault 88 Manhole
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

The unmarked Vault 88 Manhole by [Milton General Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71909) becomes available as an entry and exit point while clearing and opening up [Vault 88](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=79965) during the Vault-Tec Workshop DLC questline. The area within the vault where this exit is located serves as a possible spawn point for attackers during settlement attacks, so it is recommended to place turrets and other defenses there.

Locations.Title: Transmission Tower Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though wild mongrels are nearby.**

Under the transmission tower beside the [Ranger Cabin](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71874), there is a duffle bag and a toolbox to loot at base of the tower.

**Notable Loot:**
- **.45 Round x16**: Beside the duffle bag.
- **Hubflower**: Beside one of the tower's legs.

Locations.Title: Scrapyard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Wild Mongrels.**

This scrapyard contains an assortment of vehicles and household appliances, along with a wooden crate, first aid kit, dryer, two cap stashes inside a doorless safe, and a mattress that can be used for sleeping.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Glowing Fungus**: Growing beside a overturned pickup truck.
- **Wild Corn x4**: Growing on the north side of the scrapyard.

Locations.Title: Cliffside Houses
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located on a cliffside north of [Concord](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72004), the three houses are sealed off. Behind the middle house, however, there is a barbeque with an ammo box underneath to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Combat Knife**: On the barbeque in the backyard.
- **Radroach Meat**: On the barbeque in the backyard.
- **Wild Mutfruit x3**: Harvestable behind the houses.

Locations.Title: Enclave Encampment
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by the Enclave.**

Located east of [The Slog](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72041), the unmarked enclave encampment is part of the creation club quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417), which was added with the Next-Gen Update. To progress the quest, use the Enclave Field Operations Terminal and select “Download Homing Beacon Frequency.” This will direct you to the Glowing Sea and the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850). 

The Enclave Communications Tower at the encampment can be interacted with to deactivate it, preventing the Enclave from respawning at the site. Loot at the encampment includes two ammo boxes, two Enclave crates, two Enclave ammo boxes, and a dead pack brahmin.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Hellfire Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440709)**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=598143)**

Locations.Title: Lakeside Dock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Wild Mongrels**

Located east across the lake from [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), this dock contains a trash can, a cooler, and a first aid kit under the dock to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Carrot Flower x2**: Harvestable beside a log near the dock.

Locations.Title: Rubbish Pit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Wild Mongrels.**

Located across the lake northeast of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the pit offers little to loot beyond a dresser, but it is home to a pack of three wild mongrels.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Mirelurk Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

Located west of the [Robotics Disposal Ground](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71916), the shoreline colony is home to several mirelurks buried beneath the sand, ready to ambush anyone foolish enough to steal their eggs.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mirelurk Egg x7**: Harvestable from the egg clusters.
- **Glowing Fungus x3**: Harvestable around the colony's area.

Locations.Title: Lakeside Debris
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a nearby Scavenger.**

Located across the lake northeast of [Sanctuary](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72035), the remains of a human skeleton can be found beside a suitcase, with several items nearby to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Leather Left Leg**: Beside the suitcase.
- **Leather Right Leg**: Beside the suitcase.
- **Bloatfly Meat**: Inside the enamel bucket beside the suitcase.
- **Fishing Rod**: Beside the suitcase.
- **Human Bone x3**: What remains of the skeleton.

Locations.Title: Hardware Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, but surrounded by Raiders.**

Located across the street west of the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), the store has a chem box, filing cabinet, and two cabinets to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Hard Hat**: On a cabinet on the first floor.
- **Used Oil Can**: On the store's shelving.
- **Aluminum Can**: On a cabinet on the first floor.
- **Bag of Fertilizer**: On a cart on the first floor.

Locations.Title: Concord Civic Access
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks, Mole Rats, and Radroaches.**

Located underneath [Concord](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72004), the Concord Civic Access has three unmarked entrances across the town:

- [West](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441297)
- [East](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401373)
- [Central](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401374) *It becomes available during [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644)*

Within the civic access area, there is a cooler, tool case, three toolboxes, chem box, two first aid kits, wooden crate, two desks, three filing cabinets, duffle bag, and a steamer trunk to loot. The area immediately beyond the [Central](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401374) entrance becomes accessible during the main quest [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644).

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Taboo Tattoos](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71350)**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71494)**
- **Vault-Tec Lunchbox x2**: Near the fusion core and central entrance.
- **Day Tripper**: Beside a teddy bear and chem box.

Locations.Title: Derailed Train Cars
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of [Somerville Place](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72053), the two derailed orange train cars have a wooden crate beside them that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Skeletal Remains
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

The unfortunate individual’s remains lie in a shallow crevasse within a rocky outcropping, next to their suitcase.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441264)**
- **Machete**: On top of the suitcase.
- **Dirty Water**: Beside the skeleton's head.

Locations.Title: Crashed Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

The bus has crashed into a tree, with a cooler available to loot at the back.
**Notable Loot:**

- **Teddy Bear**: Sitting on one of the seats.

Locations.Title: Culvert Mirelurks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

Beneath a truck and flatbed trailer with the partially overturned boat, there’s a culvert filled with Mirelurk eggs. You can also reach it by following the lower branch of the stream loop that runs east from [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978). Be careful during combat, as the nearby [Super Mutant Behemoth](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508735) may take an interest in the commotion.

**Notable Loot:**
