- **Mirelurk Egg x18**: Inside the culvert.
- **Brain Fungus**: Growing beside the west side of the culvert.
- **Hubflower**: Growing beside the boat above the culvert.
- **Bloodleaf x3**: Growing on both sides of the culvert.

Locations.Title: Lake Quannapowitt Boat Launch
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

Near [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978)'s [monitoring station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442689), the boat launch has a cooler, novice-locked toolbox, and dead scavenger to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Fishing Tournament Ad](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440521)**
- **[Fishing Tournament Ad](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440522)**

Locations.Title: Sunken Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Novice-locked. Inside a sunken van at the bottom of [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978). Wear power armor, or be ready for ~13 rads when you get close.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Run Aground Rowboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

On the shoreline next to [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817), you’ll find a small boat on [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978). Onboard are the skeletal remains of someone whose fishing trip clearly didn’t end well.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Pipe Pistol**: On the rowboat.
- **Fishing Rod**: On the rowboat.

Locations.Title: Dilapidated Billboard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Climb onto the billboard to find what appears to be a sniper’s nest.

- **Short Pipe Bolt-Action Rifle**: On top of a crate.
- **Welding Goggles**: On top of a crate.
- **Silt Bean x6**: Beside the billboard.
- **Carrot Flower**: Beside the billboard.

Locations.Title: Elevated Highway Access Point
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

This spot marks a buckled section of the elevated highway. You can reach the mid-level from either the west or east side of the highway. There’s a cargo container filled with empty washers that also has a chem box inside, along with a green trailer nearby containing a wooden crate. 

To get up to the upper level, jump from the top of the blue truck onto the protruding beam. Above the wreckage below, you’ll find a red pickup truck with a toolbox available to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Elevated Highway Bus
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

At the very end of the elevated highway’s mid-level, you’ll find a bus with a novice-locked explosives box inside.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Crashed Flatbed Truck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, with Bloodbug Hatchlings nearby.**

Beside a transmission tower, the trailer has two cigarette machines, an ice cooler, and a Nuka-Cola machine to loot, along with a port-a-diner to try your luck on. The Nuka-Cola machine is somewhat unique, as it always contains a Nuka-Cola Quantum, while the other bottles inside are random.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71679)**

Locations.Title: Random Encounter Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Sometimes occupied by a Random Encounter.**

**Notable Loot:**
- Random

Locations.Title: Random Encounter Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Sometimes occupied by a Random Encounter.**

**Notable Loot:**
- **Bloodleaf x5:** Around the area.

Locations.Title: Parking Lot
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Bloatfly.**

The parking lot is at the end of the road that goes past the [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879), with a large tool chest on top of a wrecked van and a caps stash beside a nearby car frame.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Glowing Fungus**: Harvestable beside the remains of a van.
- **Hubflower**: Harvestable beside the fence.

Locations.Title: Quincy Police Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Character:** Tessa

Locations.Title: Lake Quannapowitt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks, Bloodbugs, and Bloatflies.**

In the game’s lore, Lake Quannapowitt was deliberately polluted with waste connected to the [Mass Fusion Containment Shed](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71882), leaving it irradiated in the present day. You may want to wear some power armor before getting in the water. 

Mirelurks can be found along most of the shoreline, except on the eastern side, where you’re more likely to run into bloodbugs and bloatflies. Along with the [sunken steamer trunk](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=440519), there’s also a sunken safe, a cooler inside a fridge, and a toolbox to loot beneath the lake. The last three are all near radioactive barrels, giving off ~13 rads when you get close.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Tato Flower x3**: Growing along the eastern side of the lake.
- **Bloodleaf x7+**: Growing along the eastern side of the lake.

Locations.Title: Dark Hollow Pond
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Noteworthy Loot:**
- Bloodleaf x4

Locations.Title: Walden Pond
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Character:** Walter

**Character:** Whiplash

**Character:** Bear

**Character:** Tweez

Locations.Title: Neponset Park
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

There's a bed and Steamer Trunk in a novice locked cabin.

Locations.Title: Murkwater Construction Site
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Prerequisite:** Clear the area of hostiles, including a Mirelurk Queen.

Locations.Title: The Prydwen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Arrives in the Commonwealth at the beginning of [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546).

Locations.Title: Thicket Excavations
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Raiders & Mirelurks.**

Initially, the abandoned granite quarry is flooded and cannot be fully explored. To drain the water, complete the side quest [Pull the Plug](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355598), given by Sully Mathis, who can be found beside the large yellow pump at the southeast corner of the excavation. 

After completing the quest and returning several days later, the water will be gone and a large raider stronghold will have been built inside the quarry. Sully is revealed to be a raider boss and can be found at the bottom of the excavation wearing raider gear.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Taboo Tattoos](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71346)**
- **[Sully's Journal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441301)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441302)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441300)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=605777)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=605776)**
- **Jet x4**: By trunk, crate, & weapons bench; inside trailer.
- **Psycho x2**: By a weapons workbench and a stimpak.
- **Buffout**: By a stimpak in a trailer.
- **Bourbon**: By a cinderblock wall on the mid level.
- **Nuka Cola x3**: By weapons workbench and a stimpak.
- **Dirty Water x3**: By weapons bench, chemistry station, chem box.
- **Noodle Cup**: Near a stimpak.
- **Sugar Bombs**: In trailer with chem box.
- **Dandy Boy Apples**: Inside the upper rim northside shack.
- **Gas Canister x5**: By barrel, crate, weapons bench
- **Used Oil Can x3**: By elevator, weapons bench, stimpak.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: Inside a trailer, 
- **Aluminum Can x16**: Scattered throughout the quarry.

Locations.Title: Dunwich Borers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Expect Forged Raiders at first, then Feral Ghouls as you descend.

**Notable Loot**: 
- [Astoundingly Awesome Tales](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71380)
- [Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71551)
- [Sneak Bobblehead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71271)
- [Dunwich - Tim Shoots](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508904)
- [Dunwich - Management](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508905)
- [Kremvh's Tooth](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71805)
- [Mini Nuke x2](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71553)
- Stimpak x2
- [Dunwich Borers Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=508906)

Locations.Title: Mass Gravel & Sand
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mole Rats.**

There is a weapons workbench in the office building,

Locations.Title: Quincy Quarries
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by raiders. This location becomes relabeled as Vault 88 once you discover its entrance at the bottom of Quincy Quarries, where a dug-out hole leads into the marble.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Nuka-Cherry](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=562611)
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=562612)

Locations.Title: Radio Tower 3SM-U81
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick-up new radio signals:
- [Greenbriar Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=147773)
- [Nautical Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=157200)
- [Automated Radio Alarm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442697)

Locations.Title: Relay Tower 0SC-527
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick up new radio signals:
- [Distress Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442704)
- [Miller Family Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442710)
- [Supermutant Radio Broadcast](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442715)

Locations.Title: Relay Tower 0MC-810
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick-up new radio signals:
- [Default Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=156183)
- [Separated Family Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72005)
- Distress Signal ([The Lost Patrol](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350565))

Locations.Title: Relay Tower 0BB-915
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick up new radio signals:
- [Distress Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441218)
- [Raider Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441219)
- [Civil Alert System Broadcast](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441216)

Locations.Title: Relay Tower 1DL-109
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick up new radio signals:
- [Boston City Works Beacon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441517#L)
- [Distress Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441518#L)
- [Garbled Radio Beacon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441526#L)

Locations.Title: Gunners Plaza
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Character:** Ryder

**Character:** Cruz

**Character** Captain Wes

Locations.Title: Relay Tower 0DB-521
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Use the terminal to extend the satellite array and pick up new radio signals:
- [Skylanes 1665 Mayday signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441408)
- [Unintelligible Radio Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71868)
- [Distress Signal](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71862)

Also visited as part of the Best of Three side quest added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update, after finding the [Gunner Holotape](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441405). Interact with the gunner corpse here to find [a new radio signal to follow](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441409).

Locations.Title: Outpost Zimonja
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Raiders.**

The outpost can become a settlement after killing the raiders and their leader, [Boomer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606687).

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Astoundingly Awesome Tales](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71411)**
- **[Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71570)**

Locations.Title: Hugo's Hole
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Located east of Dunwich Borers, the area has high radiation and traps as you proceed to the spot where you’ll find Hugo’s dead body, a trunk, a chemistry station, and several notable items.

**Character:** Hugo

**Notable Loot:**
- Hazmat Suit
- Mr. Handy Model Kit
- [Dunwich - Hugo's Struggle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71998)

Locations.Title: Crater House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Radioactive area, Children of Atom around. Three armed nuke mines present.

Locations.Title: Boston Police Rationing Site
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A well-secured building. To get inside, follow the steps below.
1. Jump onto the white container near the large doors
2. Climb on top of the train
3. Jump across to an orange container
4. Turn to the right and jump to another white container near the wooden boards
5. Jump onto the container being held up by the construction vehicle
6. Finally, jump down onto the sloped roof to get inside through a hole in the wall.

Locations.Title: Railroad HQ
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [Old North Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71870) - In the basement.

Locations.Title: Bedford Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Feral Ghouls.**

The station is made up of a train switch tower, several train cars, and a warehouse at the northern end of the area, near the road that passes  [Thicket Excavations](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71986). 

Inside of the unattached blue train cars, there is a [Railroad](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71969) dead drop hidden in a barrel, with the Railroad’s dead drop sign beside it. 

The station has a toolbox, three filing cabinets, two desks, a tool case, a cooler, a first aid kit, and a steamer trunk to loot. There is also a sleeping bag inside the train car still attached to the locomotive.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Cargo Handler's Note](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443396)**
- **[Dutchman's Instructions](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443398)**
- **[Helena's Instructions](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443397)**
- **[Bedford Station Recording](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71342)**
- **[Railway Rifle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=606634)**
- **Muzzled .45 Pipe Pistol**: On a train car with marble blocks. 
- **Short Pipe Rifle**: Inside a orange train car.
- **Nuka-Cola**: Inside the train car beside the locomotive.
- **Gas Canister**: In the warehouse.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: In a crate in the switch tower.
- **Used Oil Can**: In a crate in the switch tower.
- **Flip Lighter**: In the warehouse beside a terminal.
- **Desk Fan 2**: In the warehouse and switch tower.
- **Lantern**: On a crate beside a blue train car.

Locations.Title: NH&M Freight Depot
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Location can only be discovered after completing *The Big Dig* quest which is started by Bobby No Nose in Goodneighbor.

Locations.Title: Rook Family House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Barney Rook, the lone resident of Salem, can be found in a bunker on the first floor of the house.

Locations.Title: Concord
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Raiders.**

This is the first location the player is directed to visit after leaving Sanctuary during the main quest [Out of Time](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354336). The quest can be progressed by reaching the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849) on the south side of town and meeting with [Preston Garvey](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350195).

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Perception Bobblehead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71259)**
- **[RobCo Fun!](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71349)**
- **[Atomic Command](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71280)**
- **[Taboo Tattoos](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71350)**
- **[Log - SSG Michael Daly](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=123323)**
- **[Corvega Storage Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=509929)**
- **[T-45 Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71701)**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71467)**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71494)**
- **[Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=123325)**

Locations.Title: West Everett Estates
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

Locations.Title: Dogmeat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Walk up and pet the good boy (ask Dogmeat to follow)

**Companion Quest:** None

**Romanceable?** No

**Affinity Interests:** None; Dogmeat has no concerns for human affairs

Unlike other companions, Dogmeat has no affinity system; instead of earning the companion perk through behavior, you must spend skill points on the level-up perk chart.

**Companion Perk:** Attack Dog (CH 4)
1. [LVL 1] Your faithful canine companion can hold an enemy, giving you a greater chance to hit them in V.A.T.S.
2. [LVL 9] When your dog holds an enemy, there's a chance he'll cripple the limb he's biting.
3. [LVL 25] When your dog holds an enemy, there's a chance he'll cause them to bleed.
4. [LVL 31] When adventuring with your dog, you take 10% less damage.
