Wandering around the dock.

Part of [Dog Rescue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510195).

Locations.Title: Husky
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Husky creation.

Wandering around the ruined houses.

Part of [Dog Rescue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510195).

Locations.Title: Yellow Labrador
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Yellow Labrador creation.

Part of [Dog Rescue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510195).

Locations.Title: Black Labrador
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Black Labrador creation.

Wandering around the cars.

Part of [Dog Rescue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510195).

Locations.Title: Chocolate Labrador
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Chocolate Labrador creation.

Wandering around a picnic area.

Part of [Dog Rescue](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510195).

Locations.Title: National Guard Officer's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[National Guard Training Yard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71931), Recruitment Office — Inside a steel desk in one of the offices on the second floor, across from the stairwell and giant hole in the floor.

**Unlocks:**
- Recruitment Office: Barracks Access Terminal
- Barracks: Armory Mangement Terminal
- Armory: Power Armor Storage Terminal

Locations.Title: Drinkin' Buddy Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[The Shamrock Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71834) - On top of the shelf to the left of the control pod, near the flashing red light. 

Unlocks the terminal next to the control pod.

Locations.Title: Blood Clinic Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Greater Mass Blood Clinic](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71908) - three can be found throughout the building.

1 - On top of a desk in a small room on the upper floor.    
2 - Next to the door it unlocks, near a skeleton in the corridor by the basement stairs.    
3 - On top of a cabinet in the basement.

Unlocks a blue door on the ground floor, and a safe in the locked lab on the upper floor.

Locations.Title: Croup Bedroom Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located on [Croup Manor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72045)'s second floor. Unlocks a bedroom on the third floor.

Locations.Title: Croup Basement Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the third floor bedroom. Unlocks the [Croup Manor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72045) Basement.

Locations.Title: General Atomics ID Card
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[General Atomics Factory](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71901) — immediately after entering, go up the stairs in front of you and pick through a door with an expert-difficulty lock on the floor above. The card can then be found on a desk in the corner (and may be underneath a clipboard).

This ID lets you identify yourself as the General Atomics Director when visiting the [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817).

Locations.Title: Galleria Supervisor's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817) — Inside the Mr. Handy-shaped building in the center of the plaza, near a skeleton left of the desk.

After hacking the Director Override Terminal [Master] at the center of the console, this password can be used to override The Director's commands and either reopen the park, shut down the robots, or make them self-destruct. This is an alternative method to completing [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376) if the player was unable to find the ID card or persuade The Director robot.

Note: This password and terminal are useless after the Galleria has been successfully reopened.

Locations.Title: Galleria Outlet Workroom Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817), Outlet Store — Inside the cash register. Unlocks the nearby Expert-locked employee doors.

Locations.Title: USCG Lockup Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a footlocker in the [Sunken Boat](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441210). Used to get into the evidence room on the ground floor of the [Coast Guard Pier](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71934)

Locations.Title: Fiddler's Green Trailer Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a safe in the brick building near the pool in [Fiddler's Green Trailer Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71860). Pick the lock, or use a terminal on the desk nearby to get it open.

Locations.Title: Control Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Given to you by Harvey (or taken from his corpse), found inside the [Nuka-World Transit Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117903). Used to start the Nuka-Express.

*Nuka-World DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Federal Ration Stockpile Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of [Red Tourette](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71946), found deep inside the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857). She's easiest to find when entering through a hatch in the [Lonely Chapel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71867).

Used to unlock the terminal with a master-difficulty lock near the stockpile's main entrance.

Locations.Title: Intel Room Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside an Instrument Case in the corner of the room where you find a [Legendary Radroach](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71939) in [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021).

Used to unlock a security gate near the entrance.

Locations.Title: Church Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Next to the preacher's stand inside [Hopesmarch Pentecostal Church](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71868). Used to unlock a safe in the corner of the upper floor.

An additional key can be found in the same room as the safe, underneath a bench near some boxes.

Locations.Title: Enclave Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on the Enclave colonel at the bottom of the basement in [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850). 

Unlocks the nearby Enclave CO's Terminal, which can be used to end the lockdown triggered when the player first enters the building. 

The terminal also contains the “Encampment Distribution” option. Selecting it, then choosing each of the three listed Enclave encampments in the Commonwealth, starts three miscellaneous quests to visit them.
- [Southern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401453#L)
- [Eastern Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401454#L)
- [Western Enclave Encampment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401455#L)

Locations.Title: College Square Station Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
College Square Station Interior - on the lowest level. Turn right from the train driver's carriage to find a room at the end of a short corridor, where this key is on top of a cabinet.

Used to unlock all doors in the station, but is most useful when used a few floors above to get the [Live & Love](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71448) magazine.

Locations.Title: Monsignor Plaza Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On a countertop in the south-western corner of [Monsignor Plaza](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72019)'s top floor.

Used to unlock a door back out into the open world on the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Evans Way Cul-de-Sac Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of one of the raiders inside the [Evans Way Cul-de-Sac](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442039) building.

Used to unlock the other gates / doors leading to the area where you find the building.

Locations.Title: Raider Atrium Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a metal box near a turret on the top floor of [Massachusetts State House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71836). You'll reach the area it's in after fighting your way through the mirelurk-infested basement.

Used to unlock a red door with a master-difficulty lock at the end of the room to the north.

Locations.Title: First Mate's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the inventory of the First Mate, a Glowing One on the [Yangtze](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71970)'s lower deck. You'll find him in a room with glowing red lights after going down the stairs at the submarine's northern end.

Locations.Title: RobCo Sales & Service Center Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[RobCo Sales & Service Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=87934) - on top of a filing cabinet against the building's eastern wall, near the door that leads back out to the open world.

Opens the door you find it next to.

Locations.Title: Installation K-21B Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside Bill's Suitcase in the [shack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71877). 

Used to unlock a hatch under the nearby bed.

Locations.Title: Shaun's Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** On the third floor of The Institute's main room, eastern side. Enter the director's quarters to find it inside an office cabinet near the terminal it unlocks.

Locations.Title: Wilson Atomatoys ID Card
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of one of the Super Mutants occupying the [Wilson Atomatoys Factory](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71892).

Used to unlock a door with a card reader on the southern end of the factory.

Locations.Title: Gerald's Barricade Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[University Point: Sedgwick Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442666). Go up the stairs to your left as you enter into a room marked 'Tools' to find the key on a shelf beneath the cash register.

Used to unlock the white barricade door in the main room.

Locations.Title: Campbell's Safe Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[University Point: Sedgwick Hall](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442666) - added to your inventory after following a few obscure steps.

First, make for the top floor - reached by fighting through the mirelurk-infested area behind the barricade. When you reach the backside of the chained door, search a nearby office for the Professor's Terminal and read the 'CMarsh - Lab Time' entry in the 'University Mail Relay' section.

Next, return to the ground floor and examine the Student Records terminal. In the 'Student Directory for 2077-2078' / 'Enrolled Graduates' section, search initials G-M to add the password to your inventory.

Unlocks a safe with a master-difficulty lock in the [University Credit Union](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442665) that grants access to [Prototype UP77 "Limitless Potential" [Laser Gun]](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71763).

Locations.Title: Galleria DMS Override Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Added to your inventory when looking through the Supervisor's Terminal in [Back Alley Bowling](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442693). Use the [Galleria Supervisor's Password](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401377) to unlock it without needing to hack, then read entry '7/26/77' in the 'Communication Logs' section.

Used to unlock the Director Override Terminal in the large Mr Handy statue outside.

Locations.Title: Fallon's Storage Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a toolbox in the same room where you find the [Distress Signal Source](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442704) in [Fallon's Department Store](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71819).

Used to unlock the six safes in the same room.

Locations.Title: Big John's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the Shelter found in an overturned blue train carriage at [Big John's Salvage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71920). Initially sealed shut - follow the electrical wires to a circuit breaker behind a nearby building, and pull the switch to gain access.

Once inside, you'll find it on a small table near the ladder. Used to unlock the safe behind the counter in the brick building outside.

Locations.Title: Library Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the Principal's Desk, held shut with a novice-difficulty lock and found behind a door with an expert-difficulty lock to your left immediately as you enter [Shaw High School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72024). Both the desk and door can be unlocked freely with the [Principal's Office Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442714).

Opens the library door at the northern edge of the school's second floor.

Locations.Title: Principal's Office Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Shaw High School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72024) - Inside' Rusty's Lunch', a cooler found next to a terminal in a classroom with a hole in the floor on north-eastern edge of the upper floor.

Used to gain access to the [Library Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442712), found in a room to the left of the entrance.

Locations.Title: Joe's Spuckies Basement Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found a shelf directly opposite the ladder that unlocks [Joe's Spuckies Sandwich Shop (Hatch)](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442733) at the top of the ladder, which is secured with a master-level lock.

Locations.Title: Boston Mayoral Shelter Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a suitcase at the back of the storage room.

Used to unlock a safe in the same bedroom as the [Astoundingly Awesome Tales](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71366) comic.

Locations.Title: Boston Mayoral Shelter Bathroom Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Boston Mayoral Shelter](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71858), lower level - inside a dresser in the same bedroom as the [Boston Shelter - Guard Update](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71285) holotape.

Used to unlock the bathroom around the corner where you find [Boston Shelter - Mayor's Goodbye](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71286)

Locations.Title: Radioactive Containment Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899) - on the upper floor of the laboratory, inside a locked room. 

Used to unlock the Isotope Containment Terminal downstairs.

Locations.Title: CPL Director's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Molly, a Mr. Handy robot found inside [Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899).

Used to unlock the director's office on the top floor.

Locations.Title: Blood Clinic Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Added to your inventory when reading the 'Blood Test Protocol' entry in the novice-locked Exam Room Terminal on the ground floor of [Greater Mass Blood Clinic](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71908). Near the basement stairs and a blue door to the outside that's unlocked with the [Blood Clinic Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355595).

Unlocks the Lab Access terminal on the clinic's upper floor, and a terminal inside the room on a desk.

Locations.Title: Medford Operating Theater Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Medford Memorial Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71910), middle floor - inside an instrument case on top of a desk in the north-eastern corner.

Used to unlock the master-difficulty door to the Operating Theater on the top floor, and a room on the operating theater's west side that holds some loot.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Mayor's ID
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - In the inventory of Luke Silverhand, found sitting near the chained up door inside the church.

Used to disable the tripwires in the basement of the town hall.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Town Hall Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - in the inventory of Carl Everett, found dead behind a concrete barrier.

Unlocks the [door to the town hall's basement](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443599).

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Mayor's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054) - In the inventory of Sal, found dead on the upper floor of the town hall, behind a desk.

Used to gain access to the mayor's terminal in the basement.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Archives Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Ken Standish, found on the upper floor of a ghoul-infested house north of [Jamaica Plain](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72054).

Used to unlock [a door in the town hall's basement](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443599).

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Archives Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the [Jamaica Plain Town Hall Basement](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443599), on a desk next to a locked door on the western side of the area.

Used to unlock the door you find it next to.

Locations.Title: Wilson Atomatoys ID Card
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Three can be found throughout [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851).

- Ground floor, on a desk next to the Secretary's Terminal in a small side-room.
- Ground floor, in a file cabinet near an advanced-level security terminal east of the reception desk.
- Top floor, beside a bloody skeleton near the green steamer trunk and President's Terminal

Unlocks a door with a keycard scanner next to it in the basement.

Locations.Title: Wilson Atomatoys HQ Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Three can be found throughout [Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851).

- Ground floor, near an advanced-level security terminal east of the reception desk.
- Top floor, next to a skeleton on the back row of seats in the conference room
- Top floor, inside the desk where you find the President's Terminal

Used to unlock a door near a rocket-shaped trash can on the top floor.

Locations.Title: Atomatoys Security Office Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Wilson Atomatoys Corporate HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71851) - Ground floor, on top of a cardboard box opposite the advanced-level Security Terminal east of the reception desk.

Used to unlock the terminal in the same room.

Locations.Title: Cabot House Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Given to you after meeting Jack Cabot for the first time during [Special Delivery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442643).

Used to enter [Cabot House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71825) freely.

Locations.Title: Mass Fusion Labs Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Mass Fusion Building](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71831) - in a side-room one floor above the glass ceiling. Can only be accessed by using an ID card on the elevator. (obtained during the Brotherhood of Steel's [Spoils of War](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350610) quest, or every other faction's Nuclear Option quest.)

Used to unlock the neighbouring room, where a hole in the floor can take you back down to the ground floor.

Locations.Title: Fred Allen's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063), Hotel Rexford - in a room beneath the stairs in the basement.

Unlocks a novice-level terminal in the basement's main room.

Locations.Title: Overseer Door Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the inventory of Dino, a Triggerman found inside [Vault 114](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71924).

Opens the novice-level terminal keeping the Overseer's office closed (with Nick Valentine inside.)

Locations.Title: Sleepwalker's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the end of the broken road, one level below the [Camp on the Freeway](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443612). Unlocks a safe with a master-difficulty lock in the camp's trailer.

Locations.Title: Edwin's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside a cooler at the bottom of the lake, underneath a flipped boat.

Unlocks a safe with a master-difficulty lock inside the house to the southwest.

Locations.Title: Wicked Shipping Trailer Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Beside the Wicked Shipping Terminal in the small office area of the main structure at the [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879).

The key unlocks four Wicked Shipping trailers across the Commonwealth: 
- One trailer is at [Wicked Shipping Fleet Lockup](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71879).
- One [trailer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441496) is south of [Drumlin Dinner](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71814).
- One [trailer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443610) is northeast of the [South Boston Military Checkpoint](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71933).
- One [trailer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442695) is east of the [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817).

Locations.Title: Dunwich Borers Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** [Dunwich Borers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71987) - In the inventory of a Raider corpse next to a red door. To reach it, you'll need to descend to the very bottom of the mine then work your way back up through an alternate (but still ghoul-filled) path.

Unlocks the door right next to it, leading to an area near the Station 1 terminal.

Locations.Title: Irish Pride Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Irish Pride Industries Shipyard](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71898) - In the inventory of Rory Rigwell, found dead beneath the docked boat in the Mirelurk-infested south-east corner.

Unlocks a Master-level door that leads back out to the Commonwealth.

Locations.Title: Back Storage Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
On top of a desk on the upper floor of a ruined building.

Unlocks the Master-difficulty door to a small storage room behind the building.

Locations.Title: Smelter Console Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Saugus Ironworks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71885) - Inside a locked (Expert) toolbox looted as part of [Crucible](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441413).

Used to unlock the nearby Smelter Terminal.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Corvega Storage Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on the raider boss [Gristle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=597336) fought outside the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849), during the main quest [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644). 

The key is used to open a secured supply cage in the [Corvega Assembly Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71880).

Locations.Title: Nahant Sewer Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation.

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - On the upper floor, inside a  safe that can only be unlocked by hacking a Novice-difficulty terminal.

Locations.Title: Nahant Sewers Terminal C4182 Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter DLC.

[Nahant Sewers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510397) - In the inventory of the Beast Hunter.

**Unlocks:** Terminal on the upper level of a room at the end of a pipe.

Locations.Title: Pump Station 03A Utility Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation.

[Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753) - Next to a toolbox and valve in a flooded section.

**Unlocks:** Expert-difficulty door near the flooded section.

Locations.Title: Labs Card Level 1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation.

[Underground Sewer](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510753) - Inside a locked (Expert) safe in the area behind a wall you can get through with explosives. The safe can also be unlocked after hacking into a Novice-difficulty terminal.

**Unlocks:** Double doors found immediately after entering the [Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757)

Locations.Title: Labs Card Level 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Varmint Rifle creation

[Underground Facility](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510757), Research Wing - After restoring functionality to the containment pod arm, go back down in the elevator and use the Research Control Terminal to retrieve pod 41 and find the keycard inside it.

**Unlocks:** Door inside the Reactor and Security Wing area

Locations.Title: Hubris TV Studios Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Captain Cosmos creation.

At the back of the Super Duper Mart, in front of the garage doors (where Emma’s holotape is located), on the truck inside a green box.

**Unlocks:** ??

Locations.Title: Dawson's Footlocker Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Sentinel Control System Companion creation.

In the inventory of [Dawson Wakefield](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=511196).

**Unlocks:** Footlocker

Locations.Title: Throne Room Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Fantasy Hero Set creation.

Inside a duffle bag on the rooftop, accessed via [Shenley's Oyster Bar](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=353775).

Unlocks the restroom door in the bar.

Locations.Title: Chief's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824) - Behind the locked (Novice) door to the bathroom, in a stall.

Unlocks the door to the Chief's office.

Locations.Title: Hardware Town Storage Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Second floor of [Hardware Town](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72016), on a desk next to the magazine.

Unlocks a second-floor room secured by an advanced lock.

Locations.Title: Matt's Workshop Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Revenge of the Van Graffs creation

Obtained when you read [Matt's Diary Fragment](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516496)

Unlocks [Matt's Workshop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516497)

_Note: This creation is only available on the PC and Xbox versions of the game._

Locations.Title: Boston Mayoral Shelter Bathroom Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a dresser in a blue house's baby room.

Locations.Title: Cell Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** [BADTFL Regional Office](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71824) - inside a filing cabinet in the chief’s office.

Locations.Title: Barney's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Given to you by Barney after speaking to him inside the [Rook Family House](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71812).

Activates the turret terminals throughout Salem.

Locations.Title: Bergman's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Cambridge Polymer Labs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71899) - On the upper floor, in Bergman's terminal.

Locations.Title: USCG Holding Cell Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a footlocker within a crashed vertibird just north of the super mutant occupied Coast Guard Pier.

Locations.Title: Hotel Registry Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Tucked under the counter next to Clair Hutchins in Hotel Rexford, Goodneighbor.

Locations.Title: Faneuil Hall Cashier's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Across from the Manager’s Terminal, it unlocks an office on the lower level  of Faneuil Hall with a wall safe inside.

Locations.Title: Kellogg's Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: You loot this from Kellogg’s body after defeating him. The password is needed to access Kellogg’s Terminal, which is a required step in the Reunions quest.

Locations.Title: Casey’s Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A half-sunken fishing boat has Casey’s Key in a toolbox, which opens an Expert-locked office on the second floor of the nearby Nahant Oceanological Society building.

Locations.Title: HalluciGen Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the Gunner commander; another copy is in a steamer trunk near the north exit of HalluciGen.

Locations.Title: HalluciGen Master Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Obtained from the mainframe access terminal in HalluciGen. Gives access to the research terminal, CEO's terminal, lab access terminal, and decontamination control terminal.

Locations.Title: Fort Hagen Armory Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: For Hagen, Command Center (Basement Interior): Outside of the kitchen area there is a second set of stairs through a door, with a red light in the stairway. At the bottom of the stairs and to the left, loot from the skeleton there.

Locations.Title: Cell Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: There are two copies of the key within Parsons State Insane Asylum. One is in a file cabinet in Jack’s office, behind the desk with Jack’s Office Terminal. The other is in another file cabinet just outside his office.

Locations.Title: Hubris Comics Storeroom Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located in the cash register closest to the entrance when you enter Hubris Comics.

Locations.Title: Hubris Comics Office Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: There are two keys, both located on the 2nd floor of Hubris Comics. One is in the desk with the Manager’s Terminal, and the other can be found under a desk.

Locations.Title: Fort Strong Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in the desk with General Brock’s Terminal on the first floor of the Fort Strong Armory.

Locations.Title: Clarke's Personal Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a bed beside the Outgoing Mail terminal on the Prydwen main deck during the side quest Duty or Dishonor. The key can also be pickpocketed from Initiate Clarke at the Boston Airport, or pickpocketed or looted from him when he visits the Boston Airport ruins.

Locations.Title: Lucia's Personal Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Initiate Clarke’s Footlocker on the Prydwen main deck during the side quest Duty or Dishonor. The footlocker can be opened with Clarke’s Personal Key found on the bed beside it. The key can also be pickpocketed from Knight Lucia at the Boston Airport.

Locations.Title: Prydwen Armory Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Pickpocketed from the Brother Knight-Captain you meet when entering the Prydwen Main Deck for the first time.

Locations.Title: Airport Employee ID Card
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The Airport Employee ID Card is located on the desk with the Facilities Terminal in the Boston Airport ruins. It can also be pickpocketed from Initiate Clarke, who is standing beside the desk during the side quest Duty or Dishonor. Clarke will also give you the card if he agrees to turn himself in, even if you have already pickpocketed it from him. The card allows you to use the elevator inside the ruins.

Locations.Title: Poseidon Reservoir Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located on top of the office area within Poseidon Reservoir. To reach it, climb the catwalk inside, then jump onto the roof. The key can be found in one of the corners. It opens a safe secured with a master lock found within Poseidon Reservoir.

Locations.Title: Gladys’s Room Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: You can receive this from the Front Desk Attendant at Sandy Coves Convalescent Home if you pass the speech check by saying you’re checking in. It can also be looted from them if you kill them, or if they’re killed by the Synths that show up when you return to the front desk. The key opens Gladys’s Room on the second floor, which contains a trunk and a few other items you can loot.

Locations.Title: Catherine's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Catherine’s room on the second floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, next to her cat bowls on the floor. The key opens Catherine’s Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Edward's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Edward's room on the first floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, next to his typewriter. The key opens Edward's Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Ethel's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Ethel's room on the second floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, under her paintbrush. The key opens Ethel’s Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Margaret's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Margaret’s room on the first floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, under a bag of fertilizer on the floor. The key opens Margaret’s Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Mortimer's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Mortimer’s room on the first floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, next to a boat model on a shelf. The key opens Mortimer’s Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Randall's Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in Randall’s room on the second floor of Sandy Coves Convalescent Home, under his pillow. The key opens Randall’s Safe by the front desk, which cannot be picked.

Locations.Title: Barney's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Given by Barney Rook upon completing his miscellaneous quest, or it can be pickpocketed from him. The key unlocks the room in Barney’s bunker containing Reba II.

Locations.Title: Gerald's Vault Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can be obtained from Mayor’s Terminal on the third floor of the [University Credit Union's](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442665) exterior, by reading the Town Council Logs. The password allows one to access the vault control terminal within the Credit Union's interior.

Locations.Title: Office Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the 3rd floor of the main chamber in [Kendall Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71914) with a Deathclaw nearby. The key is in a red advanced locked room. Instead of picking the lock, go left past the door, use the open window, grab the key from the shelf, then return and open the door.

Locations.Title: Mahkra Facilities Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Two can be found on raider bodies, one outside and one inside the [Mahkra Fishpacking Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71884). The first is on a raider slumped in a broken window of a side building next to the plant. The second is on a raider in the lower level inside the building.

Locations.Title: Neponset Cabin Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On top of a note lying beside skeletal remains south of [Neponset Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71985) under the elevated freeway. The key unlocks a cabin at [Neponset Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71985).

Locations.Title: Boathouse Safe Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Inside the boathouse east of the [Nakano Residence](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72719). You can find it by examining a picture frame next to a destroyed computer terminal.

*Far Harbor DLC Required*

Locations.Title: Henri's Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Sentinel Site](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71864) - Can be looted from Brother Henri if he is killed.

Used to unlock a terminal.

Locations.Title: Brahmin Fence Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Brahmin Armour creation.

In [Cowbell](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=598181)'s inventory.

Locations.Title: Eager Ernie's Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In [Eager Ernie](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=598189)'s inventory.

Locations.Title: Eager Ernie's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In [Eager Ernie](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=598189)'s inventory.

Locations.Title: Four Leaf Fishpacking Security Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Given to you as part of [Diamond City Blues](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516525) if a speech check against Trish is successful.

Locations.Title: Skylanes Cargo Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Carried by Ness, a random encounter who will hire you as part of a miscellaneous quest to help secure the [Skylanes Flight 1981](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71962) crash site from raiders. 

After the site is secured with Ness and the Gunner mercenaries she hired, she reveals that she’s really after the contents of a hidden compartment beneath the front section of the plane. If you refuse to leave with only the caps she promised, Ness and the Gunners will turn on you. Once she’s been killed, the key can be looted from her body and used to open the Master-locked hidden compartment. 

Alternatively, you can pickpocket the key from her as well.

Locations.Title: Forfeiture Terminal Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Further into the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059), After you have taken the ropeway cable car, and gone through the 2 Ada access doors, inside the desk next to the door marked "Forfeiture".

Locations.Title: Adhesive Farming Location
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Location:** South of Greater Mass Blood Clinic in a large shed with 4 Power Armor Stations, the cabinet in the back.

3x Economy Wonderglue and 2x Wonderglue respawn every few days.

Locations.Title: Fiber Optics, Steel & Crystal Farming Location
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Jamaica Plain Town Hall Basement](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443599) - at the end of a corridor filled with laser tripwires (which can each be disarmed for a single Crystal, Steel, and Fiber Optic), you can press a button to re-enable them all for endless farming.

Locations.Title: Poisoned Wine
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Seven bottles of Poison Wine are scattered around Boylston Club after exiting the elevator to the upper floor. This is the only location in the game where it can be found. The wine deals damage over time when consumed.

Locations.Title: Nuke Mine x3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: One of the few locations where nuke mines can be found. Others are on the road between Longneck Lukowski's Cannery and Crater House, and one at Hub City Auto Wreckers. All three mines at Crater House are armed.

Locations.Title: Mr. Handy Model Kit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The only place where a model kit is guaranteed to create a Mr. Handy figure. 

One can also be found in the Mechanist's lair with the Automatron DLC, and they can rarely appear when opening vault-tec lunchboxes.

Locations.Title: Complete Collection of Gwinnett Beer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a shelf in the home with Lance’s terminal in [West Everett Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72005). This is a complete collection of every type of Gwinnett beer.

Locations.Title: Protectron Model Kit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found by the Power Armor Station in the unmarked [Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441317) near [Revere Beach Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71923). It is the only place in the Commonwealth where this model kit appears, and it always produces a Protectron model. The only other places to find a Protectron model are in DLC areas, at the [Mechanist's Lair](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72059) in Automatron where it is next to a terminal, or at [Grandchester Mystery Mansion](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72636) and [RobCo Battlezone](https://fallout4map.com/nuka-world?locationIds=72631) in Nuka World.

Locations.Title: Robot Model Kit Parts
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside a side building next to the [Mahkra Fishpacking](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71884). This is one of three locations where these kits can be found, and each one spawns a random robot model when interacted with. The other two locations are [Poseidon Reservoir](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71888) and [Lakeside Shacks](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441214).

Locations.Title: Trudy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The owner of [Drumlin Diner](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71814), Trudy is involved in a standoff with chem trader [Wolfgang](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350625) during the side quest [Order Up](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350623). Depending on how the quest is resolved, Trudy, Wolfgang, or both of them can remain at the diner as traders.

**Noteworthy Inventory:**
- **[General Chao's Revenge](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71756)**

Locations.Title: Wolfgang
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A chem trader involved in a standoff with [Trudy](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350624), the owner of [Drumlin Diner](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71814), over a debt her son Patrick built up while buying chems from him during the side quest [Order Up](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350623). Depending on how the quest is resolved, Trudy, Wolfgang, or both of them can remain at the diner as traders.

Locations.Title: Ronnie Shaw
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Veteran officer of the Minutemen. Returns to [The Castle](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72055) after completing [Old Guns](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350711) and becomes a local trader.

Locations.Title: Cricket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A wandering trader who occasionally stops outside of [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065), [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929), and [Warwick Homestead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72057). Sells weapons (like the unique [Spray n' Pray](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=76606)), armor, and supply shipments.

Locations.Title: Connie Abernathy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can usually be found working the fields at [Abernathy Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72033).

Locations.Title: Suggs
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Runs a shop in a small garage west of the [Cambridge Crater](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72011). One of the few traders in the game to sell Nail Guns and Saw Blade Launchers.

Added to the game as part of the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Daniel Finch
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can usually be found tending the fields at [Finch Farm](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72042).

Locations.Title: Mr. Handy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Sells junk inside the [Science Center Gift Shop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441175)

Locations.Title: Trader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: As you walk through the flooded tunnel, a trader can be found in a side-room. Their camp also has a cooking station and mattress.

Locations.Title: Eleanor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Usually found in or around her metal trailer by the pond.

Locations.Title: Anne Hargraves
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found inside the [WRVR Broadcast Station](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71995). Becomes a trader if you ask her what she does, then ask her to work for you.

This will let you send her to a settlement where she is most useful when assigned to a clothing emporium.

Locations.Title: Bethany
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A friendly ghoul doctor can be found living in the shack here. She will heal you for a fee, and sells medical supplies among other miscellaneous items.

Locations.Title: Trader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A trader lives with several cats here.

Locations.Title: Leonard Moore
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Living in a small shack here.

Locations.Title: June Warwick
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can usually be found tending the crops at [Warwick Homestead](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72057).

Locations.Title: Brother Ogden
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can usually be found soaking up rads outside one of the shacks near the [Crater of Atom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72001).

Locations.Title: Trader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Living in a metal tube beneath the freeway.

Locations.Title: Opal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the rooftop.

Locations.Title: Synth Requisition Officer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Institute](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442607) - behind a counter directly east of the fancy elevator.

Locations.Title: Synth Cafeteria Worker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[The Institute](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442607) - behind a counter directly north of the fancy elevator.

Exclusively sells Institute Bottled Water and Institute Food Packets.

Locations.Title: Deb
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Behind a counter in the indoor section of [Bunker Hill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72049). Talk to her about a job to begin a miscellaneous quest.

**Rewards:**
- XP
- 150 Caps (if you accept the quest without asking for a reward)
- 175 Caps (if you 'ask for money' - easy speech check)
- 225 Caps (if you ask for 'more money' - medium speech check)
- 300 Caps (if you ask for 'even more money' - hard speech check)

Locations.Title: Kay
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Doctor running a stall in front of the [Bunker Hill Workbench](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442080). Can heal you or trade for medical supplies.

Locations.Title: Joe Savoldi
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Running a bar at the north-western edge of [Bunker Hill](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72049).

Locations.Title: Bluejay
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found wandering in and around the [Atom Cats Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71921).

Locations.Title: Rowdy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Usually found around the power armor stations in the [Atom Cats Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71921). Sells power armor pieces, mods, Atom Cats Custom Paint Job, and a 'Power Armor Frame' note that lets you claim the frame in the garage without it being considered theft.

Locations.Title: Proctor Teagan
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [The Prydwen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71965), Main Deck. Near the northern edge of the middle level.

Locations.Title: Theodore Collins
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found inside [Longneck Lukowski's Cannery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71886).

Note: During the [Mystery Meat](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516641) quest, Theodore Collins will turn hostile. However, if you have the Intimidation perk under Charisma, you can pacify him and unlock a dialogue option to spare him and allow him to continue the operation. In return, he gives you a cut of the profits every few days and remains a functional trader you can buy from.

Locations.Title: Tinker Tom
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Railroad HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71969).

Locations.Title: Dr. Carrington
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside [Railroad HQ](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71969). Can heal you or sell medical supplies.

Locations.Title: Slim
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A chem dealer found in a reasonably sized camp at street level.

Locations.Title: Moe Cronin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Swatters' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Arturo Rodriguez
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Commonwealth Weaponry' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Myrna / Percy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Myrna and Percy run the 'Diamond City Surplus' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968). Myrna runs the shop during the daytime, while Percy takes over at night (though the latter can be found inside Myrna's house for daytime trading.)

Locations.Title: Solomon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Chem-I-Care' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Doctor Sun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Mega Surgery' shop and offers facial reconstruction surgery in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Polly
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Choice Chops' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Vadim Bobrov
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - behind the bar of the [Dugout Inn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443637).

Locations.Title: Scarlett
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968) - found inside the [Dugout Inn](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443637).

Locations.Title: Sheng Kawolski
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Klean Watur' shop on the outskirts of [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929).

Locations.Title: Wellingham
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Outside the [Colonial Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443643) in [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929).

Locations.Title: Takahashi
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Power Noodles' shop in the [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: Henry Cooke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the [Colonial Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443643) bar in [Diamond City](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=193929).

Locations.Title: Paul Pembroke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Initially found in the [Colonial Taphouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443643).

Locations.Title: Becky Fallon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside Fallon's Basement, an unmarked interior found next to the salon in [Diamond City Market](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71968).

Locations.Title: KL-E-0
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Kill or Be Killed' gun shop in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

Locations.Title: Rufus Rubins
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the Hotel Rexford in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

Locations.Title: Daisy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Runs the 'Daisy's Discounts' shop in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

Locations.Title: Fred Allen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the Hotel Rexford in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

Locations.Title: Whitechapel Charlie
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found behind the bar of The Third Rail in [Goodneighbor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72063).

Locations.Title: Maria Summerset
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Standing behind the counter in a cafeteria on the ground floor of [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065)

Locations.Title: Alexis Combes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065) - in a room marked 'Depot' on the upper floor of the main room.

Locations.Title: Rachel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Inside the medical area at the northern edge of [Vault 81](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72065).

Locations.Title: Trader
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Patrols the area around the [Trader's Shack](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=348649). Doesn't sell anything particularly exciting.

Locations.Title: Bean
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A Mister Handy food and drink trader, Bean can be found in Slocum’s Joe at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Bean and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

**Do not order coffee from Bean** before the Galleria is opened, since the room can ignite and Bean will turn hostile. After the grand reopening, Bean refuses to serve coffee due to safety concerns.

Locations.Title: Waitron
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A food trader, Waitron can be found in Handy Eats Diner at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Waitron and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

**Save before interacting with Waitron** before the Galleria is opened. He will direct you to a booth and offer four options: mashed, diced, charbroiled, or a Charisma check to say you are not hungry. Choosing one of the first three options, failing the Charisma check, or leaving the booth too early will turn Waitron hostile and lock you out of his services as a trader.

Locations.Title: Sprocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A Mister Handy junk trader, Sprocket can be found in the General Atomics Outlet at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Sprocket and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

**Save before interacting with Sprocket** while working to open the Galleria. During his demonstration, he activates a Mister Gutsy prototype that attacks, and Sprocket can also possibly become hostile during the fight.

Locations.Title: Danny
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A Mister Handy chem trader, Danny can be found in Madden’s Gym at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Danny and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

Before fighting the Champ, make sure to use the boxing gloves found in the gym and stay inside the ring. If you step into the ring and then leave without defeating the Champ properly, the robots in the gym can turn hostile, which can cost you Danny as a trader.

Locations.Title: Crisp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A Mister Handy food trader, Crisp can be found in Pinelli’s Bakery at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Crisp and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

Before the Galleria is opened, Crisp will call out ticket numbers, but none of the [Bakery Tickets](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442278) found around the bakery match the numbers he is looking for.

Locations.Title: Reg
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A Mister Handy clothing trader, Reg can be found in Fallon’s Department Store at [General Atomics Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71817). Reg and the other Galleria merchants open for business after completing the miscellaneous quest [Galleria](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=401376). 

**Do not steal or move anything in the store** before the Galleria is opened, since Reg will turn hostile and can be lost as a trader.

Locations.Title: Red Tourette
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Location:** Found deep in the [Federal Ration Stockpile](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71857). To reach her quickly, enter through the hatch in the [Lonely Chapel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71867).

Locations.Title: Mr. Wendt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Legendary Glowing One that appears as part of a Ghoul ambush when you enter the [New England Technocrat Society](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442260).

Added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update.

Locations.Title: Super Mutant Behemoth
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: After reaching an unknown level, a Super Mutant Behemoth can spawn on the northeastern side of the stream loop that runs east from [Lake Quannapowitt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71978).

Locations.Title: Legendary Mythical Deathclaw
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter Creation

Found and fought as part of [Legendary Hunt](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510419)

Locations.Title: Dawson Wakefield
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Sentinel Control System Companion creation.

Fought here as part of the [Malevolent Malfunction](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=511198) quest.

Locations.Title: Commander Kaylor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Named Gunner enemy found outside the [Nuka-World Transit Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=117903). Carries [Kaylor's Orders](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441223).

*Nuka-World DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Scutter
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Named Raider enemy found on the rooftops of [Hyde Park](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72009).

Locations.Title: Wayne Gorski
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A named (but otherwise unremarkable) Ghoul found deep inside the Root Cellar, entered through a hatch in [Gorski Cabin](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71875).

Locations.Title: Helter Skelter
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Raider leader found within [Malden Center](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71927)

Locations.Title: Dr. Handy, M.D.
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A named (but otherwise unremarkable) Mr. Handy found within the basement of [Milton General Hospital](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71909).

Locations.Title: Security Chief Andersen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Legendary Ghoul fought inside of Vault 88.

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Gristle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
A raider boss fought outside the [Museum of Freedom](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71849) during the main quest [When Freedom Calls](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350644). 

He carries the [Corvega Storage Key](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=509929), which is used to open a secured supply cage in the [Corvega Assembly Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71880).

Locations.Title: Enclave Colonel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on basement level B3 of the [Atlantic Offices](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71850), the colonel is part of the 2024 Next-Gen creation club quest [Echoes of the Past](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441417).

Locations.Title: Cowbell
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Required:** Own and install the Brahmin Armour creation.

Locations.Title: Eager Ernie
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Acting as an announcer at [Easy City Downs](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71876)

Locations.Title: Mercy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: **Required:** Own and install the Doom BFG creation.

Locations.Title: Caroni
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Named Gunner enemy who only appears here after following every step of the '[Best of Three](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441411)' quest that was added with the 2024 Next-Gen Content Update. 

Carries a [Tesla Cannon](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=441410).

Locations.Title: Ack-Ack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: A pig-tailed raider boss found on the lowest level of [USAF Satellite Station Olivia](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72021). She is near the toolbox containing the [Locket](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=605626) needed for [Returning the Favor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350759), though she does not have to be killed to complete it.

Locations.Title: Sully Mathis
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Friendly, at first. Met at [Thicket Excavations](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71986) where he provides the [Pull the Plug](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=355598) quest. 

Some time after the quest is completed, the quarry becomes a raider stronghold. Sully is then revealed to be the raider boss in charge, waiting at the bottom of the quarry near the mirelurk pens.

Locations.Title: Big Mack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Super Mutant Enemy inside Wilson Atomatoys Factory

Locations.Title: Boomer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The raider boss of [Outpost Zimonja](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72039), Boomer wears power armor that can be taken by either stealing its fusion core to force him out, or by targeting and destroying the core in VATS.

Locations.Title: Fist
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: At the top of [Trinity Tower](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71843)

Locations.Title: Captain Bridget
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Captain of the Gunners stationed at [Hub City Auto Wreckers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71922).

Fights with a Fat Man.

Locations.Title: Rags
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: [Wreck of the FMS Northern Star](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72061) — On the main deck of the ship.

Locations.Title: Bosco
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
In the basement of [D.B. Technical High School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72027).

Wears the unique [Mascot Head](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=443617)

Locations.Title: Regi Blattaria
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Spawns in the ruined building by the road after reaching level 35.

Carries a legendary item and a gatling laser.

Locations.Title: Tower Tom
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Leader of the raiders at the [Beantown Brewery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71895)

Locations.Title: Jared
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Leader of the Raiders occupying the [Corvega Assembly Plant](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71880).

Locations.Title: Judge Zeller
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Leader of the Raiders inhabiting [East Boston Preparatory School](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72025)

Locations.Title: Croup Manor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Clear [Croup Manor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72045) of hostiles to unlock the workbench.

Located on the west side of the house.

Locations.Title: Sanctuary Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: On the porch of a house, across the street from the Sole Survivor's original home.

Locations.Title: Sunshine Tidings Co-op Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear [Sunshine Tidings Co-op](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72029) of ghouls and radroaches to use this workbench in the building in the middle of the area.

Locations.Title: Abernathy Farm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete Blake Abernathy's quest, [Returning the Favor](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350759), to unlock this workbench found outside the shack.

Locations.Title: Red Rocket Truck Stop Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the garage of the [Red Rocket Truck Stop](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72034). There is no prerequisite to begin using the workbench.

Locations.Title: Coastal Cottage Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the [Coastal Cottage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72040) of raiders and mirelurks to claim the workshop found in a garage.

Locations.Title: Nordhagen Beach Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: You can claim the [Nordhagen Beach](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72047) workbench - found behind the building - by completing the settler's quest.

Locations.Title: County Crossing Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete a quest given to you by a settler at [County Crossing](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72046) to claim the workbench found near a ruined building.

Locations.Title: Taffington Boathouse Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear [Taffington Boathouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72043) of bloodbugs to claim the workbench found on the porch.

Locations.Title: Outpost Zimonja Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of Raiders to gain control of the workbench, found near the stairs.

Locations.Title: Kingsport Lighthouse Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the [Kingsport Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72037) of hostiles to claim this workbench, found at the bottom of the stairs inside the lighthouse.

Locations.Title: Tenpines Bluff Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Can only be claimed after completing a radiant quest given by a settler at [Tenpines Bluff](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72036)

Locations.Title: Graygarden Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unlocked after completing [Troubled Waters](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350767)

Locations.Title: The Slog Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete a radiant quest offered by one of the settlers to claim this workbench, found up against the fence.

Locations.Title: Finch Farm Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete [Out of the Fire](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350754) to claim this workbench found near the shack's front door.

Locations.Title: Greentop Nursery Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete a radiant quest given by one of the settlers at [Greentop Nursery](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=72044) to claim this workbench, found in front of the blue house.

Locations.Title: Oberland Station Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete a radiant quest offered by one of the settlers to claim the workbench next to the building.

Locations.Title: Hangman's Alley Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of raiders to claim this workbench, found near a fridge.

Locations.Title: Spectacle Island Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Activate the switch next to the workbench to claim it. You'll need to activate a generator first, however - find it by following the power lines down to a boat on the beach, and be ready to fight a Mirelurk Queen.

Locations.Title: Warwick Homestead Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete a radiant quest given to you by the settlers here to claim the workshop, found at the bottom of some stairs leading inside the building.

Locations.Title: Murkwater Construction Site Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of hostiles, including a Mirelurk Queen, to claim this workbench found in a shabby wooden shack.

Locations.Title: Somerville Place Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete the radiant quest given by one of the settlers here to claim a workbench found next to the house.

Locations.Title: Egret Tours Marina Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Kill Phyllis Daily or speak to her and pass a speech check to claim this workbench, found behind a counter in the building.

Locations.Title: Starlight Drive In Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of hostiles and pick through a door with a novice-difficulty lock to claim this workbench found in a small shed.

Locations.Title: Covenant Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Defeat the current residents **OR** complete [Human Error](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=516527) to claim this workbench.

Locations.Title: The Castle Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Complete [Taking Independence](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350699), or clear the area of Mirelurks at any point beforehand to claim this workbench found in the courtyard.

Locations.Title: Boston Airport Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of hostiles and complete the [Shadow of Steel](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=350546) mission to claim this workbench found in the Arrivals area. If you get on the Brotherhood's bad side, you'll need to destroy them completely to reclaim it.

Locations.Title: Jamaica Plain Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Clear the area of Ghouls to claim this workbench, found in a ruined building to the south-west.

Locations.Title: Bunker Hill Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: This workbench, found behind south-west of Bunker Hill's monument, can only be claimed after The Battle of Bunker Hill main quest.

Locations.Title: Mechanist's Lair Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Complete [Restoring Order](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=442298) to claim this workbench, found at the edge of the room where you confront the Mechanist.

*Automatron DLC Required.*

Locations.Title: Vault 88 Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
To unlock this workshop, assist Overseer Barstow in her attempts to restore Vault 88 and conduct Vault-Tec experiments.

_Vault-Tec Workshop DLC Required_

Locations.Title: Beast Hunter's Hideout Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Tale of the Beast Hunter DLC.

[Beast Hunter's Hideout](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510369) - In the basement, reached via [Nahant Sewers](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=510397).

Locations.Title: Wilmingdon Estates Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: In the lowest level of the basement bunker beneath [Wilmingdon Estates](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543137). Clear out the ghouls to claim it.

Locations.Title: Juniper Cove Resort Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Own and install the Bunker Home Pack creation.

Inside [Juniper Cove Resort](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=543140).
